column1: Boss, they're tryin' to sell us this laughable UrbanMech UFO as the pinnacle of space piracy. A Gauss Rifle with a fancy 'tractor beam' for scrap, a bunch of small lasers, and Metal blarin' through its comms. It's like they're playin' MechWarrior dress-up in space. Hurlin' scrap through a Gauss Rifle might be a spectacle, but I'd bet it's more likely to backfire than impress. And those small lasers? It's a joke – like they strapped glow sticks to a Mech and called it a day. I'd pass on this cosmic clown show; there's no serious threat here, just a Mech trying too hard to be something it ain't.
column2: 老大，他们正试图把这台可笑的 UrbanMech UFO 当成太空海盗的巅峰之作卖给我们。一把高斯步枪配上华而不实的“牵引光束”来发射废料，几门小型激光器，还有通讯中传来的金属音乐。简直像是在太空里玩《MechWarrior》换装游戏。用高斯步枪抛射废料也许很壮观，但我敢说它更可能走火，而不是给人留下深刻印象。至于那些小型激光器？纯粹是笑话，就像把荧光棒绑在机甲上便宣称大功告成。我会远离这场宇宙小丑秀；这里没有真正的威胁，只有一台拼命想装成别的东西的机甲。

column1: Developed as an experimental testbed for a unique XXL Gyro and paired with a HAG-40, this Urbanmech is test model with which to develop new combat doctrine and test radical new inovations.
column2: 这台 UrbanMech 是独特 XXL 陀螺仪的实验测试平台，并与 HAG-40 配套，用于开发新的作战理论和测试激进的新技术。

column1: This variant carries an ER PPC, TAG, 比格犬主动探头, and 守护者ECM Suite. It retains the Small Laser of the standard Urban机甲 as well. 改进的 Jump Jets help the Urban机甲 move around the city it defends more effectively.
column2: 该变体装备增程 PPC、TAG、主动探测器和 Guardian ECM 套件，同时保留标准 UrbanMech 的小型激光器。改进型跳跃喷射器让 UrbanMech 能更有效地在它守护的城市中机动。

column1: Taking inspiration from the R20 series of mechs, this Urbanmech was designed from the ground up to be a cheap and nasty ambusher aimed at the mercenary market. The combination of stealth armour and rockets allow it to savage unsuspecting targets and withdraw.
column2: 这台 UrbanMech 从 R20 系列机甲汲取灵感，从头设计成面向佣兵市场的廉价、凶狠伏击者。隐形装甲与火箭的组合能重创毫无防备的目标，然后迅速撤离。

column1: Meant for close in-city fighting, the R61L is upgraded with Stealth Equipment alongside its less expensive R60L cousin's AC20.
column2: R61L 专为于城市近距离作战，在成本更低的 R60L 表亲所用 AC/20 基础上增加了隐形设备。

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Howitzer! Unlike its smaller brethren, this Trashcan does not have to waddle into range before bringing its weaponry to bear.
column2: 别被这个矮胖的“Urbie”骗了——它看起来像会走路的垃圾桶，却能安装重型装甲和成人级榴弹炮！不像那些更小的同族，这个垃圾桶无需蹒跚着靠近目标就能开火。

column1: The -015 carries a 银弹高斯 Rifle in the right arm and a Light PPC with Twin Linked Capacitor in the left, making it a fearsome foe at medium to long ranges. A head mounted AMS Mk2 provides defensive capabilities. 特性：泰克铁康TC7000 部署成本倍率：1.45 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: -015 在右臂装备一门银弹高斯步枪，左臂装备带双联电容器的轻型 PPC，因此在中远距离都是可怕的敌人。头部安装的 AMS Mk2 提供防御能力。 特性：泰克铁康 TC7000 部署成本倍率：1.45 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: It's a...I...don't know? It looks like an oversized Annihilator, Boss. But look at those weapons, what is this? I will never understand the mind of these pirates.
column2: 这是……我……不知道？老大，它看起来像一台放大版 Annihilator。但看看这些武器，这到底是什么？我永远无法理解这些海盗的脑子。

column1: With the bad reputation the Sarath had obtained, the Free wolds League approved the creation of a 140 ton superheavy version in an attempt to regain some of the design lines reputation. The task of designing it was once again given to Ronin Inc, and the result was the Narayana Omni QuadMech. Its main focus are on indirect fire support with a 425 XL engine to ensure the QuadMech is mobile enough to reposition without too much delay.
column2: Sarath 声名狼藉后，自由世界联盟批准制造一款 140 吨超重型版本，试图挽回该设计系列的声誉。设计任务再次交给 Ronin 公司，最终成果就是 Narayana Omni 四足机甲。它主要承担间接火力支援，425 XL 引擎确保这台四足机甲能够及时重新部署。

column1: Developed on Betelguese by Capellan Confderation scientists in secret on direct orders from Chancellor Liao and later produced by Hellespont Industries in the same star system, the Roncone is a superheavy design loosely based on the Battlemaster 4L. The Roncone was an attempt to build on the stealth and ECM capabilities of the Battlemaster 4L, but constant struggles with the sheer size of a Superheavy meant that the stealth was mediocre at best.
column2: Roncone 由卡佩兰联盟科学家在 Betelguese 秘密研制，直接听命于执政官 Liao，后来由同一星系的 Hellespont Industries 生产。这是一款略微参考 Battlemaster 4L 的超重型设计，试图继承其隐形与 ECM 能力；但超重型机体过于庞大，持续的结构问题使其隐形性能充其量只能算普通。

column1: The -Er is a recent refit of the SG11-E to focus more on firepower over ruggedness. By dropping the Binary Lasers in favor of Large Pulser Lasers managed to upgrade the MRM-10 to MRM-30 launchers and adding two ER Medium Lasers, and the Heavy Duty Gyro and Reactive Plates have been exchanged for weight saving options. The final change of the refit is the switch to Compact Heat Sinks. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4
column2: -Er 是 SG11-E 的近期改装型，更重视火力而非坚固性。它放弃 Binary Lasers 换装 Large Pulser Lasers，将 MRM-10 升级为 MRM-30 发射器并增加两门增程中型激光器，同时以更轻的设备替换重型陀螺仪和反应装甲板。改装的最后一步是改用紧凑型散热器。 特性：改良生命维持 部署成本倍率：1.4

column1: The Gulltoppr OmniMonitor is a thirty-second century superheavy OmniVehicle. It was first 生产 for the Lyran Commonwealth and Clan Wolf-in-Exile as a defensive garrison unit. The Gulltoppr was 设计ed and manufactured by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal in 3102, the unit was mass 生产 to help fill up worlds on the Clan border. Gulltoppr are mammoth machines that are noted for their impressive firepower and 装甲, but their slow speeds keeps them from being anything more than a defensive combat unit. Weaponry for the Gulltoppr's Primary Configuration is mounted exclusively in its two turrets. 炮塔 one is the home to a pair of Gauss Rifles, which are fed by four tons of ammunition. 炮塔 Two houses the 车辆's big, short-ranged 长 Tom cannon and a pair of anti-missile systems. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. 装甲: Hardened 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 470 133 左侧 365 133 右侧 365 133 后方 280 133 炮塔 290 133 总计 1770 665 怪癖: 作战电脑B2000 Omni 车辆
column2: Gulltoppr OmniMonitor 是三十二世纪的超重型 OmniVehicle。它最初为莱拉联邦和流亡狼氏族生产，作为防御驻军单位。Gulltoppr 于 3102 年由流亡狼氏族在 Arc-Royal 设计并制造，随后大规模生产，用于填补氏族边境世界的防务空缺。Gulltoppr 是巨大的机器，以惊人的火力和装甲著称，但缓慢的速度使它只能担任防御作战单位。Gulltoppr 的主配置武器全部安装在两座炮塔中：一号炮塔装有两门高斯步枪，由四吨弹药供给；二号炮塔装有该载具的大型近程 Long Tom 火炮和两套反导系统。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲： Hardened 结构： 结构 数值 A S 正面 470 133 左侧 365 133 右侧 365 133 后方 280 133 炮塔 290 133 总计 1770 665 特性：作战电脑 B2000 Omni 载具

column1: The Gulltoppr OmniMonitor is a thirty-second century superheavy OmniVehicle. It was first 生产 for the Lyran Commonwealth and Clan Wolf-in-Exile as a defensive garrison unit. The Gulltoppr was 设计ed and manufactured by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal in 3102, the unit was mass 生产 to help fill up worlds on the Clan border. Gulltoppr are mammoth machines that are noted for their impressive firepower and 装甲, but their slow speeds keeps them from being anything more than a defensive combat unit. This configuration sports a mix of Inner Sphere and Clan technology. The 坦克's main guns (fitted in turret one) are a pair of Clan Gauss Rifles with four tons of ammo. In turret two, three Artemis V guided Clan LRM-20 Launchers are housed. The launchers have eight tons of ammunition fed to them from the 车辆's hull ammunition bin. Other equipment fitted includes a Clan 定位 Computer and a Clan ECM Suite. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. 装甲: Hardened 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 475 133 左侧 365 133 右侧 365 133 后方 280 133 炮塔 290 133 总计 1775 665 怪癖: 作战电脑B2000 Omni 车辆
column2: Gulltoppr OmniMonitor 是三十二世纪的超重型 OmniVehicle。它最初为莱拉联邦和流亡狼氏族生产，作为防御驻军单位。Gulltoppr 于 3102 年由流亡狼氏族在 Arc-Royal 设计并制造，随后大规模生产，用于填补氏族边境世界的防务空缺。Gulltoppr 是巨大的机器，以惊人的火力和装甲著称，但缓慢的速度使它只能担任防御作战单位。该配置混合使用内圈与氏族科技：一号炮塔的主炮是两门氏族高斯步枪，配备四吨弹药；二号炮塔装有三具 Artemis V 制导的氏族 LRM-20 发射器，由车体弹药舱提供八吨弹药。其他设备包括氏族目标锁定计算机和氏族 ECM 套件。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲： Hardened 结构： 结构 数值 A S 正面 475 133 左侧 365 133 右侧 365 133 后方 280 133 炮塔 290 133 总计 1775 665 特性：作战电脑 B2000 Omni 载具

column1: Formerly a Royal variant, these M2s are tough and reliable. I'd think twice about trying to get close in under the LRMs.
column2: 这些 M2 过去是皇家变体，坚固而可靠。想在 LRM 火力下靠近它之前，最好三思。

column1: Boss, this thing ain't much for hurtin' 'Mechs but between that engine and that Ion Projector, infantry and the like don't stand a chance.
column2: 老大，这东西对机甲的杀伤力不算强，但凭借那台引擎和 Ion Projector，步兵之类的目标根本没有活路。

column1: The Lunar Crab 1ES is an ambush conversion of the 1E, trading the 300XL for a 300-rating明尼苏达部落 Stealth engine, switching to Improved Large Lasers in the arms, and trading the 中型激光 compliment for a pair of Rocketstorm 90 batteries. 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lunar Crab 1ES 是 1E 的伏击改装型，将 300XL 替换为额定 300 的明尼苏达部落隐形引擎，手臂换装改进型大型激光器，并以两组 Rocketstorm 90 电池替换原有的中型激光器。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower，右侧 Lower

column1: You know, I didn't think I'd see one of these with this many missiles before. This isn't a museum piece like the other Mackie's I've seen.
column2: 你知道吗，我以前没见过一台装这么多导弹的 Mackie。这可不是我见过的那些博物馆展品。

column1: Built for long-range firepower, this Pulverizer relies on a Hyper PPC for firepower at all ranges and the inclusion of a standard engine and Heavy Cockpit makes it sturdier than many of its contemporaries.
column2: Pulverizer 为远程火力而生，依靠 Hyper PPC 在各种距离输出火力；标准引擎和重型驾驶舱让它比许多同代机型更坚固。

column1: A new take on a classic, Boss. This thing trades up the AC5 for an Improved AC10, the missiles for a Rocketstorm battery, and, best of all, it finally has the proper amount of Jump Jets.
column2: 经典设计的新诠释，老大。这东西用改进型 AC/10 替换 AC/5，用 Rocketstorm 电池替换导弹；最棒的是，它终于装上了正确数量的跳跃喷射器。

column1: For a medium mech, this thing is dangerously fast. That Enhanced ERPPC allows it to stay at a safe range until it is ready to pounce.
column2: 对一台中型机甲来说，这东西快得危险。增强型 ER PPC 让它能保持安全距离，直到准备好扑向目标。

column1: Boss? You ever wonder what a reactor breach looks like up close? No? Well, if you ever do, go stand near the right arm on this thing.
column2: 老大，你有没有想过近距离看反应堆破裂是什么样？没有？那如果哪天想看，就站到这东西的右臂旁边。

column1: What...in...the...world!? Is this a 'Mech or ancient behemoth!? Look at all that armor, that protective plating, and all those latest tech weapons!
column2: 这……到底是什么！？这是机甲还是远古巨兽！？看看那一身装甲、防护镀层，还有那些最新科技武器！

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. The Hyperion Prime is a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it is just as fast as an Atlas, carries more armor, and those Arrow V missiles pack a hell of a punch.
column2: 老大，我很确定这东西刚才对我吼了一声。Hyperion Prime 真是台可怕的机器：虽然重了 25 吨，却和 Atlas 一样快，装甲更多，而 Arrow V 导弹的威力更是惊人。

column1: We see a lot of kill markers scratched into mechs but this one's got ones that look like those big Clan fellas and there are a lot of them. I have a feeling they know this one.
column2: 我们经常看到机甲上刻着击杀标记，但这台机甲上的标记看起来像那些高大的氏族战士，而且数量很多。我感觉他们认识这台机甲。

column1: Despite the design being considered obsolete well before the Exodus, the schematics for the Helepolis siege mech survived the journey to the Pentagon Worlds where it went largely ignored until the Golden Century. A small group of Coyote scientists retooled the arcane design, increasing its tonnage and applying most of the weight saving techologies available, and submitted it to their Khan. Despite being rejected as a dishonorable design the HEP-IIC survived in Society caches and has slowly been upgraded over the years. The Z variant sports a Sniper Artillery Piece and a Society MRM60.
column2: 尽管这种设计在大撤离前很久就被视为过时，Helepolis 攻城机甲的图纸仍随旅程抵达五角星世界，并一直被忽视到黄金世纪。一小群 Coyote 科学家重新打造了这份古老设计，增加吨位并应用当时能找到的大部分减重技术，然后提交给他们的可汗。尽管它因不光彩而被拒绝，HEP-IIC 仍保存在 Society 的秘密仓库中，多年来逐步升级。Z 型装备一门狙击炮和一门 Society MRM60。

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of fire power and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox Z is armed with a Large Supra Laser and an ER Small Laser. A pair of Laser AMS, a Streak Narc and a TAG round out the Society variant. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Kit Fox 是一台轻型氏族 OmniMech，30 吨，于 2890 年由云蛇氏族推出。它偏重火力和装甲而牺牲速度，使用 180 XL 引擎，并混合 Endo Steel 与铁纤维装甲，提供 16 吨舱位空间。Kit Fox Z 装备一门大型 Supra 激光器和一门增程小型激光器；两套激光 AMS、一具 Streak Narc 和一具 TAG 完成了 Society 变体的配置。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Rabid Coyote was 设计ed by scientists from Clan Coyote to be a complement to other, slower Battle机甲s. First deployed in 3066, the '机甲 was deployed in an effort to stave off the slow decline of the previous decades that had befallen the Clan that created the Omni机甲. Curiously, as the '机甲 is intended to be a bodyguard for larger '机甲s like the 野蛮郊狼, front-line warriors spurn the 设计 because they do not wish to be seen merely as "support". 怪癖: Experimental TC 掉落成本乘数: 1.19
column2: Rabid Coyote 由 Coyote 氏族科学家设计，用来支援其他速度较慢的 BattleMech。它于 3066 年首次部署，旨在遏制制造这台 OmniMech 的氏族在前几十年中逐渐衰落的趋势。讽刺的是，这台机甲原本是为保护像野蛮郊狼这样的大型机甲而设计的，前线战士却不愿被视为单纯的“支援”人员，因此对该设计颇有抵触。 特性：实验型目标锁定计算机 部署成本倍率：1.19

column1: The Z-B is an advanced Society configuration that utilizes a pair of Society MRM45s, a pair of Medium Supra Lasers, and a pair of Small Supra Lasers.
column2: Z-B 是 Society 的先进配置，使用两具 Society MRM45、两门中型 Supra 激光器和两门小型 Supra 激光器。

column1: Cooperating with the Republic did 鲁西恩装甲工厂 manage to create a upgraded version of the early Avatar 全向Mech. Employing Advanced Technologies could it only be produced in limited numbers. 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 与共和国合作后，鲁西恩装甲工厂成功制造出早期 Avatar OmniMech 的升级版。由于采用先进技术，它只能限量生产。 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Anand is another Prototype of the Morrigan Project, named for a Goddess that protects the Land has this Omni Received special care to it's protective abilitys
column2: Anand 是 Morrigan 项目的又一款原型机，名称取自守护大地的女神；这台 OmniMech 在防护能力方面得到了特别强化。

column1: As far as battlefield hackjobs go, I've seen worse. Sure, it's not the prettiest, or the most heat efficient, or the most stocked on ammo, or-- well. You get the idea. At least the fact it's still here meant it worked, I guess.
column2: 说到战场上的临时拼装活，我见过更糟的。当然，它不算漂亮，散热效率也不高，弹药储备更谈不上充足，而且——好吧，你懂我的意思。至少它还在这里，说明这套改装确实能用。

column1: A experimental rebuild of the clan Behemoth/Stone Rhino, this variant is 设计ed around a experimental engine that frees up enough space in the center torso to make full use of its spinal mounted 炮塔 System. 怪癖: Spinal Mount 掉落成本乘数: 1.29 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是氏族 Behemoth／Stone Rhino 的实验性重建型，围绕一台实验引擎打造，腾出足够的中央躯干空间，以充分利用脊椎安装的火炮系统。 特性：脊椎挂载 部署成本倍率：1.29 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower，右侧 Lower

column1: Capitalizing on the hatred of Wolfs Dragoons. Kurita had a plan for several captured Annihilators. Remove the limiters on the LBX weapons and show Jaime Wolf and his Mercenary Dogs what Death was really about.
column2: 利用人们对 Wolfs Dragoons 的仇恨，Kurita 为几台缴获的 Annihilator 制定了计划：解除 LBX 武器的限制，让 Jaime Wolf 和他的佣兵猎犬见识真正的死亡。

column1: Another one of these 'Mechs of unknown origin, huh? We had a look over it, like you asked. Pretty strange stuff. Mixed technology all through the old girl, and somebody left a note in the cockpit that just says "hehe shonk".
column2: 又是一台来历不明的机甲，对吧？我们按你的要求检查过了，东西相当奇怪。整台老姑娘到处都是混合技术，而且有人在驾驶舱留下了一张字条，只写着“嘿嘿，鲨鱼”。

column1: This 'Mech is old, boss. Like, seriously old. We're talking early - or maybe even before - Star League. Somebody's given this baby a lot of love over the years, although I definitely question some of the decisions. The targeting system especially seems a bit of a hack job.
column2: 这台机甲太老了，老大。真的非常老，早在星盟初期——甚至可能更早——就存在。多年来有人精心维护并改装了它，不过其中一些决定实在值得质疑，尤其是目标锁定系统，看起来就是临时拼出来的。

column1: Jeez. Never get tired of seeing these things. This Atlas packed a serious punch for its time period, I can tell you that much. Lacking on the range a bit, but with the supercharger I'm not so sure it was ever intended to sit on the back lines.
column2: 天哪，我永远看不腻这些东西。这台 Atlas 在它所属的年代火力相当惊人，这点我可以保证。射程稍有不足，但装了增压器，我不确定它是否本来就打算待在后方。

column1: The first generation Black Watches were solid assault mechs- giving classics like the Battlemaster a run for their money. This -8A refit package sports the best our Inner-Sphere tech and Clan-tech has to offer. I've always wanted to get under the hood of one myself, but they're quite exclusive, and this one seems to be almost perfect as is. Also, the designer was a boxing fan. 11/10 Boss.
column2: 第一代 Black Watch 是坚实的突击机甲，足以和 Battlemaster 这样的经典型号一较高下。这套 -8A 改装包融合了内圈和氏族技术的精华。我一直想亲自打开一台看看，但它们非常稀有，而这台看起来几乎已经完美。顺便说，设计师还是拳击迷。11 分满分，老大。

column1: The S7 variant incorporates LosTech Stealth and Sensor Technologies, further improving the Bushwacker's ability to evade target tracking, and enabling it to move unseen and undetected until it can unleash a deadly volley.
column2: S7 型采用失落科技隐形与传感器技术，进一步提高 Bushwacker 躲避目标追踪的能力，让它能在释放致命齐射前悄无声息地移动、避开侦测。

column1: The Basilisk is an agile Fire Support Platform, able to dish out high damage at extreme ranges while staying relatively safe itself, some refer to it as a Mad Catapult.
column2: Basilisk 是一台敏捷的火力支援平台，能够在极远距离造成高额伤害，同时保持自身相对安全；有人称它为“Mad Catapult”。

column1: This 'Mech is about as duelist as they come, Boss. Sure, the configuration isn't what they might call "optimised" over on Solaris, but this thing'll still strip your armour and rinse out your internals.
column2: 老大，这台机甲几乎就是决斗专家。当然，这套配置在 Solaris 那边可能算不上“优化”，但它仍然能剥掉你的装甲，把你的内部结构冲个精光。

column1: I'm no stranger to the Emperor's reputation to keep lasers running cool, but this is an incredibly ambitious build, even with the improvements to the cooling jackets. That said, I think with some restraint, I could see this thing doing some serious work as direct fire support. Shame that some monster removed the jump jets, though. Those things were iconic!
column2: 我对 Emperor 让激光器保持低温的名声并不陌生，但这套设计实在过于大胆，即使冷却套管已经改进也是如此。话虽如此，只要稍加节制，我认为它完全可以胜任直接火力支援。可惜某个怪物拆掉了跳跃喷射器——那些东西可是标志性装备！

column1: A unusual Prototype 设计, while still Maintaining the 200 XL engine has the MASC removed for more Armour and Firepower. Still being a Fast mech, having increased armour and alot of Machineguns, this Firemoth was 设计ed to support Elementals that would be hanging off of it. The entire Cockpit has Upgrades in it, there are also Questionable Materials in here.掉落成本乘数: 0.98.
column2: 这是一台不寻常的原型机甲。它保留 200 XL 引擎，却拆除 MASC，以换取更多装甲和火力。Fire Moth 依然速度很快，增加的装甲和大量机枪让它适合支援挂载在机体上的 Elemental。整个驾驶舱都经过升级，里面还使用了一些值得怀疑的材料。部署成本倍率：0.98。

column1: 增强成像, Special Sensors and very nice Optics make this Glass Spider a Real Danger to anything it sees. The XL Engine makes room for the Two UAC2's and Two UAC5's, complemented by the Lone Medium Heavy Laser. An 主动探头 and a 守护者ECM give this enough Ewar to make it look Sensible too, while the Laser AMS give it good Coverage. All in all, a Very nice, purpose Built Mech Boss, even if albeit a bit on the Slower Side of things.
column2: 强化装甲、特殊传感器和极佳光学设备让这台 Glass Spider 对任何被它发现的目标都极其危险。XL 引擎腾出空间，安装两门 UAC/2 和两门 UAC/5，另有一门中型重型激光器提供补充火力。主动探测器和 Guardian ECM 让它拥有足够的电子战能力，激光 AMS 也提供良好防护。总的来说，这是台用途明确、设计出色的机甲，老大——只是速度稍慢。

column1: What a funny-lookin' 'Mech. There's a ton of comments tucked away in her maintenance logs talking about how special she is. I don't see it. It's a bunch of half-baked Clan tech bolted onto a crumbling chassis. I'll make her sing, sure, but it might not be the soprano you're hoping for, Boss.
column2: 真是台长相滑稽的机甲。维护日志里塞满了关于它有多特殊的评论，但我看不出来。它不过是把半成品氏族科技焊在一副正在崩坏的底盘上。我会让它唱起来，当然，可能不是你期待的女高音，老大。

column1: The 'Vollstrecker', or Executioner, is a Steiner Elite Battlemech, agile like a medium 'Mech and armed to the Teeth, is this a true Lyran Military doctrine Scout.
column2: “Vollstrecker”，也就是“执行者”，是一台 Steiner 精英 BattleMech。它像中型机甲一样敏捷，武装到牙齿，真正体现了莱拉军队的侦察理念。

column1: In common with several lighter clan combat units this Jenner carries an impressive loadout of machine guns. The pair of heavy medium lasers are quite capable of punching a hole in armor that you can pour bullets into.
column2: 和几种较轻的氏族战斗单位一样，这台 Jenner 携带了惊人的机枪配置。两门重型中型激光器足以在装甲上打出缺口，让机枪子弹倾泻而入。

column1: This 'Mech has some speed on her, Boss. Just as well, too - all these weapons are a helluva lot shorter range than the usual LRMs these things carry. 12 SRMs, 3 medium lasers, and 3 smalls should be enough to put the hurt on most things around the same weight class.
column2: 这台机甲速度很快，老大。这样正好——它携带的所有武器射程都比这类机甲通常使用的 LRM 短得多。12 具 SRM、3 门中型激光器和 3 门小型激光器，足以重创大多数同吨位目标。

column1: Developed by Clan 地狱战马 as an insult to 氏族钻石鲨 is this variant of the Mad Cat MKII 设计ed to carry a pair of their newly 开发 experimental RAC5, bringing Sorrow upon any who dare stand in its Way. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.27 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是氏族为羞辱石头蛮牛而开发的 Mad Cat MK II 变体，搭载两门新近完成的实验型 RAC/5，任何敢挡路的人都会迎来悲惨结局。 特性：标准武器 - AC 部署成本倍率：1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower，右侧 Lower

column1: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. Though this was piloted and decorated like a typical Pirate Mech, something is entirely off about this.
column2: Marauder II 于 3012 年首次制造，旨在将 Marauder 的火力与突击级底盘的可靠性和坚固性结合起来。虽然这台机甲被按典型海盗机甲的方式驾驶和装饰，但其中有些地方完全不对劲。

column1: A excavated derelict Omega retrofitted and made functional by a 'very lucky' Pirate, it has a mostly functional StarLeague Era 'Railgun' permanently fixed into its center torso.
column2: 一台被挖掘出来的废弃 Omega 经过“非常幸运”的海盗改装并恢复运作，中央躯干永久固定着一门基本可用的星盟时代“轨道炮”。

column1: The Rabid Coyote was 设计ed by scientists from Clan Coyote to be a complement to other, slower Battle机甲s. First deployed in 3066, the '机甲 was deployed in an effort to stave off the slow decline of the previous decades that had befallen the Clan that created the Omni机甲. Curiously, as the '机甲 is intended to be a bodyguard for larger '机甲s like the 野蛮郊狼, front-line warriors spurn the 设计 because they do not wish to be seen merely as "support". 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.17
column2: Rabid Coyote 由 Coyote 氏族科学家设计，用来支援其他速度较慢的 BattleMech。它于 3066 年首次部署，旨在遏制制造这台 OmniMech 的氏族在前几十年中逐渐衰落的趋势。讽刺的是，这台机甲原本是为保护像野蛮郊狼这样的大型机甲而设计的，前线战士却不愿被视为单纯的“支援”人员，因此对该设计颇有抵触。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.17

column1: The Scorpion was one of the first Quad机甲s to come out of the 泰拉霸权 en masse. Weird 设计 at the best of times, but this one is somethin' else entirely. The stealth systems on this thing mean it could creep right up behind ya' and you wouldn't even know 'til it stung you.
column2: Scorpion 是最早大规模走出泰克铁康氏族生产线的四足机甲之一。它在最好的时候就已经够怪了，而这台更是完全不同。隐形系统让它能悄悄摸到你身后，直到它蜇你之前你都不会察觉。

column1: Based on the Raven Battle机甲, the Sha Yu, or ''Shark'', is one of the first '机甲s to incorporate the Stealth 装甲 开发 by the Capellan Confederation. A top speed of 118 km/h allows it to control where and when it engages a Target. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Sha Yu（意为“鲨鱼”）以 Raven BattleMech 为基础，是最早采用卡佩兰联盟研制的隐形装甲系统的机甲之一。118 公里／小时的最高速度让它能够控制交战的地点和时机。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper，右侧 Upper

column1: The Shinigami, 'Death Spirit', is a Kurita Prototype using stolen and reverse engineered Stealth Systems, striking from the shadows while being just as respectable a foe at shorter ranges.
column2: Shinigami，即“死神”，是 Kurita 的原型机，使用窃取并逆向工程的隐形系统，从阴影中发动攻击，同时在近距离仍是不可小觑的对手。

column1: Based on old Prototypes of the Project Phoenix 'Super Griffin', the 3-X is an attempt to create a more modern and capable upgrade of the somewhat ancient Griffin.
column2: 3-X 基于 Project Phoenix“Super Griffin”的旧原型，是一次让这台略显古老的 Griffin 变得更现代、更强大的升级尝试。

column1: This chassis is a pretty radical depature from the usual jack-of-all-trades approach your regular Thunderbolt has. Makes sense given the designation, I suppose. No need for MGs or small lasers if you're only expecting to fight 'Mechs.
column2: 这套底盘与普通 Thunderbolt 的万金油思路截然不同，算是一次相当激进的偏离。考虑到它的型号，这倒也说得通：既然只预计与机甲交战，就不需要机枪或小型激光器。

column1: A customised model, this RQA-B was one of the original prototypes, built prior to the first production run. Full of technological upgrades that never made it into production, this mech is equally deadly at range and close quarters. Featuring 3 PPC’s, first generation heat dissipation armour and a unique FCS built to maximise the damage potential of the weapons; this Urbanmech has claimed many unwary opponents. Piloted by one of Damage Inc’s senior officers, this mech is equally notorious among Damage Inc’s opponents and allies.
column2: 这是定制型号，RQA-B 是最初的原型机之一，在首批量产机之前制造。它充满了从未进入量产的技术升级，无论远距离还是近距离都同样致命。它装备 3 门 PPC、第一代散热装甲，以及专门优化武器伤害潜力的独特火控系统；这台 UrbanMech 已让许多毫无防备的敌人成为牺牲品。驾驶它的是 Damage Inc. 的一名高级军官，因此它在 Damage Inc. 的敌我双方中都臭名昭著。

column1: Well, this is a monster of a 'Mech. Whoever designed this thing loved their PPCs; the entire fire control systems are optimised around squeezing as much out of them as possible. She runs way hot, though, so keep an eye on that.
column2: 这真是一台怪物般的机甲。设计它的人热爱 PPC；整套火控系统都围绕着尽可能榨出 PPC 火力进行优化。不过它运行时非常过热，一定要盯紧热量。

column1: Well, I can say that this 'Ronin' had more brains and better tastes than most of the periphery and pirate junk we often come across. Must've been pretty well off to afford all this custom work, and I'd really love to meet the tech who made it happen. Pretty straight forward missile brawling mech CO, my kind of style.
column2: 我得说，这个“Ronin”比我们经常遇到的大多数外围和海盗垃圾更聪明、品味也更好。能负担这些定制改装，它的主人肯定相当富裕；我真想见见完成这项工作的技师。总体而言，这是一台直截了当的导弹格斗机，很合我的口味。

column1: The Anzu was well-regarded by both 机甲Warriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had 开发 since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard 装甲 with CASE II built in to protect the '机甲 and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Anzu 因可靠性受到战士和技师双方好评；自圣战以来，AMSC 一直采用激进的战斗战术，认为 Anzu 非常适合这种风格。虽然 Anzu 的最高地面速度只有 64 公里／小时，但 Chilton 465 跳跃喷射器允许它跃进 120 米。Anzu 装有 11 吨 Starshield A 型标准装甲，并内置 CASE II，以保护机体和驾驶员免受弹药爆炸伤害。Anzu 还采用与 Shadow Hawk 相同、在其服役时已久经验证的生命维持系统；RCA Instatrac Mark X 目标锁定与追踪系统则允许它同时攻击多个目标，并通过安装的 TAG 系统为间接火力进行目标标定。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower，右侧 Lower

column1: Apparently 设计ed as a command 车辆, the Perseus E has three tons of Communications Equipment in the right torso. A 比格犬主动探头 is available to find hidden units. Offensively, the E configuration carries a Gauss Rifle, Large 变速脉冲激光, Medium 变速脉冲激光, and ER Small Laser. An ER 中型激光 covers the rear. For last ditch defense, the E variant carries an 改进的 One-Shot SRM-6 in the center torso.
column2: 显然，这是一台被当作指挥机使用的机甲。Perseus E 在右侧躯干安装了 3 吨通信设备，并配备主动探测器用于发现隐藏单位。E 型配置搭载高斯步枪、大型激光器、中型激光器和增程小型激光器；后方还有一门增程中型激光器。作为最后防线，E 型在中央躯干安装了一次性 SRM-6。

column1: 圣战期间投入生产的定制Demolisher Bombast，装备两门Bombast激光、两具MML-5和两门Magshot，后者用于压制步兵和战斗装甲。 Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: 重型铁纤维装甲 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 300 40 Left 220 40 Right 220 40 Rear 150 40 Turret 235 40 Total 1125 200 特性：主战坦克
column2: 在一次改造中，Demolisher Bombast 加装了外部设备，包括 Bombast 炮塔、MML-5 导弹发射器、Magshot 和压制装甲。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 300 40 左侧 220 40 右侧 220 40 后方 150 40 炮塔 235 40 总计 1125 200 特性：主战坦克

column1: Developed during the Jihad this Shreck variant replaced one standard PPC with a Light PPC. This freed enough space and weight to add a C3 Master, 守护者ECM Suite, and an 反导系统. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 275 40 左侧 120 40 右侧 120 40 后方 110 40 炮塔 180 40 总计 805 200 特性：窄小低矮轮廓
column2: Shreck 的这一变体在圣战期间开发，用一门轻型 PPC 替换标准 PPC。腾出的空间和重量用于增加 C3 主计算机、Guardian ECM 套件和反导系统。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 275 40 左侧 120 40 右侧 120 40 后方 110 40 炮塔 180 40 总计 805 200 特性：窄小低矮轮廓

column1: The 黄蜂 was built around the Poland Model C Gauss rifle. Subsequent version mounted other system, but it remained centered around as single heavy weapon. Though not as fast as most VTOLs, the 黄蜂 still has greater speed than most Battle机甲s and Omni机甲s. The long range weapons, respectable speed and relatively heavy 装甲 keep the 车辆 safer than many of it's peers. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 125 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 90 15 总计 430 75 怪癖: 突破一击
column2: Yellow Jacket 以 Poland Model C 高斯步枪为核心制造。后续版本虽然安装了其他系统，但始终围绕单一重型武器构建。它的速度不如多数 VTOL，却仍快于大多数 BattleMech 和 OmniMech。远程武器、可观的速度和相对厚重的装甲让这辆载具比同类更安全。 生物群系限制：该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 125 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 90 15 总计 430 75 特性：突破一击

column1: It's lopsided boss. The idea was that you could carry troops and battle-装甲 into combat while keeping the heavily-装甲ed side facing the enemy but all that extra 装甲 amounts to it being over two tons heavier on the right side and throwing the steering all out of whack. What a stupid idea.
column2: 这台机甲左右失衡，老大。设计思路是运输部队和战斗装甲时，让重装甲侧朝向敌人；但额外装甲使右侧比左侧重了两吨多，转向也完全失常。真是个愚蠢的主意。

column1: Boss, this thing is an odd mix of primitive junk and impressive firepower, I'm not sure how to feel about it.
column2: 老大，这东西把原始的破烂和惊人的火力混在了一起，我真不知道该作何感想。

column1: With only a pair of Thunderbolt-5 launchers and a retractable blade for weapons, “Aladdin” isn’t a flashy fighter. Its Angel ECM and stealth armor give it the ability to hide in built up terrain, and thus surprise strikes are its best hope
column2: “Aladdin”只有两具 Thunderbolt-5 发射器和一把伸缩刀作为武器，算不上华丽的战士。它的 Angel ECM 和隐形装甲让它能藏在建筑密集地形中，因此突袭是它最好的希望。

column1: The D3's construction reflects its intended role as (almost) a custom design for Commanders. The 'Mech is designed for dealing punishing attacks, while retaining the survivability and speed of the original Atlas.
column2: D3 的结构体现了它几乎是为指挥官定制的设计目标。这台机甲专注于发动毁灭性攻击，同时保留原版 Atlas 的生存能力和速度。

column1: A Dark Age re设计, the Commando 9S is a long-ranged harasser. Based on the earlier 8S model, the 9S replaces the entire weapons loadout. A pair of MML-3s sit in the side torsos, supported by an arm-mounted Light PPC. Two SRM-2s provide additional firepower if an attacker closes in.
column2: 作为黑暗时代的重新设计，Commando 9S 是一台远程骚扰机。它以早期的 8S 型为基础，完全更换了武器配置：侧躯干安装两具 MML-3，手臂安装一门轻型 PPC；若敌人逼近，两具 SRM-2 可提供额外火力。

column1: Depending on the situation and the length of the engagements this 'Mech can be either a weakness or a strength since its only weapons are Streak LRMs.
column2: 根据战况和交战持续时间，这台机甲可能成为弱点，也可能成为优势，因为它唯一的武器是 Streak LRM。

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The IIC is a militarized Crosscut built with Clantech, powered by a 300-rated XL Engine and armed with an iHML in addition to the standard Chainsaw.
column2: Crosscut 是一种广受欢迎的伐木机甲，以林地作业效率和商业林业能力著称。IIC 是采用氏族技术军事化改装的 Crosscut，使用 300 额定 XL 引擎，除标准链锯外还配备一门 iHML。

column1: The Cyllaros is a fascinating concept, combining the best of both worlds with its hybrid design. It's a marvel of engineering and technology, a true testament to the ingenuity of Clan Hell's Horses. I can't wait to see what kind of modifications could be made to enhance its combat capabilities even further.
column2: Cyllaros 是一个迷人的概念，以混合设计结合了两种体系的优点。它是工程与科技的奇迹，充分体现了地狱之马氏族的创造力。我迫不及待想看看还能进行哪些改装，以进一步增强它的战斗能力。

column1: A Dark Age re设计 of the Firebee, the WI-WAM is a Militia 机甲 deployed by Cappellan planetary defense units. Built with Industrial grade components, the WI-WAM is built around a 105-rated Fuel Cell and is armed with a 雷电10 and an RL-20.
column2: 作为 Firebee 的黑暗时代重新设计，WI-WAM 是一台由卡佩兰行星防御部队部署的民兵机甲。它采用工业级部件，以 105 额定燃料电池为核心，并装备 Thunderbolt 10 和 RL-20。

column1: The "Dwarf" is a hybrid refit of the Clans' Gnome. The unique modifications of this suit took a lot of people by surprise, not only for its mobility and firepower, but also because its operators at Team Magic Mirror have consistently fielded these suits in seven-man squads.
column2: “Dwarf”是氏族 Gnome 的混合改装型。这套装备的独特改造让许多人都大吃一惊，不仅因为它的机动性和火力，还因为魔镜小队的操作员一直以七人小组编制部署这些装备。

column1: The Clans upgraded and lightened the venerable Griffin 设计 until the Battle机甲 now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. Seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous 装甲 are mounted on an Endo Steel frame, giving the Griffin IIC almost maximum 装甲 protection for its size. It is slightly faster than its antecedent, and it correspondingly mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 180 meters at a time.
column2: 氏族对老牌 Griffin 设计进行了升级和减重，最终诞生了如今的 Griffin IIC BattleMech。七吨铁纤维装甲安装在 Endo Steel 骨架上，使 Griffin IIC 在自身吨位下拥有近乎最大化的防护。它比前身略快，并配备足够的跳跃喷射器，一次可跃进 180 米。

column1: 玉鹰氏族's version of the Jade Hawk is purely Clan-spec and lacks the advanced myomers and claws of the DOA JHK-03 model, carrying four 锁定式SRM-6 launchers instead of the standard models and mounting a 轻型 主动探头 in its head. Four tons of ammo give the design excellent endurance despite the large number of launchers, while the addition of Ferro-Fibrous plating increases its protection.
column2: Jade Hawk 的这一版本完全采用氏族规格，不具备 DOA JHK-03 型的先进肌肉束和爪。它以四具改进型 SRM-6 取代标准型号，并在头部安装主动探测器。四吨弹药为大量发射器提供出色续航，铁纤维装甲也提升了防护。

column1: One of the more interesting Jenner IIC variants, it could be worth doing some field trials with it.
column2: 这是 Jenner IIC 最有趣的变体之一，值得进行一些实地测试。

column1: There is one major flaw here. Cooling. The cockpit will quickly turn into a sauna if you keep firing all weapons, so you better bring your towel.
column2: 这里有一个主要缺陷：散热。如果持续开火，驾驶舱很快会变成桑拿房，所以最好带上毛巾。

column1: An interesting upgrade to the Locust IIC focused on dealing with other Light 'Mechs. And does a damn good job at it.
column2: 这是 Locust IIC 针对其他轻型机甲的一次有趣升级，而且效果相当出色。

column1: The T variant is a hybrid missile boat configuration featuring the powerful Artemis V guidance system for its two LRM20s. An ER Large and ER Medium Laser in each arm provide additional firepower.
column2: T 型是混合导弹艇配置，两个 LRM-20 采用强大的 Artemis V 制导系统。每只手臂各有一门增程大型激光器和增程中型激光器，提供额外火力。

column1: The Rhino was 开发 by Escorpión Imperio in the thirty-second century. The unusual quad Battle机甲 was fielded by Omega Galaxy during the invasion of the Hanseatic League in 3140.
column2: Rhino 由 Escorpión Imperio 于三十二世纪开发。这台独特的四足 BattleMech 在 3140 年汉萨同盟入侵期间由 Omega Galaxy 部署。

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium Omni机甲 开发 by 氏族新星猫 to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The SHC-I is a Dark Age close quarters configuration featuring two 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, backed up by a pair of Medium ER Pulse Lasers and a pair of Streak SRM6 launchers.
column2: Shadow Cat 是一台武装强大且机动灵活的中型 OmniMech，由氏族科技打造，用于在三十一世纪初、复兴行动准备期间取代 Ice Ferret。SHC-I 是黑暗时代的近距离配置，装备两门重型激光器，辅以两门中型增程脉冲激光器和两具 Streak SRM-6。

column1: With the B configuration the Sojourner gets more of a support role, carrying an ECM suite and 2 ER Large Pulse lasers combined with a single 锁定式SRM-6. Four Jump Jets together with a Supercharger ensures the mobility of the configuration.
column2: B 型配置让 Sojourner 更偏向支援角色，携带 ECM 套件、两门增程大型脉冲激光器和一具改进型 SRM-6。四具跳跃喷射器与增压器确保了该配置的机动性。

column1: A cheaper alternative to the expensive TBT-9R, the Trebuchet TBT-9N is built around an Endo Steel skeleton, paired with an XL Gyro and a XL Engine. A pair of Clan LRM-15’s are fed by a CASE II protected magazine, while 3 Medium VSPL’s offer a heavy punch at closer ranges.
column2: 作为昂贵的 TBT-9R 的廉价替代品，Trebuchet TBT-9N 以 Endo Steel 骨架为核心，配有 XL 陀螺仪和 XL 引擎。两具氏族 LRM-15 由 CASE II 保护的弹药舱供弹，三门中型 VSPL 则能在近距离造成强力打击。

column1: One of the latest UrbanMech variants, the UM-R96 is an evolution of the -R80. It drops all the weaponry bar the 短管PPC to mount the hardened armor of the -R93 model. The standard small laser remains, although now of the X-pulse variety. This creates an incredibly tough 'Mech with minimal logistics needs, which is perfectly suited to combat in an urban environment—but nowhere else.
column2: UM-R96 是 UrbanMech 的最新变体之一，也是 -R80 的演进型。它舍弃除重型 PPC 外的全部武器，改装 -R93 型的硬化装甲。标准小型激光器仍保留，但升级为 X 脉冲型号。这造就了一台极其坚固、后勤需求极低的机甲，非常适合城市作战——但不适合其他地方。

column1: This configuration retains the ER PPC and the ER Small Pulse Lasers of the original. It replaces the autocannon with another energy weapon - a Medium Pulse Laser - and swaps out the SRM-6s, mounting a single Streak LRM-15 in each of the left and right torsos instead.
column2: 该配置保留原版的增程 PPC 和增程小型脉冲激光器。它用另一件能量武器——中型脉冲激光器——替换自动火炮，并拆除 SRM-6，改为在左右侧躯干各安装一具 Streak LRM-15。

column1: This version was created before the introduction of the PHX-HK2, in 2695. It removed the ER Large Laser, a 中型激光, and two heat sinks, replacing them with an experimental 短管PPC, 比格犬主动探头, and an additional half ton of armor.
column2: 该版本在 PHX-HK2 于 2695 年推出之前制造。它拆除了增程大型激光器、中型激光器和两组散热器，换装实验型短管 PPC、主动探测器，并增加半吨装甲。

column1: Based off of the Crab Battle机甲, the Aquagladius was a creation of the 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队, or VEST, for the Solaris VII games. 设计 specifically for usage in underwater combat, the Aquagladius featured state-of-the-art environmental sealing to ensure that the '机甲's internals were well protected from water in the event of inevitable hull breaches.
column2: 基于 Crab BattleMech，Aquagladius 是 VEST（Vining 工程与回收团队）为 Solaris VII 比赛打造的作品。Aquagladius 专为水下战斗设计，配备最先进的环境密封，确保在不可避免的船体破损时机体内部仍能受到水密保护。

column1: The 4U variant of the Albatross is a basic upgrade of the design. The 'Mech replaces the 中型激光s with a pair of ER 中型激光s. The 'Mech also replaces the LB-X Autocannon/10 with a 轻型高斯步枪. The SRM-6 launcher has also been replaced with a 锁定式SRM-6launcher.
column2: Albatross 的 4U 变体是该设计的基础升级型。机甲将中型激光器替换为两门增程中型激光器，并将 LB-X 自动火炮/10 替换为高斯步枪。SRM-6 发射器也被替换为一具 Streak SRM-6。

column1: Alt configuration P of the Arctic Wolf 全向Mech features a ER Large and ER 中型激光 in left arm and paired ER Mediums in the right arm, supported by twin 锁定式SRM-4s in the left torso and two ER Small Lasers in right torso. Two tons of Stream reloads and five extra double heat sinks keep the Arctic Wolf P in battle.
column2: Arctic Wolf OmniMech 的 P 备用配置在左臂装备增程大型激光器和增程中型激光器，右臂装备两门增程中型激光器；左侧躯干配备两具改进型 SRM-4，右侧躯干配备两门增程小型激光器。两吨 Stream 弹药和五组额外双散热器让 Arctic Wolf P 能持续作战。

column1: The -S3-DC subvariant of the -S3 replaces the two Small Lasers and two heatsinks with a Command Cockpit. The variant quickly became the main command Atlas within the Lyran forces.
column2: -S3-DC 子变体用指挥驾驶舱替换 -S3 的两门小型激光器和两组散热器。该变体很快成为莱拉军队的主力指挥 Atlas。

column1: This 'Mech is pretty storied, Boss. Black box says she served in BULLDOG and god knows what else afterwards. There's a kill-count scratched into the console here. Sixteen. The last couple look pretty fresh.
column2: 这台机甲的经历相当传奇，老大。黑匣子显示它曾在 BULLDOG 服役，之后还干过天知道多少事情。这里的控制台上刻着击杀数：十六。最后几笔看起来还很新。

column1: What ever the engineer in the Hegemony was smoking, I want some. If nothing else it'll help me destress from clearing out all these bloody rocket tube.
column2: 不知道霸权时代那个工程师抽了什么，我也想来一点。至少能帮我在清理这些该死的火箭发射管后缓解压力。

column1: The third variation is based on the original. It mounts an ER Large Laser and a pair of Heavy Medium Lasers. Three additional double heat sinks keep heat in check, while a Targeting Computer aids the accuracy of all three weapons.
column2: 第三种变体以原型为基础，装备一门增程大型激光器和两门重型中型激光器。三组额外双散热器控制热量，目标锁定计算机则提高三件武器的命中精度。

column1: The Copperhead's main weapon is a Sutel Precision Line Medium X-Pulse Laser mounted in the left arm, backed up by three torso-mounted Diverse Optics ER Medium Lasers. A single Holly Streak SRM-4 in the right arm and a head-mounted Poland Main Model C Magshot provide a nasty surprise at close range with a ton of reloads carried for each.
column2: Copperhead 的主武器是安装在左臂的 Sutel 精密线性中型 X 脉冲激光器，三门安装在躯干的 Diverse Optics 增程中型激光器提供支援。右臂的一具 Holly Streak SRM-4 和头部安装的 Poland Main Model C Magshot 能在近距离带来意外打击，每件武器都配有一吨备用弹药。

column1: Debuting during the civil war era, the 7N boasts superior firepower in the form of a Gauss Rifle in the right arm and an AC/5 in the left arm, with a traditional medium laser in the left torso and a MRM-10 launcher in place of the LRM launcher.
column2: 7N 在内战时代首次亮相，右臂的高斯步枪和左臂的 AC/5 提供强大火力；左侧躯干安装传统中型激光器，并以 MRM-10 发射器取代 LRM 发射器。

column1: There's not really much special going on here, Boss. Sure, it's an Excalibur. And sure, it's got some Star League stuff in it, but it's just a 'Mech. The cockpit does look a little cramped, I suppose — as if it was made for somebody smaller than usual.
column2: 这里没什么特别的，老大。当然，它是 Excalibur，也确实装了些星盟设备，但终究只是一台机甲。驾驶舱看起来有点拥挤，仿佛是为比常人更小的驾驶员制造的。

column1: The H is configured to take advantage of heavy lasers. Bearing a close resemblance to the prime, the Grendel H uses a Heavy Large Laser, 锁定式SRM-4, two ER 中型激光s, and a single ER Small Laser. Four additional double heat sinks strain to keep heat levels under control.
column2: H 型专为发挥重型激光器的优势而配置。它与原型相似，使用一门重型大型激光器、一具改进型 SRM-4、两门增程中型激光器和一门增程小型激光器。额外的四组双散热器勉强维持热量水平。

column1: Gotta give it to those space Roman Knock offs, they know how to utilize rockets to their full effect. This modification should let the pilot immediately finish off any target they open up.
column2: 得承认，那些太空罗马仿制品很懂得如何充分利用火箭。这项改装应该能让驾驶员立即解决任何被他们撕开防线的目标。

column1: I think I saw a Solaris match with one of these; that field artillery strapped on the right arm is a force to be reckoned with and that axe in the other arm is no slouch either.
column2: 我好像在 Solaris 看过这种机甲的比赛；右臂捆着的野战火炮很难对付，另一只手的斧头也毫不逊色。

column1: The famous 'Mech of Grace Shiro! Where did you find this one, Boss? Can I have it? Pretty please? With sugar on top?
column2: 这是 Grace Shiro 的著名机甲！老大，你从哪儿找到的？能送给我吗？求你了，再加点糖霜就更好了！

column1: The 3C is intended to spar with its enemies at long range. The 'Mech replaced the LB 20-X AC with a powerful Gauss Rifle. Additionally, the 3C removed the LRM-15 in favor of three LRM-5 launchers, giving it the same firepower but allowing it to spread it over a greater number of targets.
column2: 3C 旨在与敌人在远距离交战。它用强力高斯步枪替换 LB 20-X AC，并拆除 LRM-15，换成三具 LRM-5 发射器；火力相同，但可以分散攻击更多目标。

column1: The sales model of the Mad Cat MK II lacks many important Clan upgrades, being equipped with basic Free Inner Sphere technology and downgraded Electronics is it still a capable foe.
column2: Mad Cat MK II 的销售型号缺少许多重要的氏族升级，采用基础的自由内圈技术和降级电子设备，但仍然是一个有能力的敌人。

column1: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This Steiner variant was built to carry a Heavy Gauss Rifle.
column2: Marauder II 于 3012 年首次制造，旨在将 Marauder 的火力与突击级底盘的可靠性和坚固性结合起来。这一 Steiner 变体搭载一门重型高斯步枪。

column1: The Minotaur is the 'assault class' of the first generation ProtoMechs. Weighing more than any other ProtoMech, it trades speed for armor and weaponry. This variant utilizes an LB 2-X Autocannon with a single ton of ammunition.
column2: Minotaur 是第一代 ProtoMech 的“突击级”型号。它比任何其他 ProtoMech 都重，以装甲和武器换取速度。这一变体使用一门 LB 2-X 自动火炮，并携带一吨弹药。

column1: The IIC 4 retains two of the Large Pulse Lasers from the base variant, but adds a pair of ATM 9s, each of which can draw on two tons of ammunition. Sixteen double heat sinks are all that is needed to keep all heat from the weapons under control.
column2: IIC 4 保留基础变体的两门大型脉冲激光器，并增加两门 ATM 9，每门可使用两吨弹药。十六组双散热器足以控制全部武器产生的热量。

column1: The Satyr Proto机甲 was 设计ed to serve as a deep raider and reconnaissance unit. Offering only slightly more protection than a Harpy or Siren, the Satyr's best defense is to remain hidden from enemy units. the Satyr 3 retains the original's 装甲 protection while adding jump jets for increased mobility. The Satyr 3 is given a single Streak SRM 2 launcher.
column2: Satyr ProtoMech 旨在执行深度突袭和侦察任务。它的防护仅比 Harpy 或 Siren 略强，最佳防御是隐藏在敌方单位视线之外。Satyr 3 保留原版装甲防护，同时增加跳跃喷射器以提高机动性，并配备一具 Streak SRM-2 发射器。

column1: The STN-C is a Combine upgrade of the 3M model, with the medium laser removed in order to carry a C3 Slave Unit.
column2: STN-C 是 3M 型的联邦升级版，拆除中型激光器以安装 C3 从属单元。

column1: The 9C further modifies the 8C by removing the autocannon and a heat sink to make room for a Gauss Rifle, turning the Shootist into a support 'Mech.
column2: 9C 进一步改造 8C，拆除自动火炮和一组散热器，为高斯步枪腾出空间，使 Shootist 成为支援型机甲。

column1: The Capellans did an admirable jump on this thing; it can bring those PPCs or Plasma Rifles to bear a lot faster than most people would suspect. If you're up close and the Plasma Rifles run dry, you'll still have four ER Medium Lasers and a pair of Smal Pulse Lasers to fall back on.
column2: 卡佩兰人在这台机甲上完成了出色的跳跃改进；它能比大多数人预想得更快地让 PPC 或等离子步枪投入射击。如果你已经逼近而等离子步枪耗尽，仍可依靠四门增程中型激光器和两门小型脉冲激光器。

column1: A Capellan designed version, the 4C is a short range brawler and light mech hunter. Retaining the Endo Steel skeleton of the preceding models, a monstrous LBX/20 and a pair of SRM-6’s provide heavy short range firepower, whilst the remaining half ton of weight is devoted to additional armor.
column2: 这是卡佩兰设计的 4C，专门用于近距离格斗和猎杀轻型机甲。它保留前代型号的 Endo Steel 骨架，一门巨大的 LBX/20 和两具 SRM-6 提供强劲近距离火力，剩余半吨重量则用于增加装甲。

column1: A commander's configuration, this variation carries a C3 Master Computer to coordinate fire. To protect itself from hostile electronic systems, it carries a 守护者ECM Suite. Offensively it carries a pair of 中型脉冲激光s, twin Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-15s, and an ER PPC. A Small Laser has also been included.
column2: 这是指挥官配置，携带 C3 主计算机用于协调火力。为保护自身免受敌方电子系统干扰，它配备 Guardian ECM 套件。进攻方面，它装备两门中型脉冲激光器、两具经 Artemis IV 增强的 LRM-15 和一门增程 PPC，另有一门小型激光器。

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. This is a fire-support variant equipped with an LRM-3 launcher a pair of ER Micro Lasers and an ER Small Laser.
column2: Triton 由 Goliath Scorpion 氏族为其搜索者设计。这是一个火力支援变体，配备一具 LRM-3 发射器、两门增程微型激光器和一门增程小型激光器。

column1: A BattleMech Mace is nothing to take lightly but when you combine one with Triple-Strength Myomer on a 'Mech as fast as the Valkyrie II-HLD, you should pay extra attention. 'Hildr' here has been a terror in the Solaris arenas, leaving many opponents crushed with that mace or slagged with the Snub-Nosed PPC in the left hand.
column2: BattleMech 级别的狼牙棒绝不能轻视；当它与三重强度肌肉束结合，并安装在像 Valkyrie II-HLD 这样快速的机甲上时，更应格外小心。这里的“Hildr”曾在 Solaris 竞技场上令人闻风丧胆：许多对手被狼牙棒砸碎，或被左手的短管 PPC 熔成残渣。

column1: A Wolverine that does not have Jump Jets is quite unusual, not sure how to feel about that.
column2: 没有跳跃喷射器的 Wolverine 非常不寻常，我真不知道该怎么评价。

column1: In a bid to join the Arms Race of Inner Sphere 全向Mech Designs, Hellespont reacted with an attempt to upgrade their most iconic salespiece, the UrbanMech. Dubbed the 'Mobile 炮塔', it does what every 'Urbie' has done before. Sadly, the increased cost and expertise required for maintenance, left it mostly unsold.
column2: 为了加入内圈全向机甲设计的军备竞赛，赫勒斯庞特试图升级其最具标志性的产品：城市机甲。这款机甲被称为“移动炮塔”，依旧在做每一台“垃圾桶”曾经做过的事。可惜，维护所需的高昂成本和专业技术让它几乎无人问津。

column1: A complete rebuild of the R25, this new chassis draws inspiration from the RetroTech designs flooding the periphery arm’s markets. Built with a mixture of periphery and advanced tech, the center piece of this mech are the heavy rocket launchers that enable this mech to go toe to toe with foes, many times it’s weight class. It’s relatively high cost and limited production, has so far kept it confined to the more advanced periphery nations.
column2: 这是对R25的一次彻底重建，新底盘的灵感来自席卷边疆市场的复古科技设计。它融合了边疆与先进技术，机体核心是重型火箭发射器，使这台机甲能够与数倍于自身重量级别的敌人正面交锋。较高的成本和有限的产量，至今让它只能在技术更先进的边疆国家服役。

column1: This adorable Trashcan was refit to be used for Agrarian work and self defense on the Deep Periphery.
column2: 这只可爱的“垃圾桶”经过改装，用于边疆深处的农耕工作和自卫。

column1: Yet another typical Urbie, this variant sports a not too uncommon refit for planetary militias, replacing the AC10 with a Mortar.
column2: 又一台典型的垃圾桶。这一型号采用了行星民兵并不罕见的改装方案，以一门迫击炮替换了AC/10。

column1: An unusual Urbanmech, the UM-R62 trades fire power for range. The removal of the standard weapons systems allows for the installation of an AC/2 and a PPC, inverting the usual Urbanmech load out. Deployed as a fire support and AA mech alongside infantry and armor units, the UM-R62’s range more than makes up for its slow speed and lack of heavy firepower.
column2: 一台不同寻常的城市机甲，UM-R62以火力换取射程。移除标准武器系统后，它得以安装AC/2和PPC，完全颠覆了城市机甲常见的武器配置。UM-R62与步兵和装甲部队协同，作为火力支援和防空机甲部署；它的射程足以弥补速度缓慢和重火力不足的缺陷。

column1: They weren't kidding about welding every spare scrap of metal on this thing. I can fix it up as is, but there's almost nothing I can swap out without compromising the structure.
column2: 他们说把所有能找到的废金属都焊到这东西上，看来一点也没夸张。我可以按现状把它修好，但几乎没有任何部件能在不破坏结构的情况下更换。

column1: A Sobek that one of those crazy pirate bands found and heavily modified, adding their crazy contraptions everywhere. I don't know what to tell you, Boss, I have no idea how bad it will do in a real battle.
column2: 这是某支疯狂海盗团找到并大幅改装的索贝克，到处都加装了他们那些疯狂的装置。老板，我真不知道该怎么说；它在真正的战斗中会糟到什么程度，我完全无法判断。

column1: The L005 variant changes the basic loadout of the Quad机甲 to be more support focused. Two Delta LRM-20 launchers, an experimental Huge Pulse Laser and a 长 Tom 火炮加农炮; all allowing long range support and makes any attempts to approach the 机甲's defensive position quite rough. A 作战套件 even provides electronic warfare capabilities. 怪癖: Reinforced 结构 掉落成本乘数: 1.44
column2: L005型改变了四足机甲的基础配置，使其更偏向支援。两具Delta LRM-20发射器、一门实验型巨型脉冲激光，以及一门长吨级火炮加农炮，都能提供远程支援，让任何试图接近这台机甲防御阵地的行动变得极其困难。一套作战套件还赋予它电子战能力。 怪癖：强化结构 掉落成本乘数：1.44

column1: Manufactured in small numbers by Skobel 机甲Works from their facilities in the Russia region of Terra prior, the Omega represented the first truly viable superheavy Battle机甲 设计 to appear on the battlefield. Although the Omega was a prototype, almost thirty of the huge '机甲s were 生产 by Skobel prior to the Superheavy manufacturing wing of their Russian facility being destroyed. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.32
column2: 欧米茄由斯科贝尔机甲工厂在早期泰拉俄罗斯地区的设施少量制造，是战场上第一种真正可行的超重型战斗机甲设计。虽然欧米茄只是原型机，但在其俄罗斯设施的超重型制造部门被摧毁前，斯科贝尔仍生产了近三十台这种巨型机甲。 怪癖：扰乱 掉落成本乘数：1.32

column1: The -5M is 设计ed to be a support force, using its 变色龙偏振护盾 to protect its whereabouts before delivering a long range strike. The combination of an Arrow IV launcher and a 重击者火炮 means the '机甲 can handle most support assignments, and two LRM-20 launchers provide more accurate firepower as needed. Two small mortars are used to deploy smoke as needed on the battlefield. The Serket 5M's major flaw is it lack of speed, it only brings a 275 engine core meaning almost any foe can easily catch it once detected. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.32
column2: -5M型被设计为支援单位，利用变色龙偏振护盾隐藏自身位置，然后发动远程打击。箭IV发射器与重击者火炮的组合，使这台机甲能够承担大多数支援任务；两具LRM-20发射器则在需要时提供更精准的火力。两门小型迫击炮用于在战场上按需布置烟幕。Serket 5M的主要缺陷是速度不足，它只有275级引擎核心，一旦暴露，几乎任何敌人都能轻易追上。 怪癖：多重追踪 掉落成本乘数：1.32

column1: The Gulltoppr OmniMonitor is a thirty-second century superheavy OmniVehicle. It was first 生产 for the Lyran Commonwealth and Clan Wolf-in-Exile as a defensive garrison unit. The Gulltoppr was 设计ed and manufactured by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal in 3102, the unit was mass 生产 to help fill up worlds on the Clan border. Gulltoppr are mammoth machines that are noted for their impressive firepower and 装甲, but their slow speeds keeps them from being anything more than a defensive combat unit. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. 装甲: Hardened 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 460 133 左侧 365 133 右侧 365 133 后方 280 133 炮塔 290 133 总计 1760 665 怪癖: 作战电脑B2000 Omni 车辆
column2: Gulltoppr全向监视车是三十二世纪的超重型全向载具。它最初为莱拉联盟和流亡狼氏族生产，作为防御驻军单位。3102年，Gulltoppr由流亡狼氏族在阿克皇家设计并制造；随后大量生产，用于填补氏族边境各个世界的防务空缺。Gulltoppr是以惊人火力和装甲著称的巨型机器，但缓慢的速度使它只能承担防御作战任务。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3格 / 60/90米。 装甲：强化装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 460 133 左侧 365 133 右侧 365 133 后方 280 133 炮塔 290 133 总计 1760 665 怪癖：B2000作战电脑 全向载具

column1: Originally 生产 by Blue Shot Weapons, the Lynx was 设计ed as a striker mech, with a 设计 that blended speed, 装甲 and firepower into a fearsome package. Built around a 275-rated XL Engine, the Lynx LNX-9M is armed with an Enhanced ERPPC and a pair of 改进的 Large Lasers.

\n怪癖: Multi Trac

\n<color=#FFEF00>Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper</color>
column2: 山猫最初由蓝光武器公司生产，被设计为突击机甲，以速度、装甲和火力融合而成的可怕组合为特色。LNX-9M型山猫以275级XL引擎为核心，装备一门强化ER PPC和两门改进型大型激光。

column1: This thing may be a bit slow, boss, but those AC20s with Ares TPS are going to really hurt anything in range.
column2: 这东西可能有点慢，老板，但那两门装有阿瑞斯TPS的AC/20足以重创射程内的任何目标。

column1: While this thing doesn't have the tube count of other Stalkers, I wouldn't discredit the punch those larger missiles dish out.
column2: 虽然这东西的发射管数量不如其他“潜行者”，但那些大型导弹的打击力绝不能小看。

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of fire power and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox Z is armed with a Large Supra Laser and an ER Small Laser. A pair of Laser AMS, a Streak Narc and a TAG round out the Society variant.
column2: 30吨级的轻型氏族全向机甲Kit Fox由云蛇氏族于2890年推出。它更重视火力与装甲的结合，而非速度；机体由180级XL引擎驱动，并采用内骨骼钢和铁纤维装甲混合结构，提供16吨吊舱空间。Kit Fox Z型装备一门大型超脉冲激光和一门ER小型激光；两套激光AMS、一具Streak NARC和一具TAG构成了社会氏族改型的完整配置。

column1: The 步枪手IIC S is a Society refit 设计ed to provide direct fire support for Society mech formations. The Z variant sports a Light Ultra Gauss Rifle and a Large Supra Laser in each arm, providing a frightening amount of firepower at range, and a suite of improved electonics including a Nova CEWS.
column2: 步枪手IIC S型是社会氏族为其机甲编队提供直接火力支援而设计的改装型号。Z型在每条手臂上各装备一支轻型超高斯步枪和一门大型超脉冲激光，能够在远距离倾泻令人胆寒的火力；同时配备包括Nova CEWS在内的一整套改进电子设备。

column1: Assassin II 源于联邦太阳提出的“快速突袭骚扰单位”需求。Maltex Corporation 对老款 Assassin 底盘进行了大幅重新设计，成品机甲超出所有预期，如今已开始用于对抗联邦制采用的隐形技术。 Quirk: 集成TSM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Assassin II源于联邦太阳提出的“快速突袭骚扰单位”需求。Maltex Corporation对老款Assassin底盘进行了大幅重新设计，成品机甲超出所有预期，如今已开始用于对抗联邦制采用的隐形技术。 怪癖：集成TSM 掉落成本乘数：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Named for an ancient God of the Forges, taming the Fires of Olympus, does this 全向Mech design do its ancestor, the venerable Warhammer, proud. Built with a specialized 热抗型装甲 is it able to withstand incoming heat damage from its opponents. 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 这款全向机甲以锻造之神、驯服奥林匹斯之火的古老神祇命名；它没有辜负祖先般的传奇战锤。机体采用特制热抗型装甲，能够承受敌方造成的热量伤害。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
