column2: Assassin II源于联邦太阳提出的“快速突袭骚扰单位”需求。Maltex Corporation对老款Assassin底盘进行了大幅重新设计，成品机甲超出所有预期，如今已开始用于对抗联邦制采用的隐形技术。 怪癖：集成TSM 掉落成本乘数：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Akuma is a experimental Assassin II with specialized targeting systems designed to destroy the equilibrium of a targets Gyro.
column2: Akuma是一台实验型Assassin II，配备专门的瞄准系统，旨在破坏目标的陀螺仪平衡。

column1: A experimental rebuild of the clan Behemoth/Stone Rhino, this variant is 设计ed around a experimental engine that frees up enough space in the center torso to make full use of its spinal mounted 炮塔 System.
column2: 这是氏族Behemoth/Stone Rhino的一次实验性重建型号，围绕一台实验引擎设计；该引擎释放了足够的中央躯干空间，使其能够充分利用脊柱安装的炮塔系统。

column1: Well Boss, a lot of effort has gone into making this thing more or less unstoppable. I once saw a mech like this in a Solaris game. I'll never forget the expression on the opposing pilot's face when she blew off both side torsos and it just kept shooting.
column2: 老板，为了让这东西几乎无法被阻止，他们投入了大量精力。我曾在Solaris的一场比赛中见过类似的机甲。对方驾驶员打掉它两侧躯干后，它仍然继续开火；她脸上的表情我永远忘不了。

column1: Apparently Built on Kookens Pleasure Pit, this Abomination DOES NOT come into my 机甲bay without Additional Pay. Some of the Parts arent even properly set on the Chassis. Those Goddamn Armour plates could fall off any Momen. No, I do not Care what Darius says, its a Liability Boss.
column2: 据说这东西是在库肯的欢乐坑里拼出来的。这台畸形物要进我的机甲舱，得先额外付钱。有些部件甚至没有正确固定在底盘上，那些该死的装甲板随时可能掉下来。不，我不在乎Darius怎么说；老板，这就是个累赘。

column1: This 'Commando' was found in a Deep Periphery Weapons Cache, named after the Furies of Terran Mythology, it packs a surprisingly mean punch for it's size.
column2: 这台“突击队”是在边疆深处的武器库中发现的。它以泰拉神话中的复仇女神命名，以这样的体型而言，火力强得出人意料。

column1: Well, congratulations, Amaris. You built a Rifleman. I really hope that this is a custom job by some merc company or something. This is just kind of ridiculous, if you ask me. Look - somebody's even stenciled the name on the side here: "Rattler".
column2: 恭喜你，Amaris，你造出了一台步枪手。我真希望这只是某个佣兵公司的定制改装之类的东西。依我看，这实在荒唐。看——有人甚至把名字喷在了侧面：“响尾蛇”。

column1: The personal Fafnir of Peter Steiner Davion, equipped with a special 3-Pack RL 20 system in both Arms.
column2: 这是Peter Steiner Davion的私人Fafnir，双臂各装备一套特殊的3联装RL-20系统。

column1: A Gnat actually 设计ed for Solaris Combat, but never made it into the Sands of said Arena, This Gnat was supposed to Outlast the Enemy in every Way. Only Equipped with Low amounts of Weaponry, and the Armour Slowing it down, it might seem like a Slow Opponent. Do not be Overconfident, this Gnat is hard to Pick off.
column2: 这是一台真正为Solaris战斗设计的Gnat，但最终没能登上那座竞技场的沙场。它原本计划在各个方面拖垮敌人。虽然武器数量不多，装甲又拖慢了速度，看起来似乎是个缓慢的对手，但千万别大意：这只Gnat很难被击落。

column1: Well, boss, the strangest thing amongst this is the Big Steel on his arm. Big Steel on his arrrrmmmm...
column2: 老板，这东西最奇怪的地方就是它手臂上的那块大钢铁。大钢铁在它的手臂上……它的手臂上……

column1: Is that Bean!? From "Locust-1VBean"?! Commander, I watch th— I, uh, I mean. I used to watch that show all the time as a kid! Everybody loves Bean!
column2: 那是Bean吗！？来自“Locust-1VBean”的Bean！？指挥官，我看过——呃，我是说，我小时候经常看那个节目！人人都喜欢Bean！

column1: This custom Mad Cat MkII is the personal ride of IlKhan Morphyum Kerensky, made infamous when he 'accidentally' fragged an allied Battle机甲 because he 'needed a hole to shoot the enemy through'. As could be imagined, the Lady Killer is an Autocannon specialist.
column2: 这台定制Mad Cat MkII是伊尔汗Morphyum Kerensky的座驾。它因“意外”击毁一台友军战斗机甲而臭名昭著——因为他说自己“需要一个能向敌人开火的洞”。不难想象，“Lady Killer”是一台专精自动加农炮的机甲。

column1: MAD-ness! This Marauder Variant was exclusively 设计ed for the Deadly Sins stable on Solaris VII and has specialized support systems for Gauss & PPC Weapons. Hitting like an angry God.
column2: 疯狂吧！这台Marauder改型专为Solaris VII上的“七宗罪”马厩设计，配备了高斯和PPC武器的专用支援系统。它的打击力如同愤怒的神明。

column1: This 'Panther' has all kinds of weird scribbles on it. They seem to be praising something called 'The Book of the Dead' and 'Naturom Demonto.' I just have to assume whatever idiot got their hands on it was stuck in some Cabin too long.
column2: 这台“猎豹”上到处都是奇怪的潦草字迹，似乎在赞美某种叫作《亡灵之书》和“Naturom Demonto”的东西。我只能假设，拿到它的那个白痴在某间小屋里待得太久了。

column1: The Patton-SB's weapons are 设计ed to take advantage of the hazards of vacuum combat by spreading out their damage to maximize the chances of a breach. Its 银弹高斯 rifle, combined with a Holly five-tube LRM launcher combine hull breach seeking ordinance and long range firepower in an attractive package; both with plenty of ammunition. Two 多元光学 lasers serve as the 坦克's secondary weapons and deter close assault. The Patton 坦克 is a 65-ton 装甲ed combat 车辆, specializing in conventional 装甲ed warfare. Identical to its twin, the Rommel, in every way but armament and 装甲 configuration, the Patton has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after General George S. Patton, Jr., a legendary commander of 装甲ed and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 环境密封 Values A S 前方 300 35 左侧 260 35 右侧 260 35 后方 200 35 炮塔 270 35 总计 1290 175 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: Patton-SB的武器经过设计，可利用真空作战环境，将伤害分散以最大限度提高击穿概率。银弹高斯步枪与Holly五管LRM发射器结合，既能发射追踪舱体破坏点的弹药，又能提供远程火力，而且弹药储备充足。两门多元光学激光作为坦克的副武器，用于阻止近距离突击。Patton坦克是一种65吨级装甲战斗车辆，专精于常规装甲战。除武器和装甲配置外，它与姊妹型号Rommel完全相同，主要服役于莱拉联盟和莱拉联邦。它以乔治·S·巴顿将军命名，这位传奇指挥官因在泰拉第二次世界大战期间指挥装甲与机械化部队而闻名。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6格 / 120/180米。 装甲：重型铁纤维装甲 结构：环境密封 数值 A S 前方 300 35 左侧 260 35 右侧 260 35 后方 200 35 炮塔 270 35 总计 1290 175 怪癖：主战坦克

column1: The SM Tank Destroyer was 设计ed as a speedy infighter by scientists from 氏族新星猫. The machine is a cheap and effective combat 车辆. The 车辆 has unique 'glass' dual cockpits on the front of the 车辆 that are functionally identical while mounting a smaller anti-infantry turret just behind its left side cockpit. The 车辆's unique split cockpit 设计 allows the cockpit modules to eject from the 车辆. Due to its appearance, the SM1 was dubbed the 'Suicide Machine' by its first pilots because they felt overexposed with the 坦克's all ferro-glass cockpit. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 235 25 左侧 150 25 右侧 150 25 后方 120 25 炮塔 150 25 总计 805 125 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons
column2: SM坦克歼击车由氏族新星猫的科学家设计为高速近战车辆。这台机器廉价而高效。车辆前部拥有独特的“玻璃”双驾驶舱，功能完全相同；左侧驾驶舱后方还安装了一座较小的反步兵炮塔。独特的分离式驾驶舱设计允许驾驶舱模块从车辆中弹射。由于外形特殊，首批驾驶员称SM1为“自杀机器”，因为全铁纤维玻璃驾驶舱让他们感觉暴露无遗。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12格 / 240/360米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 235 25 左侧 150 25 右侧 150 25 后方 120 25 炮塔 150 25 总计 805 125 怪癖：稳定武器

column1: The 黄蜂 was built around the Poland Model C Gauss rifle. Subsequent version mounted other system, but it remained centered around as single heavy weapon. Though not as fast as most VTOLs, the 黄蜂 still has greater speed than most Battle机甲s and Omni机甲s. The long range weapons, respectable speed and relatively heavy 装甲 keep the 车辆 safer than many of it's peers. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 140 15 左侧 85 15 右侧 85 15 后方 60 15 总计 385 75 怪癖: 突破一击
column2: 黄蜂围绕波兰C型高斯步枪建造。后续版本安装了其他系统，但始终以单一重型武器为核心。虽然速度不及大多数垂直起降机，黄蜂仍比大多数战斗机甲和全向机甲更快。远程武器、可靠的速度和相对厚重的装甲让这辆车辆比同类更安全。 生物群系限制：该单位因使用ICE无法部署在月球生物群系。 移动：7/11格 / 210/330米。 装甲：重型铁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 140 15 左侧 85 15 右侧 85 15 后方 60 15 总计 385 75 怪癖：突破一击

column1: Well it is fast, and tough, but it lacks punch unless you are fighting the lightest of opponents.
column2: 它速度快、也很坚固，但除非对手是最轻型的单位，否则火力并不够强。

column1: The personal BattleMech of Colonel Isolde Centrella of the Magistracy Armed Forces. Chosen especially for its strengths as a command 'Mech for her squad of lighter scouting 'Mechs.
column2: 这是治安军上校Isolde Centrella的私人战斗机甲，专门看中它作为轻型侦察机甲小队指挥机甲的优势。

column1: The T configuration carries an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor in each arm. An extra double heat sink is in the left and right torso, but to handle heavy heat loads the right torso carries a triple Coolant Pod.
column2: T型在每条手臂上各装备一门ER PPC和一个PPC电容器。左右躯干各增加一枚双重散热器；为了处理巨大的热负荷，右侧躯干还安装了三重冷却舱。

column1: The -12S builds upon the endo-steel chassis of prior models, upgrading it with a home-built Clan-grade engine and lasers. The weight savings enabled Defiance’s engineers to follow the weaponry layout of the -3S. Armor levels match the toughest Banshees, creating a very strong and fast assault ’Mech, albeit one with a challenging heat curve. Alpha-striking will shut the ’Mech down, so MechWarriors are advised to use either the main or secondary weapons, but not both at once.
column2: -12S型以旧型号的内骨骼钢底盘为基础，升级为自制的氏族级引擎和激光器。减重后，Defiance工程师得以采用-3S型的武器布局。装甲水平足以匹敌最坚固的Banshee，造就了一台强悍而迅捷的突击机甲，但散热曲线相当棘手。全弹齐射会令机甲停机，因此建议机甲战士在主武器和副武器之间择一使用，不要同时开火。

column1: Commander, have you seen the latest refit for the Boreas? It's the R variant, also known as the Amirault, and let me tell you, I am impressed! The frame is made of Endo Steel, which means it's lighter and more maneuverable, and the weapons have been replaced with a Bunch LRM 15 launchers n a couple Clan ER Medium Lasers. Can you imagine the kind of firepower this mech can unleash? I can't wait to see this baby in action!
column2: 指挥官，你看过Boreas最新的改装吗？这是R型，也叫Amirault。我得说，真让我印象深刻！框架采用内骨骼钢，因此更轻、更灵活；武器则换成一大堆LRM-15发射器和几门氏族ER中型激光。想象一下这台机甲能倾泻出什么样的火力吧？我迫不及待想看它投入战斗！

column1: Designed in secrecy, the Centaur is a Heavy-weight battle armor, first designed for the Republic of the Sphere's armed forces during the later Dark Age era. This was part of an effort by the Republic to develop a highly mobile battle armor-scale artillery piece. It was first built on Devil's Rock at the highly secretive Rhodes Foundry Ltd. factory, along with other secret projects. The battle armor first entered production in 3136 along with the Simian battle armor, and they would often be teamed up in the years ahead.
column2: 半人马是在秘密中设计的重型战斗装甲，最初为黑暗时代后期的球体共和国武装部队研制。这是共和国开发高机动战斗装甲级火炮的一部分工作。它最初与其他秘密项目一起，在高度保密的Rhodes铸造有限公司工厂、恶魔之岩上制造。战斗装甲于3136年与Simian战斗装甲一同投产，之后多年经常配合作战。

column1: Designed as a successor to the Wolverine, the Conjurer is a 50-ton Mech seen in Clan Second Line formations. Powered by a 250-rated XL Engine, the Conjurer CJR-8 mounts 5 Jump jets and MASC. An Inner Sphere RAC/5 makes up the bulk of the CJR-8’s weapons, with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 for close combat.
column2: 咒术师是作为Wolverine的继任者设计的50吨级机甲，常见于氏族二线编队。CJR-8由250级XL引擎驱动，安装5具跳跃喷射器和MASC。内圈RAC/5构成主要武器，近战则配备两门中型脉冲激光和一具Streak SRM-6。

column1: Even if this configuration favours short range engagements and even enables melee, I don't think I would ever use it. A Crossbow chassis is just not made for that kind of engagements. But somehow clan Jade Falcon makes it work.
column2: 即使这个配置偏向短程交战，甚至能够进行近战，我也不认为自己会使用它。Crossbow底盘根本不是为这种战斗设计的。但不知怎么，玉龙鹰氏族让它发挥了作用。

column1: Artemis IV LRM 15s, Extended Range Pulse Lasers, Streak SRM launchers! What is there not to like here? Can I have one, Boss? Just for research purposes of course, I would never use it to terrorize the local wildlife for fun on the next planet we arrive at.
column2: Artemis IV LRM-15、增程脉冲激光、Streak SRM发射器！这里有什么不喜欢的？老板，我能要一台吗？当然只是出于研究目的；下一个星球上我绝不会拿它去吓唬当地野生动物取乐。

column1: A 28th century 设计 that first saw production in 3058, the Dragon Fire is a 75-ton mech 设计ed for brawling. The DRG-4/6N is armed with a Gauss Rifle and an LB-10X, with an ER Large Laser and a pair of ER 中型激光s as secondary weapons. A 300-rated XL Engine, Light Ferro-Fibrous and an Endo Steel Skeleton provide the weight needed for the heavy payload, while CASE and 守护者ECM add to the 设计s survivability. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 龙火是28世纪设计、于3058年首次投产的75吨级近战机甲。DRG-4/6N装备一支高斯步枪和一门LB-10X，副武器为一门ER大型激光和两门ER中型激光。300级XL引擎、轻型铁纤维装甲和内骨骼钢骨架提供重型载荷所需的减重空间，CASE与守护者ECM则提高了设计的生存能力。 怪癖：易于维护 掉落成本乘数：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂、右侧上臂

column1: A RISC refit of the standard Emperor, using Clan-tech heat sinks, electronics and XL engines, this redesign also replaces the arm-mounted weaponry with a pair of RISC's experimental Hyper Lasers and coats its exterior with the advanced Void-signature mimetic plating.
column2: 这是标准Emperor的RISC改装型，采用氏族技术散热器、电子设备和XL引擎；同时以两门RISC实验型超能激光替换手臂武器，并在外部覆盖先进的虚空特征仿生装甲板。

column1: Originating after the 17th battle of Hesperus II, the Fafnir II is the 设计ation given to a limited production run of custom Fafnir's created with battlefield salvage. Built by 迪法恩斯工业, the 100 ton Fafnir II FNR2-5-C is powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core and protected by 21 tons of Ferro-Lamellor 装甲. A pair of LB-20Xs form the primary armament supported by a quad of Medium Re-Engineered Lasers and a 中型脉冲激光. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Fafnir II源自Hesperus II第17次战役之后，是利用战场残骸打造的一批定制Fafnir的称呼，产量有限。由迪法恩斯工业制造的100吨级Fafnir II FNR2-5-C采用300级聚变核心驱动，并由21吨铁层叠装甲保护。两门LB-20X构成主武装，辅以四门中型重构激光和一门中型脉冲激光。 怪癖：稳定武器 掉落成本乘数：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂、右侧上臂

column1: The Firestorm was created by a combined group of Spina Khanate and Wolf Empire warriors and technicians. Based on a new OmniMech derived from the Shadow Cat, this long term project wasn't ready for production; however, a BattleMech could be developed from a planned configuration, thus laying the groundwork for the Firestorm. With this in mind, the Clan Wolf warriors favored a weapons suite focused on incendiary operations. This allowed the Wolf touman to rapidly expand its second line and garrison forces without incurring the cost of expensive OmniMechs.
column2: Firestorm由斯皮纳汗国和狼帝国的战士与技术人员联合制造。它以Shadow Cat衍生的新型全向机甲为基础；这个长期项目尚未达到量产条件，但可以根据预定配置开发战斗机甲，从而奠定Firestorm的基础。狼氏族战士据此选择了专注燃烧作战的武器套件，使狼氏族能够迅速扩充二线和驻军部队，而不必承担昂贵全向机甲的成本。

column1: With the markets again hungry for cutting-edge Battle机甲s after the collapse of the Republic, 迪法恩斯工业 once more updated the classic '机甲 with a full suite of its Clan equivalent weaponry. This new Flashman FLS-10E was 开发 to survive against any foe of equal weight, Spheroid or Clan. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 共和国崩溃后，市场再次渴求尖端战斗机甲；迪法恩斯工业于是为经典机甲全面换装氏族同级武器。新的Flashman FLS-10E旨在对抗任何同重量级的敌人，无论是球体还是氏族。 怪癖：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂、右侧上臂

column1: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike 'Mech that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the 球体共和国. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A 比格犬主动探头 allows the Ghost to find enemy units, while 隐身装甲 and a 守护者ECM Suite allows the 'Mech to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins. Another variant introduced in 3133 removes the SRM-6 rack from the standard Dark Age Ghost and replaces it with a Chainsaw to minimize logistical needs, or potentially to disguise it as an IndustrialMech.
column2: Ghost是在圣战后期作为Griffin的补充开发的中型突击机甲，在球体共和国成立后的多年间得到广泛使用。它由莱拉联邦与前自由世界联盟的人员共同开发，携带大量电子战设备投入战斗。比格犬主动探头帮助Ghost发现敌方单位，隐身装甲和守护者ECM套件则让这台机甲名副其实。优秀的陆地速度与强大的中程武器使Ghost非常适合猎杀和重型袭击任务，尤其适合与Griffin搭配。3133年推出的另一种改型移除了黑暗时代Ghost的SRM-6架，换装链锯，以降低后勤需求，也可能是为了伪装成工业机甲。

column1: The Götterdämmerung is a Heavy class BattleMech first fielded by the Lyran Commonwealth in 3138, the 'Mech's German name translates to twilight of the gods or ragnarök.
column2: Götterdämmerung是莱拉联邦于3138年首次投入使用的重型战斗机甲；其德语名称意为“诸神黄昏”。

column1: Manufactured by Jalastar Aerospace from their plant on Panpour, the Gunsmith entered service shortly before the Blackout. Armed with 4 medium X-Pulses lasers,the Gunsmith quickly earned a fearsome reputation as a pursuit Battle机甲 and raider.
column2: Gunsmith由Jalastar航空航天公司在Panpour的工厂制造，在黑幕事件前不久投入服役。装备4门中型X脉冲激光后，Gunsmith很快因作为追击型战斗机甲和突袭者的可怕名声而闻名。

column1: The Gùn is a moderately fast light OmniMech which was designed by the Capellan Confederation as an Infantry Support 'Mech. Rebuilding several 'liberated' chassis from border conflicts was this upgraded with a more formidable engine and Stealth systems to infiltrate deep into Capellan Territory.
column2: Gùn是一种速度适中的轻型全向机甲，由卡佩兰联邦设计为步兵支援机甲。它利用边境冲突中缴获的多具底盘重建而成，并升级了更强的引擎和隐身系统，以便深入卡佩兰领土执行渗透任务。

column1: Commander, the Harpagos is a heavy Battle机甲 开发 by 氏族地狱马. It's armed with two Gauss rifles, capable of dealing massive amounts of damage to its targets from long range. However, due to its lack of jump jets, it's not as mobile as some other Battle机甲s. It has a top speed of 64 km/h, which is decent for its weight class. Its heavy 装甲 and firepower make it a great choice for a front-line combat unit.
column2: 指挥官，Harpagos是由氏族地狱马开发的重型战斗机甲。它装备两支高斯步枪，能够从远距离对目标造成巨大伤害。但由于没有跳跃喷射器，它的机动性不如一些其他战斗机甲。最高速度为64公里/小时，对于这一重量级来说相当不错。厚重的装甲和火力使它非常适合作为前线作战单位。

column1: A 65-ton design that emphasizes overwhelming firepower over speed or armor, the Hellbringer is a Clan 全向Mech. Powered by a 325-rated XL Engine, the Hellbringer has 28.5 tons of pod space. The Hellbringer T is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s and an ATM-6. 3 ER 中型激光s and a pair of AP Gauss Rifles cover close range combat. AMS protects the Hellbringer T from missiles while CASE II protects the munitions bay. 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Hellbringer是65吨级氏族全向机甲，强调压倒性火力而非速度或装甲。它由325级XL引擎驱动，拥有28.5吨吊舱空间。Hellbringer T型装备两门ER PPC和一具ATM-6；三门ER中型激光和两支AP高斯步枪负责近距离作战。AMS保护Hellbringer T免受导弹攻击，CASE II则保护弹药舱。 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An 全向Mech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous armor giving the 全向Mech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman F is armed with an Improved Heavy Large Laser and a pair of Artemis V enhanced LRM-15’s. A pair of ER 中型激光s provide additional firepower at close range. A 瞄准计算机 enhances the weapons accuracy.
column2: Huntsman是氏族新星猫设计的50吨级机甲，用于复兴行动和入侵内圈，于3049年首次投产。这是一台全向机甲，以250级XL引擎为核心，采用内骨骼钢骨架和铁纤维装甲，为其提供21.5吨吊舱空间。底盘固定安装5具跳跃喷射器，提升了灵活性。Huntsman F型装备一门改进型重型大型激光和两具配备Artemis V的增强型LRM-15；两门ER中型激光提供近距离火力。瞄准计算机提高武器精度。

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An OmniMech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous armor giving the OmniMech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman T is armed with a UAC/2 and a pair of Streak LRM-5’s. 4 Improved Heavy 中型激光s, a ER Small Laser, a 微型 Pulse Laser, a 锁定式SRM-6 and a Flamer provide additional firepower at close range. Laser AMS improves the Huntsmans defensive capabilities while a 瞄准计算机 enhances the accuracy of Mechs weapons.
column2: Huntsman是氏族新星猫设计的50吨级机甲，用于复兴行动和入侵内圈，于3049年首次投产。这是一台全向机甲，以250级XL引擎为核心，采用内骨骼钢骨架和铁纤维装甲，为其提供21.5吨吊舱空间。底盘固定安装5具跳跃喷射器，提升了灵活性。Huntsman T型装备一门UAC/2和两具Streak LRM-5；4门改进型重型中型激光、一门ER小型激光、一门微型脉冲激光、一具锁定式SRM-6和一具火焰喷射器提供近距离火力。激光AMS增强防御能力，瞄准计算机则提高武器精度。

column1: First 生产 in 2948, the Ice Ferret is a medium scout Omni机甲 often employed as a head hunter or strike unit. A 45 ton Clan Omni机甲, the Ice Ferret is powered by a 360-rated XL Engine and has 9.5 tons of pod space thanks to a combination of Endo Steel, an XL Engine and Ferro-Fibrous. The Ice Ferret IFR-T is armed with an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser, an ER 中型激光 and an SRM-4. An 主动探头 improves the Ice Ferrets scout capabilities and a Supercharger boosts its speed.
column2: 冰雪雪貂于2948年首次投产，是一种常被用作猎头或突击单位的中型侦察全向机甲。作为45吨级氏族全向机甲，它由360级XL引擎驱动，内骨骼钢、XL引擎与铁纤维装甲的组合为其提供9.5吨吊舱空间。Ice Ferret IFR-T型装备一门改进型重型大型激光、一门ER中型激光和一具SRM-4。主动探头提升侦察能力，增压器则提高速度。

column1: The final Clan version is based off the Jade Hawk 2, dropping the Ferro-Fibrous plating and shaving the armor levels to restore the standard Jade Hawks jump-jets and upgrade two of the arm-mounted lasers to Medium Pulse versions instead of the ER Large models.
column2: 最终的氏族版本以Jade Hawk 2为基础，取消铁纤维装甲并削减装甲等级，以恢复标准Jade Hawk的跳跃喷射器；同时将两门手臂激光升级为中型脉冲型号，替代ER大型激光。

column1: A Dark Age re设计 of the King Crab, the KGC-011 is an unusual take on the classic assault mech. A 400-rated XXL Engine and a Supercharger make the KGC-011 the fastest King Crab to ever walk off of Cosara’s production line. A pair of LB-20X’s and a 等离子步枪 provide a devastating close range punch, whilst a 火箭发射器 acts as a backup weapon should an enemy survive to close in. 怪癖: Command 机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.18
column2: KGC-011是King Crab的黑暗时代重设计，是对经典突击机甲的一次非同寻常的诠释。400级XXL引擎和增压器让KGC-011成为Cosara生产线上走下来的最快King Crab。两门LB-20X和一支等离子步枪能够在近距离造成毁灭性打击；如果敌人侥幸接近，火箭发射器还可作为备用武器。 怪癖：指挥机甲 掉落成本乘数：1.18

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox BLO is armed with a UAC/10, an ER 中型激光 and an ER Small Laser. C3i rounds out the variant. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Kit Fox是30吨级轻型氏族全向机甲，由云蛇氏族于2890年推出。它重视火力和装甲的平衡，而不是速度；由180级XL引擎驱动，采用内骨骼钢与铁纤维装甲混合结构，提供16吨吊舱空间。Kit Fox BLO型装备一门UAC/10、一门ER中型激光和一门ER小型激光，C3i系统完善了配置。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox ID is armed with an Improved Heavy Large Laser and an Advanced AMS. A pair of ER 中型脉冲激光s and an a Watchdog CEWS round out the variant.
column2: Kit Fox是30吨级轻型氏族全向机甲，由云蛇氏族于2890年推出。它重视火力和装甲的平衡，而不是速度；由180级XL引擎驱动，采用内骨骼钢与铁纤维装甲混合结构，提供16吨吊舱空间。Kit Fox ID型装备一门改进型重型大型激光和一套先进AMS；两门ER中型脉冲激光和一套Watchdog CEWS完善了配置。

column1: If you see this thing coming at you, Boss, and you are not in a fully armored Assault Mech with lots of fast targetting weapons...run. Disengage. Withdraw. Flee. Whatever you can do, do it to get away from this monster.
column2: 老板，如果你看到这东西朝你冲来，而自己不在一台全装甲突击机甲里、手上也没有大量快速瞄准武器……快跑。脱离接触，撤退，逃走。想尽办法远离这个怪物。

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the 全向Mech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-I is armed with an ER Large Laser and 4 机枪 Arrays.部署成本倍率：1.1.
column2: Linebacker作为Timber Wolf的替代品设计，65吨级机体于3052年投产。它围绕390级XL引擎建造，较快的速度使其能在机动作战中跟上较轻的氏族同伴，这是Timber Wolf难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内骨骼钢的组合为全向机甲提供17.5吨可用吊舱空间。Linebacker LBK-I型装备一门ER大型激光和4组机枪阵列。部署成本倍率：1.1。

column1: A Dark Age variant of the Lupus, the Lupus D is armed with a RAC/5, backed up by a Streak LRM-10 and a pair of ER Medium Pulses Lasers.
column2: Lupus D是Lupus的黑暗时代改型，装备一门RAC/5，并由一具Streak LRM-10和两门ER中型脉冲激光提供支援。

column1: This Dark Age configuration carries a TSEMP Cannon, two Streak SRM-4s, and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers. A Beagle Active Probe is carried in the center torso, while a MASC system allows it to briefly reach speeds of 120 km/h.
column2: 这套黑暗时代配置携带一门TSEMP炮、两具Streak SRM-4和两门中型X脉冲激光。中央躯干装有比格犬主动探头，MASC系统则能让它短时间达到120公里/小时。

column1: A common Light OmniMech, the Mist Lynx is fielded by every Clan since its introduction in 2926. A 25-ton mech, the Mist Lynx is powered by a 175-rated XL Engine and is built with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous that gives it a respectable 7.5 tons of pod space. An 主动探头 is hardwired into the chassis boosting the Mist Lynx’s effectiveness as a scout. The Mist Lynx T is armed with an LRM-10, SRM-4 and 2 ER Small Lasers. A 守护者ECM Suite rounds out the variant.
column2: 迷雾山猫是常见的轻型全向机甲，自2926年推出以来被各个氏族部署。25吨级机体由175级XL引擎驱动，内骨骼钢与铁纤维装甲的组合提供7.5吨吊舱空间。底盘内置主动探头，提高了迷雾山猫的侦察效率。迷雾山猫T型装备LRM-10、SRM-4和两门ER小型激光，守护者ECM套件完善了配置。

column1: The 12R is a cut above many of the other variants with the inclusion of some stealth armor and a Clan ER Large Laser to bring respectable firepower and range for an Ostscout.
column2: 12R型比许多其他改型更胜一筹，配备隐身装甲和氏族ER大型激光，为Ostscout带来可靠的火力和射程。

column1: Codenamed TT, this loadout of the Phantom is actually rumored to be a prototype of an updated base 设计 due to the similarity of the abbreviations TT and II. Two ER Micro Lasers, a Heavy Large Laser and a 定位 Computer linking them are combined with a 守护者ECM. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这套Phantom配置代号为TT，据传由于TT与II缩写相似，它其实是更新基础设计的原型。两门ER微型激光、一门重型大型激光和连接它们的定位计算机，与守护者ECM组合在一起。 怪癖：改进的传感器 掉落成本乘数：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Based on specs from Operation Trapdoor, the 45 ton Rattlesnake II is a 10 ton upgrade of the original Rattlesnake 机甲. Built by 海狐氏族 for the AFFS during the waning years of the Dark Age, the RSN-1 is powered by a 315-rated Clan XL Engine. 8 tons of Clan Ferro-Fibrous 装甲 and a 守护者ECM suite protect the 机甲 while Clan MASC increases the 机甲s ground speed. A pair of Clan ER 中型激光s backed up a quartet of 中型激光s form the bulk of the 机甲s arsenal with an ER Small Laser rounding out the weapons. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Rattlesnake II是基于陷阱门行动规格打造的45吨机甲，比原始Rattlesnake增加10吨。它由海狐氏族为AFFS建造于黑暗时代末期，RSN-1由315级氏族XL引擎驱动。8吨氏族铁纤维装甲和守护者ECM套件保护机体，氏族MASC提高地面速度。两门氏族ER中型激光、四门中型激光构成主要火力，另有一门ER小型激光。 怪癖：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂、右侧上臂

column1: Based on specs from Operation Trapdoor, the 45 ton Rattlesnake II is a 10 ton upgrade of the original Rattlesnake 机甲. Built by 海狐氏族 for the AFFS during the waning years of the Dark Age, the RSN-2 is powered by a 315-rated Clan XL Engine. 9 tons of Stealth 装甲 and a 守护者ECM suite protect the 机甲. A sextet of of 中型激光s form the bulk of the 机甲s arsenal with a Small Laser rounding out the weapons.
column2: Rattlesnake II是基于陷阱门行动规格打造的45吨机甲，比原始Rattlesnake增加10吨。它由海狐氏族为AFFS建造于黑暗时代末期，RSN-2由315级氏族XL引擎驱动。9吨隐身装甲和守护者ECM套件保护机体。六门中型激光构成主要火力，另有一门小型激光。

column1: The IIC 10 is hard to see as anything other than a conceptual failure. This variant of the IIC 2 has been recently spotted in Raven AMC units. The use of Proto机甲-class autocannons results in a platform that does nothing especially well, with the loss of range and accuracy a serious hindrance. The addition of a supercharger to enable pilots to close range is insufficient to balance things out.
column2: 很难把IIC 10看作概念失败以外的东西。这个IIC 2改型最近在乌鸦特遣队单位中被发现。使用原型机甲级自动加农炮后，它没有任何特别擅长之处，射程和精度的损失更是严重障碍。加装增压器以帮助驾驶员接近目标，也不足以弥补这些缺点。

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1BR is powered by a 330-rated Light Fusion Engine giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. An ER PPC and a 锁定式SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load. MASC provides improved speed for short periods.
column2: Scorpion是最早量产的四足机甲之一，55吨级机体于2570年作为步兵支援单位投产。由于步态极不稳定，大多数机甲战士都不喜欢它，但Scorpion仍在继承战争及之后持续服役。Scorpion 1BR由330级轻型聚变引擎驱动，最高速度97公里/小时。ER PPC和锁定式SRM-6构成武器配置，MASC可在短时间内提高速度。

column1: he Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium Omni机甲 开发 by 氏族新星猫 to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The T configuration is a Dark Age 设计 featuring an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm, and a pair of 中型脉冲激光s.
column2: Shadow Cat是由氏族新星猫开发的重型、机动型中型全向机甲，用于在31世纪初复兴行动准备期间替代Ice Ferret。T型是黑暗时代设计，右臂装有一门Ultra AC/10，另有两门中型脉冲激光。

column1: The C configuration converts the Sojourner to a missile boat by arming it with two LRM 20s. The configuration also sports a Heavy Large Laser and a Micro Pulse Laser to defend itself.
column2: C型将Sojourner改造成导弹平台，装备两具LRM-20；同时配备一门重型大型激光和一门微型脉冲激光用于自卫。

column1: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These Omni机甲s are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatable with anything else. But with that huge engine and lots of jumpjet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many '机甲s its size that are faster.
column2: 老板，氏族把这些东西叫Summoner，但我一直称它们为Thor。这些全向机甲对于自身重量级别来说吊舱空间略少，早期结构挂点也无法兼容其他设备。不过凭借那台巨大的引擎和大量跳跃喷射器挂点，很难找到同体型且速度更快的机甲。

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Black Hills Urban Combat Zone Arena and piloted by Jillian Robertson and squad, this variant is a rebuild of an existing Clan battlesuit model. The base chassis was increased in mass to improve its 装甲 and weapon options, without sacrificing the suit’s airborne mobility or its anti-'机甲 attack options. The variant retains the Clan engineering HarJel technology and the life support systems keeping its warrior battle-ready even when compromised. The lighter-weight Clan 装甲 has been upgraded here by sixty percent over the original, that now can sustain hits from all but the heaviest lasers and autocannon, while still closing in to swarm its target. The variant trades the original Sylph’s bomb rack for a one shot five-pack of SRMs which also gives it a little extra punch, allowing a squad of these up-sized air Elementals to put some serious hurt on even a medium Battle机甲.
column2: 该改型于3144年在黑山城市战区竞技场首次亮相，由Jillian Robertson及其小队驾驶，是对某种氏族战斗装甲型号的重建。基础底盘增加了质量，以改善装甲和武器选择，同时保留空中机动性及反机甲攻击能力。它保留氏族工程使用的HarJel技术和生命维持系统，即使受损也能让战士保持战斗状态。较轻的氏族装甲在此基础上提升了百分之六十，可承受除最重型激光和自动加农炮外几乎所有攻击，同时仍能接近并蜂拥目标。该改型以一次性五联装SRM替换原始Sylph的炸弹舱，为放大的空中元素战士小队提供额外火力，甚至能重创中型战斗机甲。

column1: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower.
column2: Thug由Maltex Corporation设计，用于直接竞争热门的Warhammer战斗机甲。它于2572年首次投产，目标是解决Warhammer面临的若干问题，其中最主要的是在不牺牲火力的情况下增加装甲防护。

column1: Named for the symbol of the Egyptian goddess Wadjet, the Uraeus is a heavy BattleMech which first appeared during the Dark Age era in the hands of ComStar and the 球体共和国. With the Malcolm Buhl-led splinter faction the Blessed Order seeking to secretly rebuild the Com Guards, in 3128 agents of the Blessed Order stole advanced 布雷克圣言会 technical data, including extensive specs on the Manei Domini's Celestial series 全向Mechs, stored within a protected 球体共和国 data depot on Terra. Reengineering the secured schematics to develop the Uraeus BattleMech, Buhl commissioned the New Earth Trading Company - little more than a corporate front owned and operated by ComStar since the early Succession Wars - to secretly construct production lines for these new 'Mechs, hiding them among the massive volume of civilian manufacturing lines operated by NETC.
column2: Uraeus以埃及女神瓦吉特的象征命名，是一台重型战斗机甲，最初在黑暗时代由ComStar和球体共和国使用。由Malcolm Buhl领导、试图秘密重建Com Guards的Blessed Order分裂派，于3128年窃取了先进的布雷克圣言会技术资料，其中包括存储在泰拉受保护的球体共和国数据仓库中的Manei Domini天体系列全向机甲规格。Buhl重新设计这些机密图纸开发Uraeus，并委托New Earth Trading Company秘密建造生产线；这家公司自继承战争早期起就是ComStar拥有和运营的企业幌子，并将新机甲隐藏在NETC庞大的民用生产线上。

column1: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a 大型脉冲激光 in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two 锁定式SRM-2s and three 中型脉冲激光s split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a 瞄准计算机 makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven 双散热器, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
column2: Vapor Eagle采用杂色的近程武器配置：右臂装备一门大型脉冲激光，配以一挺机枪、两具锁定式SRM-2和分布于两侧躯干的三门中型脉冲激光；左臂的手枪形外壳中还装有三挺机枪。瞄准计算机让它在武器进入射程后更加致命。11枚双重散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨Streak导弹足以应付普通氏族试炼。

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy 机甲. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton 机甲 is a solid blend of firepower and mobility 设计ed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280-rated 轻型引擎 and 装甲ed in 弹道强化装甲 装甲, the Warhammer WHM-10K is armed with a pair of ER PPCs. Paired 中型激光s, ER Small Lasers, Clan Machine Guns and a 锁定式SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Clan DHS and CASE II round out the 设计.
column2: Warhammer在内圈及更远地区广受尊敬，是最杰出的重型机甲。70吨级机体于2515年首次亮相，将火力与机动性融为一体，旨在击败几乎所有对手。Warhammer WHM-10K由280级轻型引擎驱动，覆盖弹道强化装甲，装备两门ER PPC；配对中型激光、ER小型激光、氏族机枪和锁定式SRM-6阻止敌人接近。氏族双重散热器与CASE II完善了设计。

column1: Another of the latest iterations of the Wolverine, this variant has many uses and is proving increasingly popular.
column2: 这是Wolverine最新的改型之一，用途广泛，正越来越受欢迎。

column1: The Laser Bellona was massively upgraded with an XL engine, 装甲ed motive system, Streak LRMs, and a targeting computer This update gives Support Cizins a run for their money. In the late 3060s, under Khan James Cobb's command, 氏族地狱马 began preparation for a renewed presence in the Inner Sphere. The scientist caste saw this as an opportunity to create a new cavalry 车辆, which they called the Bellona. 设计 as a striker and flanker, the Bellona carries enough firepower on a nimble enough frame to keep up with even the fastest-advancing lines. The original specs called for tracks, but test pilots for the 车辆 cited that 'speed is 装甲', which led to the Bellona being re设计ed as a hover坦克. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 160 25 左侧 145 25 右侧 145 25 后方 105 25 炮塔 160 25 总计 715 125 怪癖: Nimble
column2: Laser Bellona通过XL引擎、装甲化动力系统、Streak LRM和瞄准计算机进行了大幅升级，这一更新让支援市民也能与之抗衡。3060年代后期，在汗王James Cobb指挥下，氏族地狱马开始准备重新进驻内圈。科学家阶层借此机会创造了新型骑兵车辆，称为Bellona。Bellona作为突击和侧翼单位设计，在灵活底盘上携带足够火力，甚至能跟上最快的推进部队。原始规格要求履带，但车辆试飞员认为“速度就是装甲”，于是Bellona被重新设计为气垫坦克。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：10/15格 / 300/450米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 145 25 右侧 145 25 后方 105 25 炮塔 160 25 总计 715 125 怪癖：灵巧

column1: The slowest Tank class, but carrying the heaviest 装甲 and biggest weapons. Carrying an array of ranged weapons, the Assault Tank is 设计ed to smash targets at range. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. 装甲: 反射涂层 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 260 40 左侧 245 40 右侧 245 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 235 40 总计 1185 200 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors
column2: 最慢的坦克级别，却拥有最厚的装甲和最大的武器。突击坦克携带多种远程武器，旨在从远距离粉碎目标。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5格 / 90/150米。 装甲：反射涂层 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 260 40 左侧 245 40 右侧 245 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 235 40 总计 1185 200 怪癖：改进的传感器

column1: An updated version of the Huitzilopochtli used by 玉鹰氏族, the Huitzilopochtli (LRM) replaces the Arrow IV launchers with a pair of Artemis-V enhanced LRM-20s. AP Gauss Rifles replace the Machine Guns and a 定位 Computer is added to improve overall accuracy. Lastly, 设计ers substituted the original armour for the more durable Hardened type. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. 装甲: Hardened (C) 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 100 45 左侧 100 45 右侧 100 45 后方 85 45 炮塔 90 45 总计 475 225 怪癖: 改进的 Jammer
column2: 这是玉鹰氏族使用的Huitzilopochtli升级版。Huitzilopochtli（LRM）以两具配备Artemis-V的LRM-20替换箭IV发射器，以AP高斯步枪替换机枪，并加入定位计算机提高整体精度。最后，设计师将原始装甲替换为更耐用的强化装甲。 生物群系限制：该单位因使用ICE无法部署在月球或火星生物群系。 移动：2/3格 / 60/90米。 装甲：强化装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 100 45 左侧 100 45 右侧 100 45 后方 85 45 炮塔 90 45 总计 475 225 怪癖：改进的干扰器

column1: An updated version of the classic Pike FSV, the Pike (Plasma) upgrades the Pike with a 燃料电池引擎 and Clan technology. Ferro-Fibrous and CASE improves protection whilst 3 等离子炮s replace the standard AC/2's and the SRM-2's are upgraded to Streak models. A 定位 Computer augments the Cannon's accuracy. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 240 30 左侧 130 30 右侧 130 30 后方 130 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 830 150 怪癖: Protected 机甲anisms
column2: Pike（等离子）是经典Pike FSV的升级版，采用燃料电池引擎和氏族技术。铁纤维装甲与CASE提高防护，三门等离子炮替换标准AC/2，SRM-2升级为Streak型号；定位计算机提高火炮精度。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5格 / 90/150米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 240 30 左侧 130 30 右侧 130 30 后方 130 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 830 150 怪癖：受保护的机械结构

column2: 别说了，老板……你在这东西里可不是速度快，因为它根本不快！

column1: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to 双散热器. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H 锁定式SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League.
column2: 这是3050年推出的标准Atlas的联邦升级版。S型从设计中移除五枚散热器，并将剩余散热器升级为双重散热器。减重后增加两具向后发射的Coventry T4H锁定式SRM-2，使Atlas的后方火力弧防护得到提升。内战后该型号停止生产，但两个分裂国家的驻军仍继续使用；AFFS部队为自动加农炮使用精准弹药，LAAF部队则使用从自由世界联盟缴获的专用LRM弹药。

column1: “海盗”据说是外围区的一个通用称呼，指的是继承战争年代越拖越久、人们出于绝望拼凑出来的重型与突击级拼装机甲——它们没有特定的重量或基础底盘；而其中最成功的型号是95吨的庞然大物，造型大体相似，通常带有COR编号。 Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: “海盗”据说是外围区的通用称呼，指的是继承战争年代越拖越久、人们出于绝望拼凑出来的重型与突击级拼装机甲——它们没有特定的重量或基础底盘；其中最成功的型号是95吨的庞然大物，外形大体相似，通常带有COR编号。 怪癖：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂

column1: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for Battle机甲s that were not ammunition dependent. The '机甲 was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The '机甲 is capable of speeds of up to 151 km/h and is 装甲ed with three and a half tons of 装甲. The '机甲, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon '机甲 and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 0.96
column2: Dart是在联邦寻找不依赖弹药的战斗机甲时建造的。该机甲采用全能量武器库和极高速底盘，最高速度可达151公里/小时，并覆盖3.5吨装甲。虽然武装较轻，但它是出色的侦察机甲，也适合游击部队；能量武器让它可以独立行动。 怪癖：延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数：0.96

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-4Nb-PP is armed with a 中型激光 and a PPC. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 猎鹰由SLDF在统一战争后设计，是侦察猎手和反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，它由180级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4Nb-PP装备一门中型激光和一门PPC。 怪癖：窄小低矮轮廓 掉落成本乘数：0.99

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-4Nb is armed with a pair of 中型激光s and a Snub Nose PPC. Endo Steel and 双散热器 free up the weight needed for the experimental PPC. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 猎鹰由SLDF在统一战争后设计，是侦察猎手和反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，它由180级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4Nb装备两门中型激光和一门短鼻PPC；内骨骼钢与双重散热器释放了安装实验型PPC所需的重量。 怪癖：窄小低矮轮廓 掉落成本乘数：0.99

column1: The Clans upgraded and lightened the venerable Griffin 设计 until the Battle机甲 now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. Seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous 装甲 are mounted on an Endo Steel frame, giving the Griffin IIC almost maximum 装甲 protection for its size. It is slightly faster than its antecedent, and it correspondingly mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 180 meters at a time. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 氏族改进并减轻了传奇Griffin的设计，最终诞生了被称为Griffin IIC的战斗机甲。七吨铁纤维装甲安装在内骨骼钢框架上，为Griffin IIC提供接近该体型极限的装甲防护。它比前身略快，并配备足够的跳跃喷射器，一次可跳跃180米。 怪癖：战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数：1.06

column1: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon '机甲, but lack of interest forced the 设计 to be shelved two years later. In 2990, 卡隆工业 rediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The '机甲 is 设计ed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy 装甲. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the '机甲 is hard pressed to defend itself. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Hornet于2760年作为城市侦察机甲首次亮相，但缺乏兴趣使该设计两年后搁置。2990年，卡隆工业重新发现图纸并恢复生产；升级后的HNT-171于3051年投产，生产线在3069年被卡佩兰摧毁。该机甲旨在以相对厚重的装甲快速穿越城市环境。由于武器混杂且速度较慢，Hornet在城市内尚算有效，离开城市后则很难自卫。 怪癖：窄小/低调 掉落成本乘数：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂、右侧上臂

column1: 这是鬼熊部族85吨原型的第二版，之后最终设计定为100吨。主要差别在于尝试使用较小的255额定引擎核心以避免使用XL引擎。 Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是鬼熊氏族85吨原型的第二版，最终设计后来确定为100吨。主要区别在于尝试使用较小的255级引擎核心，以避免使用XL引擎。 怪癖：防空瞄准系统 掉落成本乘数：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂、右侧下臂

column1: 这是郊狼部族作为决斗机研制的设计，科学家以钢内骨结构底盘为基础。它还带一台XL引擎和十六个双散热器，四具跳跃推进器让它一次可跃升一百二十米。右臂装一门LB 10-X，左臂装一对大型脉冲激光；左右躯干各一具连发SRM-2，以利用重武器造成的伤害。右躯干有一套反导弹系统，对面的躯干则装一门增程小型激光。反导弹系统与连发导弹各配一吨弹药，LB 10-X则有三吨弹药。 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是郊狼氏族研制的决斗机甲，科学家以钢内骨结构底盘为基础。它配备XL引擎、16枚双重散热器和4具跳跃喷射器，一次可跃升120米。右臂装一门LB-10X，左臂装两门大型脉冲激光；左右躯干各装一具连发SRM-2。右躯干有反导系统，左躯干装一门ER小型激光。反导系统和连发导弹各配一吨弹药，LB-10X配三吨弹药。 怪癖：精准武器—导弹 掉落成本乘数：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: The Ostscout was 设计ed as a pure recon Battle机甲 by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional; the Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other 设计s can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. Introduced at the same time as the original model and used by the SLDF Royal units, the 7Jb is the only variant of the Ostscout built prior to the 氏族入侵. This variant uses endo steel to free up enough mass to add a Beagle active probe. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Ostscout由Ostmann工业设计为纯侦察战斗机甲，完全围绕收集情报和脱离险境建造；它足够迅速，能逃离大多数陷阱，其他设计很少能在速度和机动性上匹敌。7Jb与原始型号同时推出，由SLDF皇家部队使用，是氏族入侵前唯一生产的Ostscout改型。该型号采用内骨骼钢，为安装比格犬主动探头释放重量。 怪癖：改进的传感器 掉落成本乘数：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂、右侧下臂

column1: 作为第一代战斗机甲，50吨的凤凰是边缘世界共和国建造的第一种本土战斗机甲。它采用原始部件，由一具240级聚变核心驱动，凤凰1R携带一门PPC和两具SRM-2。3个跳跃推进器赋予凤凰有限的跳跃能力，代价是原本的SRM-4被降级。 Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 作为第一代战斗机甲，50吨级凤凰是边缘世界共和国建造的第一种本土战斗机甲。它采用原始部件，由240级聚变核心驱动；凤凰1R携带一门PPC和两具SRM-2。三具跳跃喷射器赋予有限跳跃能力，代价是原本的SRM-4被降级。 怪癖：易于维护 掉落成本乘数：0.82 手臂驱动器限制：右侧上臂

column1: The 步枪手IIC Chironex carries an Ultra AC/2 and ATM 3 rack in each arm, supported by head mounted ER Small Laser and a 大型脉冲激光 in each side torso. Built around a 195-rated standard engine, Endo Steel frame and thirteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Chironex is fitted with fourteen 双散热器, three Jump Jets, three tons of ATM reloads and two tons of UAC rounds.
column2: 步枪手IIC Chironex每条手臂装备一门Ultra AC/2和一具ATM-3发射架，头部装有ER小型激光，两侧躯干各装一门大型脉冲激光。它以195级标准引擎、内骨骼钢框架和13吨铁纤维装甲为核心，配备14枚双重散热器、3具跳跃喷射器、3吨ATM弹药和2吨UAC弹药。

column1: 作为突击级火力支援机甲，火蜥蜴于3055年投产。作为80吨机甲，火蜥蜴围绕一具320级XL引擎和内层钢骨架建造，使其能携带43吨武器与装备。火蜥蜴PPR-6T武装为两具LRM-20。一对中型脉冲激光器和一门大型脉冲激光器充当后备武器。 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为突击级火力支援机甲，火蜥蜴于3055年投产。80吨级机体围绕320级XL引擎和内骨骼钢骨架建造，可携带43吨武器与装备。火蜥蜴PPR-6T装备两具LRM-20，一对中型脉冲激光和一门大型脉冲激光作为后备武器。 怪癖：精准武器—导弹 掉落成本乘数：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂

column1: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched 锁定式SRM-6 and ER 中型激光s in each arm. An 反导系统 and a 轻型 主动探头 in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
column2: Sun Spider B是混合射程战斗机甲，右侧躯干安装一支高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有ER大型激光；两条手臂各配一具锁定式SRM-6和ER中型激光。左侧躯干的反导系统和轻型主动探头防止它被偷袭；同时携带两吨高斯与Streak弹药、一吨AMS弹药和一枚额外双重散热器。

column1: 作为公牛的最初原型，A-1基于卡佩兰联邦研发的原始火蜂。它装有两具共分享一吨弹药的SRM-2和一门大型激光器。虽然最高只能跑64公里/小时，A-1的装甲防护比火蜂更多，以十吨半原始装甲保护机甲。 Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.78 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为Bull的最初原型，A-1基于卡佩兰联邦研发的原始火蜂。它装有两具共用一吨弹药的SRM-2和一门大型激光。虽然最高速度只有64公里/小时，A-1的装甲防护比火蜂更多，以10.5吨原始装甲保护机体。 怪癖：易于维护 掉落成本乘数：0.78 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂

column1: The 4L was a variant built for the Capellan Confederation by 塞雷斯金属 starting in 3066. The 设计 used a Taurian-生产 standard engine for power and was built around a Endo Steel skeleton. The '机甲 carried an ER large laser in its right forearm as its primary weapon, joined by two ER medium lasers in the left and right arm for secondary weapons. It also mounted a machine gun in either arm, with half a ton of reloads carried in the center torso. The six jump jets split between the rear side torsos were also upgraded from the original, being specially 设计ed to protect the exhaust ports and improve cooling during operation. One of the more radical changes was the use of eight tons of 塞雷斯金属 Stealth 装甲, making the 凤鹰 harder to target at range. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03
column2: 4L型是塞雷斯金属自3066年起为卡佩兰联邦制造的改型。该设计使用陶里安生产的标准引擎，并以内骨骼钢为核心。机甲右前臂装备一门ER大型激光，两条手臂各装一门ER中型激光；每条手臂还装有机枪，中央躯干携带半吨弹药。后侧躯干分布的六具跳跃喷射器经过升级，专门保护排气口并改善运行散热。更激进的变化是采用8吨塞雷斯金属隐身装甲，使凤凰更难被远距离锁定。 怪癖：改进的通信 掉落成本乘数：1.03

column1: Based off of the Crab Battle机甲, the Aquagladius was a creation of the 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队, or VEST, for the Solaris VII games. The Aquagladius 4 fields a more conventional Battle机甲 loadout as opposed to the more unorthodox weapons wielded by its older brother. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Lower
column2: Aquagladius以Crab战斗机甲为基础，由瓦伊宁工程与打捞队（VEST）为Solaris VII赛事打造。Aquagladius 4型采用比其老兄弟更传统的战斗机甲武器配置。 怪癖：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL 机甲 设计ed to work with the light Hammer fire support 机甲. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 300-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-3R is armed with a pair of 大型脉冲激光s and a pair of 中型激光s. A 守护者ECM Suite distorts enemy sensors.
column2: Anvil于3055年首次亮相，是自由世界联盟设计的机甲，用于配合轻型Hammer火力支援机甲。作为重型近战机甲，它重60吨，配备300级聚变核心和内骨骼钢底盘。Anvil ANV-3R装备两门大型脉冲激光和两门中型激光，守护者ECM套件可扰乱敌方传感器。

column1: The design of the Arctic Wolf is simple: get close, unleash a torrent of missiles, and get out. Like the Pack Hunter, some materials used in the design were obtained from the Kell Hounds, though the design is Clan-tech in every way that matters.
column2: Arctic Wolf的设计很简单：接近目标，倾泻导弹，然后脱离。和Pack Hunter一样，设计中使用的部分材料来自Kell Hounds，但在关键方面它完全采用氏族技术。

column1: The BL1-OD is a bomb on legs on account of how much ammunition it's carrying. The large reserves allow for extended deployments, and the risk of explosion is mitigated slightly by the CASE. Slightly.
column2: BL1-OD因为携带大量弹药，简直是一枚长着腿的炸弹。巨大的储备允许长期部署，而CASE略微降低了爆炸风险——只是略微。

column1: Another custom designed variant produced from the BBM factories at Nanking on the orders of Duke Morgan Hasek-Davion.
column2: 这是另一种定制改型，由南京BBM工厂根据Morgan Hasek-Davion公爵的命令生产。

column1: The Basilisk Proto机甲 was 设计ed and built by 云蛇氏族 to support their Elemental and Omni机甲 forces. Unlike most second generation Protos, the Basilisk has a relatively low top speed. This variant of the Basilisk removes the standard weapons mix and replaces them with a Small Laser, two Micro Lasers, a 短 Range Missile launcher, and jump jets.
column2: Basilisk原型机甲由云蛇氏族设计和制造，用于支援其元素战士和全向机甲部队。与多数第二代原型机甲不同，Basilisk最高速度相对较低。该改型移除标准武器组合，换装一门小型激光、两门微型激光、一具短程导弹发射器和跳跃喷射器。

column1: The Blackjack 1Cr is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage.
column2: Blackjack 1Cr是相当不寻常的改装，以两门迫击炮替换自动加农炮，从而提供间接火力支援，并获得AMS防护。

column1: The personal 'Mech of Lt. Hannah McQuarters of the 1st Kestrel Grenadiers, all of Gertrude's medium pulse lasers were removed and replaced with eight forward facing ER medium lasers, two in each arm, two in the center torso, and one in both left and right torsos.
column2: 这是第一骑兵掷弹兵团Hannah McQuarters中尉的私人机甲。Gertrude原有的所有中型脉冲激光都被拆除，换成八门面向前方的ER中型激光：每条手臂两门，中央躯干两门，左右躯干各一门。

column1: The Cecerops Proto机甲 was 设计ed and built by 血灵氏族 using materials acquired from 雪鸦氏族. Though not as heavily 装甲ed as some other Proto机甲s, the 设计's high speed prevents most opponents from getting a target lock. This variant reduces the engine size slightly to incorporate a single tube Streak SRM launcher.
column2: Cecerops原型机甲由血灵氏族使用从雪鸦氏族取得的材料设计和制造。虽然装甲不如其他原型机甲厚重，但高速使大多数对手难以锁定目标。该改型略微缩小引擎，以安装一具单管Streak SRM发射器。

column1: The scientists of 血灵氏族 and 雪鸦氏族 worked together to start their Proto机甲 programs. The six-meter tall Chrysaor was the first Proto机甲 the two clans 设计ed. Chrysaor 2 removes the ER Micro Lasers and replaces them with two 微型 Pulse Lasers and five jump jets
column2: 血灵氏族与雪鸦氏族的科学家合作启动原型机甲计划。六米高的Chrysaor是两族共同设计的第一台原型机甲。Chrysaor 2移除ER微型激光，换成两门微型脉冲激光和五具跳跃喷射器。

column1: This Conjurer variant uses an XL Engine to achieve the same speed as the original, but saves weight for added components. A short-range powerhouse, the 设计ers included four Heavy 中型激光s that max out the fourteen double heat sinks. Despite that, they also included a 中型脉冲激光 and two 锁定式SRM-6s to aid to hunting battle 装甲. For work against conventional infantry, it includes two 轻型 Machine Guns. A 定位 Computer improves the accuracy of the lasers. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: 左侧 Lower
column2: 该Conjurer改型使用XL引擎以达到与原型相同的速度，同时节省重量安装其他部件。设计师加入四门重型中型激光，使其成为短程火力强者，并将十四枚双重散热器推至极限。除此之外，它还配备一门中型脉冲激光和两具锁定式SRM-6，用于猎杀战斗装甲；对付常规步兵则有两挺轻型机枪。定位计算机提高激光精度。 怪癖：延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂

column1: A stealthy Crusader with Jump Jets, be prepared for pain delivered from above with little warning. And still it keeps a respectable level of weaponry. Impressive.
column2: 这是一台装备跳跃喷射器的隐身Crusader；准备好承受从上方突然袭来的痛击吧。即便如此，它仍保有相当可观的武器配置。令人印象深刻。

column1: The 5K variant comes the closest of any of the variants to living up to the 'Mech's name. The SRM-6 launcher has been removed from the 'Mech and replaced with a C3 Master Computer, allowing it to coordinate the actions of a C3 lance. The 'Mech is extremely valuable as a medium command 'Mech.
column2: 5K型最接近实现该机甲名称含义。它拆除SRM-6发射器，换成C3主计算机，从而能够协调C3长枪单位的行动。这台机甲作为中型指挥机甲极具价值。

column1: Between this and the 6T, I am not sure which one I'd prefer. More weapons or better targetting? It's a tough choice, Boss.
column2: 在这台和6T之间，我不确定自己更喜欢哪一台。是更多武器，还是更好的瞄准？老板，这是个艰难的选择。

column1: Well, Boss, this might look like an Excalibur, but it's about as far from one as you could get in terms of equipment. The level of technology we're looking at here? It's somethin' else. Whoever came up with this design knew what they needed to put on this thing to ruin somebody's day.
column2: 老板，这东西看起来像Excalibur，但就装备而言，它离Excalibur差得远。我们看到的技术水平？简直非同寻常。设计它的人非常清楚该装什么，才能毁掉某人的一天。

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-5P is armed with a 中型脉冲激光 and a pair of ER 中型激光s. A 瞄准计算机 enhances the Laser’s accuracy while the inclusion of MASC boosts the Falcon’s speed. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 猎鹰由SLDF在统一战争后设计，是侦察猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，它由180级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-5P装备一门中型脉冲激光和两门ER中型激光。瞄准计算机提高激光精度，MASC则提升猎鹰速度。 怪癖：窄小低矮轮廓 掉落成本乘数：0.99

column1: A variant sold exclusively to the 布雷克圣言会, the 9K1B variant of the Falcon Hawk is a major upgrade of the 设计. The ER PPC, both medium pulse lasers, and the small pulse laser have all been removed, replaced with an ER large laser and a trio of ER medium lasers. The saved weight has been used to add a TAG laser 设计ator, a Beagle active probe, and a 守护者ECM suite. 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 9K1B型猎鹰鹰是专门出售给布雷克圣言会的改型，对原设计进行了重大升级。ER PPC、两门中型脉冲激光和小型脉冲激光全部拆除，换成一门ER大型激光和三门ER中型激光。节省的重量用于增加TAG激光指示器、比格犬主动探头和守护者ECM套件。 怪癖：均衡 掉落成本乘数：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂、右侧下臂

column1: The Capellans have rebuilt the Griffin from the skeleton up to take advantage of their new stealth 装甲. The engineers selected a XL fusion engine to allow for the larger LRM-15 launcher and 守护者ECM system; thirteen double-strength heat sinks are required to keep the 设计 reasonably cool. Further upgrades include an Artemis IV targeting system to improve the accuracy of the missile rack and an ER PPC. Concerns about the fragility of using an XL engine was settled by allotting an additional 1.5 tons of 装甲. Finally, CASE protection for the ammunition bins was vital; while incapable of protecting the bulky engine, it allows the pilot to eject safely in the event of an ammunition explosion.
column2: 卡佩兰人从骨架开始重建Griffin，以利用新型隐身装甲。工程师选用XL聚变引擎，以容纳更大的LRM-15发射器和守护者ECM系统；十三枚双强度散热器用于保持合理温度。进一步升级包括提高导弹架精度的Artemis IV瞄准系统，以及一门ER PPC。为解决XL引擎脆弱性问题，机体额外分配了1.5吨装甲。最后，弹药箱的CASE防护至关重要；虽然无法保护笨重的引擎，却能在弹药爆炸时让驾驶员安全弹射。

column1: The Lyran 6S Griffin was built in 3066 using an Endo Steel chassis and mounting a 275 Light Fusion Engine. This allowed the 6S model to carry a ER PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 over the right shoulder with Artemis IV, and two ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 莱拉6S型Griffin于3066年制造，采用内骨骼钢底盘和275级轻型聚变引擎。因此6S型可在右臂携带一门ER PPC，在右肩上方安装配备Artemis IV的LRM-15，并装备两门ER中型激光。

column1: Jointly 开发 by the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine, the 85 ton Gunslinger entered production in 3053. Powered by a 255-rated XL Engine, the Gunslinger 2ERD is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles. 4 中型激光s add additional firepower at close ranges. A 守护者ECM Suite and a C3 Master Computer enhance the 机甲s capabilities, while a trio of Jump Jets increase mobility.
column2: Gunslinger由联邦合众国与龙马联盟联合开发，85吨级机体于3053年投产。由255级XL引擎驱动，Gunslinger 2ERD装备两支高斯步枪；4门中型激光提供近距离额外火力。守护者ECM套件和C3主计算机增强机甲能力，三具跳跃喷射器提高机动性。

column1: Developed to meet customer demand for a cheaper fire support unit, the T3 merely swaps the Arrow IV launcher for the more common Thumper artillery piece. Otherwise unchanged, this mech is marketed to budget conscious customers looking for an artillery mech.
column2: T3是为满足客户对廉价火力支援单位的需求而开发的，只将箭IV发射器替换为更常见的Thumper火炮。除此之外保持不变，这台机甲面向预算有限、需要火炮机甲的客户销售。

column1: It's a straight upgrade of the brawler HBK-4H. It hits harder and runs cold unless you jump and alpha strike. It's as 装甲ed as it can be and even has CASE II.
column2: 这是格斗型HBK-4H的直接升级版。它打击更重，只要不跳跃并全弹齐射，就能保持低温。装甲已达到极限，甚至配备CASE II。

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An 全向Mech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous armor giving the 全向Mech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman H is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers. 4 Heavy 中型激光s and a Heavy Small Laser provide additional firepower at close range. 守护者ECM protects the Huntsman, while a 瞄准计算机 improves the accuracy of the Lasers. An 主动探头 allows it to scout.
column2: Huntsman是氏族新星猫设计的50吨级机甲，用于复兴行动和入侵内圈，于3049年投产。作为全向机甲，它以250级XL引擎为核心，采用内骨骼钢和铁纤维装甲，提供21.5吨吊舱空间；底盘固定5具跳跃喷射器。Huntsman H型装备两门ER大型激光，4门重型中型激光和一门重型小型激光提供近距离火力。守护者ECM保护机体，瞄准计算机提高激光精度，主动探头使其能够侦察。

column1: Intended to serve as a medium assault unit, the Hydra carries heavy armor and a decent weapon suite. Introduced in 3066, the Hydra 2 was centered around the use of a set of Jump Jets, at the expense of armor protection and weaponry.
column2: Hydra旨在充当中型突击单位，拥有厚重装甲和可靠武器套件。Hydra 2于3066年推出，以一组跳跃喷射器为核心，牺牲了一部分装甲防护和武器。

column1: Another of those crazy merc refits. We sure know how to make 'em, this one is so much better than the stock produced ones. At a much higher cost, of course. But it is all about winning your battles as a Merc.
column2: 又一个疯狂的佣兵改装。我们确实知道怎么造这种东西；这台比量产型号强得多。当然，成本也高得多。但作为佣兵，赢下战斗才是一切。

column1: One of the earliest second generation 全向Mech designs, the Kingfisher debuted in 2887 and is reputed to have influenced all subsequent Clan Assault 全向Mech designs. A 90-ton mech powered by a 360-rated Fusion Engine, the Kingfisher has 24 tons of podspace provided by a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel skeleton. The Kingfisher E is armed with an ATM-12 and a 大型脉冲激光. At closer ranges, the E can bring to bear 5 中型脉冲激光s.
column2: Kingfisher是最早的第二代全向机甲设计之一，于2887年首次亮相，据称影响了此后所有氏族突击全向机甲设计。90吨级机体由360级聚变引擎驱动，铁纤维装甲与内骨骼钢骨架提供24吨吊舱空间。Kingfisher E型装备ATM-12和一门大型脉冲激光，近距离还能使用5门中型脉冲激光。

column1: The main guns on the Legacy are its two large-bore Mydron Excel autocannon, which are capable of punching through any opposing 'Mech with amazing speed. The three Diverse Optics lasers and the Guided Technologies 2nd Gen 4-tube are clearly backup weapons. The lack of significant long-range weapons hampers the design somewhat, an absence that is only exacerbated by its slow speed. Moreover, the 'Mech's vaunted durability is limited due to its reliance on ammo-fed weaponry. Should the Legacy run out of ammunition, it is clearly advantageous for the pilot to quit the field rather than attempt to use energy weaponry that can be outclassed by 'Mechs half its size.
column2: Legacy的主炮是两门大口径Mydron Excel自动加农炮，能够以惊人速度击穿任何敌方机甲。三门Diverse Optics激光和Guided Technologies第二代四管发射器显然只是备用武器。缺少有效的远程武器削弱了设计，缓慢速度又加重了这一问题。此外，机甲依赖弹药供给武器，传闻中的耐久性也受到限制。如果Legacy耗尽弹药，驾驶员最好退出战场，而不是尝试使用会被半重量机甲压制的能量武器。

column1: The Lineholder was the first Battle机甲 设计 to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is 设计ed around a set of `Common Sense Rules` for '机甲 设计. This approach has 生产 a '机甲 with a good ground speed and respectable amount of 装甲 and firepower. The '机甲 has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium '机甲s. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of 装甲 protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable '机甲 that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton Battle机甲s. For minor factions able to afford brand new Battle机甲s, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lineholder是Kressly Warworks推出的第一款战斗机甲，围绕机甲设计的“常识规则”打造。该方法造就了速度良好、装甲和火力可靠的机甲，最高速度86.4公里/小时，除最快的轻型和中型机甲外都能跟上。Lineholder还拥有10吨装甲和14枚散热器。现成武器与设备的组合让它可靠、易修理且值得信赖。对小型部队和小贵族而言，它最终的卖点是价值与价格；上市首年，相较其他55吨战斗机甲取得了历史性成功，并成为买得起新机甲的小派系首选驻军机器。 怪癖：易于维护 掉落成本乘数：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂、右侧下臂

column1: Debuting in 3052, the Mantis is a light mech 设计ed for the 机甲 arenas on Solaris VII. A 30-ton 机甲, the Mantis is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine, giving it the speed to outrun or out-maneuver almost any other 机甲. The Mantis MTS-L is armed with 4 中型脉冲激光s and a Lance. A Supercharger increases the MTS-L’s speed and TSM adds to it’s close quarters punch. 掉落成本乘数: 0.97.
column2: Mantis于3052年首次亮相，是为Solaris VII机甲竞技场设计的轻型机甲。30吨级机体由270级XL引擎驱动，速度足以超过或绕过几乎所有其他机甲。Mantis MTS-L装备4门中型脉冲激光和一柄长枪；增压器提高速度，TSM增强近战打击力。掉落成本乘数：0.97。

column1: Debuting in 3052, the Mantis is a light mech 设计ed for the 机甲 arenas on Solaris VII. A 30-ton 机甲, the Mantis is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine, giving it the speed to outrun or out-maneuver almost any other 机甲. The Mantis MTS-T3 is armed with 3 ER 中型激光s and a pair of ER Small Lasers augmented by a 定位 Computer. MASC, Reactive 装甲 and a pair of Claws allow it to tear apart other 机甲s. 掉落成本乘数: 0.97.
column2: Mantis于3052年首次亮相，是为Solaris VII机甲竞技场设计的轻型机甲。30吨级机体由270级XL引擎驱动，速度足以超过或绕过几乎所有其他机甲。Mantis MTS-T3装备3门ER中型激光和两门ER小型激光，并由定位计算机增强。MASC、反应装甲和一对利爪让它能够撕碎其他机甲。掉落成本乘数：0.97。

column1: This is a Sheriff's mech, it brings a peace of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology. By switching to double heat sinks, the 2L model of the Marshal is able to upgrade the LRM-5 launcher to a much more powerful LRM-15 launcher.
column2: 这是一台治安官机甲，能给人带来安心，但技术含量不高。Marshal 2L型改用双重散热器后，可以将LRM-5发射器升级为威力强得多的LRM-15。

column1: The Minotaur is the 'assault class' of the first generation Proto机甲s. This variation of the Minotaur was re设计ed as a fire support model, armed with an LRM-12 Launcher as its 'main gun'. Improvements to the 设计 include an increase of its maximum speed to 80 km/h, increase range to its jumping capacity, and additional 装甲 protection.
\n
\n怪癖: Resilient
\n
\n掉落成本乘数: 0.984
column2: Minotaur是第一代原型机甲中的“突击级”型号。这一变体被重新设计为火力支援型号，以LRM-12发射器作为主炮。改进包括将最高速度提升至80公里/小时、增加跳跃距离，并加强装甲防护。

column1: \n
\n怪癖：坚韧
\n
\n掉落成本乘数：0.984
column2: LLM

column1: The Orc is the first ProtoMech developed wholly by Clan Hell's Horses. The Orc reflects the unique battle tactics of the Horses. The standard Orc uses a quartet of SRM-1 missile tubes, with each of the launchers carries five reloads.
column2: Orc是第一台完全由氏族地狱马开发的原型机甲，体现了该氏族独特的战术。标准Orc使用四具SRM-1导弹管，每具发射器携带五次再装填。

column1: The Ostscout was 设计ed as a pure recon Battle机甲 by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional; the Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other 设计s can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. The 9CS is a complete upgrade of the original 设计 incorporating an endo steel chassis and ferro-fibrous 装甲. With the weight savings a 比格犬主动探头, 守护者ECM and TAG were added and armament has been increased to a pair of ER 中型激光s and an ER Small Laser. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Ostscout由Ostmann工业设计为纯侦察战斗机甲，完全围绕收集情报和脱离险境建造。9CS是原始设计的全面升级，采用内骨骼钢底盘和铁纤维装甲；减重后增加比格犬主动探头、守护者ECM和TAG，武装升级为两门ER中型激光和一门ER小型激光。 怪癖：改进的传感器 掉落成本乘数：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂、右侧下臂

column1: The Ostscout 9S has been rebuilt from the ground up with advanced armor and chassis to allow an advanced suite of electronics and a respectable weapons loadout. It's still not built for the front line but is a very capable scout.
column2: Ostscout 9S从底盘到装甲全面重建，采用先进装甲和框架，以容纳先进电子设备和可靠武器配置。它仍不是前线机甲，但作为侦察机非常出色。

column1: The Procyon is the first ProtoMech designed and built by Clan Coyote. Procyon 2 removes the heat sinks and small lasers and replaces them with a pair of LRM-4 launchers and some additional armor.
column2: Procyon是第一台由郊狼氏族设计和制造的原型机甲。Procyon 2移除散热器和小型激光，换成两具LRM-4发射器并增加装甲。

column1: Almost identical to the standard version of the Red Shift introduced in 3063, the 2B is modified to find hidden enemy units by removing the ECM Suite and replacing it with a Beagle Active Probe.
column2: 2B型几乎与3063年推出的标准Red Shift相同，但移除了ECM套件并换成比格犬主动探头，以发现隐藏的敌方单位。

column1: The Roc is considered one of the best of the first generation Proto机甲s, and most known successful, as it was 生产, operative and fighting for almost a century. Roc 3 main gun is exchanged for a 中型脉冲激光, with less 装甲 reduction than the Roc 2. However, the 设计ers were forced to drop the jump jets from the Proto机甲.
column2: Roc被认为是第一代原型机甲中最优秀、最成功的型号之一，曾生产、服役并战斗近一个世纪。Roc 3将主炮换成中型脉冲激光，相比Roc 2减少了装甲削减；不过设计师不得不移除原型机甲的跳跃喷射器。

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 12C is powered by a 330-rated XL Engine giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. An ER PPC, iNARC and an ER Small Laser form the Mechs weapons load. A C3i module allows the Mech to share data with other C3i equipped Mechs.
column2: Scorpion是最早量产的四足机甲之一，55吨级机体于2570年作为步兵支援单位投产。尽管步态极不稳定、遭多数机甲战士嫌弃，它仍在继承战争期间及之后持续服役。Scorpion 12C由330级XL引擎驱动，最高速度97公里/小时；ER PPC、iNARC和ER小型激光构成武器配置。C3i模块让它能够与其他配备C3i的机甲共享数据。

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium Omni机甲 开发 by 氏族新星猫 to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The D configuration comes bristling with weapons, featuring an ER Large Laser, three 中型脉冲激光s, a Streak SRM6, an ER Small Laser, and two Machine Guns.
column2: Shadow Cat是由氏族新星猫开发的重型、机动型中型全向机甲，用于在31世纪初复兴行动准备期间替代Ice Ferret。D型武器密集，装备一门ER大型激光、三门中型脉冲激光、一具Streak SRM-6、一门ER小型激光和两挺机枪。

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Silver Fox uses a large but light engine to provide a lot of speed for low weight. The increased size of this engine leaves little room for weapons, but given how fast the Silver Fox is this usually isn't a problem. To protect the 'Mech, Innovative Design Concepts added seven tons of reflective armor, which while only as effective as standard armor against missiles or autocannons, provides superior protection against energy weapons common to the arenas. To provide more protection, IDC additionally installed an ECM suite in the 'Mech's right torso.
column2: Silver Fox是Solaris VII的战斗机甲，以大型但轻量的引擎换取低重量下的高速。引擎体积较大，留给武器的空间很少，但Silver Fox速度极快，通常不成问题。Innovative Design Concepts为保护机甲增加7吨反射装甲；它对导弹和自动加农炮仅与标准装甲相当，却能更好地防御竞技场常见的能量武器。IDC还在右侧躯干安装ECM套件以进一步加强防护。

column1: Well, I thought this was a standard Spartan to begin with, but it looks like there's been a bunch of aftermarket improvements made to it by the Com Guards — mainly swapping some weaponry out for sorely needed heat sinks.
column2: 我原本以为这是一台标准的Spartan，但看起来Com Guards对它进行了大量售后改进——主要是把一些武器换成急需的散热器。

column1: Intended for long range combat, the Templar A is configured to engage an enemy at long ranges. To do this, it carries an ER PPC as its primary weapon backed up by an 超级自动炮/10 which can fire at twice the rate of a standard autocannon. Both of these are linked to an advanced 瞄准计算机 for increased accuracy. For close combat, the Templar A has a 锁定式SRM-6 launcher and for increased mobility this configuration has four jump jets, letting it jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. To protect the 'Mech from enemy electronic warfare systems, the 'Mech has a 守护者ECM Suite and to handle the 'Mech's heavy heat load, it has an additional double heat sink.
column2: Templar A型用于远程作战，配置旨在从远距离交战。它以ER PPC为主武器，并由一门超级自动炮/10支援，后者射速是标准自动加农炮的两倍；两者都连接到先进瞄准计算机以提高精度。近战时，Templar A装备锁定式SRM-6；四具跳跃喷射器提高机动性，最多可跳跃120米。守护者ECM套件保护机甲免受敌方电子战，额外双重散热器则处理巨大的热负荷。

column1: Built for both ComStar and the Word of Blake in 3067, the Thug 12E is a redesign of the Thug 11E with the aim of extending it’s accuracy and range. The traditional PPCs have been upgraded to ER PPCs and an improved C3 computer has been added. To make the change to a C3i computer, a double heat sink, one ton of ammunition, and the corresponding CASE were removed.
column2: Thug 12E于3067年为ComStar和布雷克圣言会制造，是Thug 11E的重设计，目标是扩大精度和射程。传统PPC升级为ER PPC，并增加改进型C3计算机。为改用C3i计算机，拆除了一个双重散热器、一吨弹药及相应CASE。

column1: The Ying 长 usually carries an infantry-scale Man-Portable 等离子步枪. In addition to having a decent range and damage potential, the rifle is useful for starting fires. The Battle Claws used by the battlesuit enable it to make anti-'机甲 attacks and ride Omni机甲s into battle. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.888 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: Ying长通常携带步兵级便携式等离子步枪。步枪射程和伤害潜力都不错，还可用于点火。战斗装甲使用的战斗爪使其能够进行反机甲攻击，并骑乘全向机甲投入战斗。 怪癖：伏击者 掉落成本乘数：0.888 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can. Eschewing the autocannon, this Draconis Combine variant carries an MRM-30 with two tons of ammo.
column2: 别被矮墩墩的“垃圾桶”骗了；它看起来像会走路的垃圾桶，但这台龙马联盟改型放弃自动加农炮，携带一具MRM-30和两吨弹药。

column1: Boss, this beauty is one of those Valkyrie IIs from the Solaris stables; I've seen these in action. 'Sigrun' here has a BattleMech Sword and TSM allowing it to cleave limbs clean off many 'Mechs. Her left-hook is also pretty damn brutal with that Plasma Cannon. Roll that all together with that monstrous engine and six jump jets, this 'Mech can chase down and murder most 'Mechs.
column2: 老板，这台漂亮货是Solaris马厩里的Valkyrie II之一，我见过它们实战。“Sigrun”装有战斗机甲剑和TSM，能把许多机甲的肢体整条砍下。它的左勾拳配合等离子炮也相当残暴。再加上那台怪物般的引擎和六具跳跃喷射器，这台机甲能追上并消灭大多数机甲。

column1: An upgrade of the Watchman made after the incursion into the Draconis Combine by James Sandoval, the Duke of Robinson, the 4DM upgrades the Watchman to make it more potent on the modern battlefield. The 'Mech has had the Large Laser and Machine Guns replaced with a PPC, giving the 'Mech a great deal of long range firepower. The 'Mech has also upgraded its heat sinks to double heat sinks and the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous armor, providing the 'Mech with better armor protection.
column2: 这是James Sandoval、Robinson公爵入侵龙马联盟后对Watchman进行的升级，4DM让Watchman在现代战场上更具威力。大型激光和机枪被一门PPC替换，带来强大的远程火力；散热器升级为双重散热器，装甲升级为铁纤维装甲，提供更好的防护。

column1: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人觉得它不过是个会走路的水冷器。批评者们得到的是震惊。幽灵是一台只要运用得当，就能以惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中大闹的机甲。它围绕一台巨大的LTV 385 XL引擎建造，使其速度可达略低于119公里/小时。幽灵拥有一套简单却有效的脉冲武器载荷。脉冲激光武器让该机甲能抵消其大量使用跳跃推进器对精度造成的大部分副作用，使这台轻武装机甲拥有令人难以置信的精度与威力。A modification of the Wraith made by the 布雷克圣言会, the TR3 replaces the two 中型脉冲激光s with two ER 中型激光s while one of the jump jets is removed to make room for an improved C3 computer, making the Wraith an incredibly powerful point 'Mech for units equipped with C3i equipment.
column2: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人认为它只是会走路的水冷器；批评者很快被震惊。幽灵只要运用得当，就能以惊人的速度和机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它围绕LTV 385 XL引擎建造，速度略低于119公里/小时，采用简单却有效的脉冲武器载荷。脉冲激光抵消了大量跳跃喷射器对精度造成的影响，使这台轻武装机甲拥有令人难以置信的精度和威力。布雷克圣言会的TR3改型用两门ER中型激光替换两门中型脉冲激光，并拆除一具跳跃喷射器以安装改进型C3计算机；对于配备C3i设备的部队而言，它是极其强大的尖兵机甲。

column1: The Badger-H carries a Heavy 中型激光 and 锁定式SRM-2 in the turret, while an advanced 瞄准计算机 improves accuracy. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. 装甲： Armor (C) 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 115 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 75 15 炮塔 95 15 总计 465 75 特性：防护机构 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Badger-H在炮塔中携带一门重型中型激光和锁定式SRM-2，先进瞄准计算机提高命中精度。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9格 / 180/270米。 装甲：装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 115 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 75 15 炮塔 95 15 总计 465 75 特性：防护机构 全向载具 可携带1个战斗装甲班，配有射击孔。

column1: The slowest Tank class, but carrying the heaviest 装甲 and biggest weapons. Carrying an array of ranged weapons, the Assault Tank is 设计ed to smash targets at range. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. 装甲: 反射涂层 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 260 40 左侧 230 40 右侧 230 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 215 40 总计 1135 200 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors
column2: 这是最慢的坦克级别，却拥有最厚的装甲和最大的武器；突击坦克携带多种远程武器，旨在从远距离粉碎目标。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5格 / 90/150米。 装甲：反射涂层 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 260 40 左侧 230 40 右侧 230 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 215 40 总计 1135 200 怪癖：改进的传感器

column1: The Hephaestus Scout Tank is an 全向Vehicle produced exclusively by 氏族地狱马. All variants of the Hephaestus incorporate a sizable infantry bay as well as an 主动探头 to locate hidden units. A support variant introduced in 3064, the Hephaestus A mounts an LRM-15 in its turret along with an Artemis IV Fire Control System. A single ton of ammunition does not allow for a high rate of fire for an extended period of time. Supplementing the missile launcher is a single ER Small Laser. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 100 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 90 15 炮塔 90 15 总计 480 75 特性：导弹干扰器 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Hephaestus侦察坦克是氏族地狱马专门生产的全向载具。所有Hephaestus变体都拥有宽敞的步兵舱和用于发现隐藏单位的主动探头。3064年推出的支援型Hephaestus A在炮塔安装LRM-15和Artemis IV火控系统；一吨弹药无法长时间维持高射速，另有一门ER小型激光补充导弹发射器。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12格 / 240/360米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 100 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 90 15 炮塔 90 15 总计 480 75 特性：导弹干扰器 全向载具 可携带1个战斗装甲班，配有射击孔。

column1: The Hephaestus Scout Tank is an 全向Vehicle produced exclusively by 氏族地狱马. All variants of the Hephaestus incorporate a sizable infantry bay as well as an 主动探头 to locate hidden units. The D configuration introduced in 3071 carries a pair of ER 中型激光s in the turret, backed by a pair of AP Gauss Rifles. It carries the expected 主动探头 in the hull, along with an ECM Suite. An expanded five ton infantry bay is also provided. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 100 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 95 15 炮塔 100 15 总计 495 75 特性：导弹干扰器 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Hephaestus侦察坦克是氏族地狱马专门生产的全向载具。所有变体都拥有宽敞步兵舱和主动探头。3071年推出的D型在炮塔安装两门ER中型激光，辅以两支AP高斯步枪；车体内装有主动探头和ECM套件，并提供扩大的5吨步兵舱。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12格 / 240/360米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 100 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 95 15 炮塔 100 15 总计 495 75 特性：导弹干扰器 全向载具 可携带1个战斗装甲班，配有射击孔。

column1: The most common alternate configuration mounts an Ultra AC/20 in the turret, while its front is packed with two medium lasers and one ER Small Laser. It also mounts a C3 slave module. When the Federated Commonwealth was looking for 全向Vehicle designs, 星团工业 quickly gathered a design team and released a prototype in record time. Officially it fulfilled all requirements, but unofficially 星团工业 had greased all the right palms. With every version able to deliver an awesome amount of firepower while being extremely fast for a heavy tank, the Manteuffel is a serious tank to consider. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 235 35 左侧 200 35 右侧 200 35 后方 125 35 炮塔 225 35 总计 985 175 特性：主战坦克 全向 Vehicle
column2: 最常见的替代配置在炮塔安装Ultra AC/20，车头装有两门中型激光和一门ER小型激光，并配备C3从属模块。联邦合众国寻找全向载具设计时，星团工业迅速组建设计团队并在创纪录时间内推出原型。官方说它满足全部要求，私下里则是星团工业打通了所有关系。每个版本都能提供惊人火力，同时对重型坦克而言速度极快，因此Manteuffel是一台值得认真考虑的坦克。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：5/8格 / 150/240米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 235 35 左侧 200 35 右侧 200 35 后方 125 35 炮塔 225 35 总计 985 175 特性：主战坦克 全向载具

column1: First appearing in 3056, the Palisade Defense Tank is a 60-ton defensive 坦克 found throughout the wealthier parts of the Periphery. Based on an older 坦克 设计 dating back to the Succession Wars, the Palisade is 设计ed as a multi-role 坦克 capable of engaging 机甲s or Vehicles. Capable of speeds of 60 km/h, the Palisade (MRM) is powered by a 240-rated Fuel Cell and carries 12 tons of 装甲. The main gun is an LB-10X, with a MRM-20 supporting this at shorter ranges. An MG provides some limited anti-infantry capabilities. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 260 30 左侧 185 30 右侧 185 30 后方 150 30 炮塔 195 30 总计 975 150 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: Palisade防御坦克于3056年首次出现，是外围富裕地区常见的60吨级防御坦克。它基于可追溯到继承战争的老式坦克设计，是能够与机甲或载具交战的多用途坦克。Palisade（MRM）由240级燃料电池驱动，最高速度60公里/小时，携带12吨装甲；主炮为LB-10X，近距离由MRM-20支援，机枪提供有限的反步兵能力。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6格 / 120/180米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 260 30 左侧 185 30 右侧 185 30 后方 150 30 炮塔 195 30 总计 975 150 怪癖：主战坦克

column1: The 黄蜂 was built around the Poland Model C Gauss rifle. Subsequent version mounted other system, but it remained centered around as single heavy weapon. Though not as fast as most VTOLs, the 黄蜂 still has greater speed than most Battle机甲s and Omni机甲s. The long range weapons, respectable speed and relatively heavy 装甲 keep the 车辆 safer than many of it's peers. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 135 15 左侧 95 15 右侧 95 15 后方 60 15 总计 400 75 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - AC
column2: 黄蜂围绕波兰C型高斯步枪建造。后续版本安装了其他系统，但始终以单一重型武器为核心。虽然速度不及大多数垂直起降机，黄蜂仍比大多数战斗机甲和全向机甲更快。远程武器、可靠速度和相对厚重的装甲让车辆比同类更安全。 生物群系限制：该单位因使用ICE无法部署在月球或火星生物群系。 移动：6/9格 / 180/270米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 135 15 左侧 95 15 右侧 95 15 后方 60 15 总计 400 75 怪癖：精准武器—AC

column1: A prototype that only ever entered limited development, the 2G swaps the standard HAG-20 for a Gauss rifle. An XL engine freed up the tonnage needed to mount the rifle and allowed for the incorporation of a light active probe. Needless to say, this wasn’t popular with most the warriors assigned to it. Production was eventually cancelled in 3074, due to unacceptably high losses under combat conditions.
column2: 这是一款仅进入有限开发阶段的原型机。2G 型将标准 HAG-20 换成了高斯步枪。XL 引擎腾出了安装该步枪所需的吨位，并允许加装轻型主动探头。不用说，这并不受大多数被分配驾驶它的战士欢迎。由于实战损失高得无法接受，生产最终于 3074 年取消。

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, even if it may look like a walking trash can. Trading traditional lasers for flamers, it also wields a pair of MMLs help keep enemies off while weaving through urban envrionments.
column2: 别被这台短粗的“小城市”机甲骗了，即使它看起来像一只会走路的垃圾桶。它用火焰喷射器替代传统激光器，还装备了一对 MML，可在穿行城市环境时牵制敌人。

column1: A typical refit seen in the periphery, this is the salvaged remains of multiple Urbanmechs; sheathed in repurposed industrial armour and carrying just enough ammo to survive a battle.
column2: 这是边疆地区常见的典型改装品，由多台 UrbanMech 的残骸拼合而成，外覆再利用的工业装甲，只携带足以撑过一场战斗的弹药。

column1: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60LL replaces its Autocannon 20 with an Ultra version.
column2: R60LL 专为城市近距离作战设计，将 AC/20 替换为 Ultra 版本。

column1: An Urbanmech outfitted with a set of pressurized water canisters, and  directive nozzles. The UM-RFF1 was created in 2700 by Orguss Industries to supplement fire fighting forces dealing with industrial fires and hazardous decontamination scenarios.
column2: 这台 UrbanMech 装有一组加压水罐和定向喷嘴。UM-RFF1 由 Orguss Industries 于 2700 年制造，用于支援处理工业火灾和危险去污任务的消防力量。

column1: Developed on Betelguese by Capellan Confederation scientists in secret on direct orders from Chancellor Liao and later produced by Hellespont Industries in the same star system, the Roncone is a superheavy version of the Battlemaster 4L. The Roncone was an attempt to build on the stealth and ECM capabilities of the Battlemaster 4L, but constant struggles with the sheer size of a Superheavy meant that the stealth was mediocre at best.
column2: Roncone 由卡佩兰联邦科学家在 Betelguese 秘密研发，直接遵照 Chancellor Liao 的命令，之后又由同一星系的 Hellespont Industries 生产，是 Battlemaster 4L 的超重型版本。Roncone 试图继承 Battlemaster 4L 的隐形与 ECM 能力，但超重型机体庞大的尺寸始终难以控制，因此其隐形性能充其量只能算一般。

column1: These Pirates. They always find new ways to amaze me. In that is not in a positive sense, Boss. What the blazes is this thing??
column2: 这些海盗总能找到新方法让我大开眼界——当然是负面的，Boss。这到底是什么鬼东西？？

column1: When Clan Ghost Bear needed a superheavy 'Mech, they took the basic Kodiak concepts and created the Nanook. A 160 ton beast of a 'Mech, fully armored and surprisingly fast thanks to its 460 XXL engine, it is meant to outmaneuver other superheavies before dealing a full on alpha strike. Worth noticing is that the way the internal circuitry of the Nanook is set up, it heavily favours Laser weapons.
column2: 氏族幽灵熊需要超重型机甲时，借鉴 Kodiak 的基本概念制造了 Nanook。这台 160 吨的巨兽装甲齐全，凭借 460 XXL 引擎速度出奇地快；它的战术是在发动全力齐射前先机动压过其他超重型机甲。值得注意的是，Nanook 的内部电路布局极度偏向激光武器。

column1: Developed on Betelguese by Capellan Confderation scientists in secret on direct orders from Chancellor Liao and later produced by Hellespont Industries in the same star system, the Roncone is a superheavy version of the Battlemaster 4L. The Roncone was an attempt to build on the stealth and ECM capabilities of the Battlemaster 4L, but constant struggles with the sheer size of a Superheavy meant that the stealth was mediocre at best.
column2: Roncone 由卡佩兰联邦科学家在 Betelguese 秘密研发，直接遵照 Chancellor Liao 的命令，之后又由同一星系的 Hellespont Industries 生产，是 Battlemaster 4L 的超重型版本。Roncone 试图继承 Battlemaster 4L 的隐形与 ECM 能力，但超重型机体庞大的尺寸始终难以控制，因此其隐形性能充其量只能算一般。

column1: Originally a custom 设计 for a mercenary company, the -7K was well liked enough that it became a standard production model. Two typical PPC provide the main damage together with four 增程LRM-10 launchers. Two Brightbloom ER 中型激光s and one head mounted Intek Small Laser creates the secondary line of weapons together with an arm mounted SRM-4. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.36 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这台 -7K 最初是为一家佣兵公司定制的设计，因广受欢迎而成为标准生产型号。两门标准 PPC 配合四具增程 LRM-10 发射器提供主要火力；两门 Brightbloom 增程中型激光和一门安装在头部的 Intek 小型激光，连同手臂上的 SRM-4，构成次要武器线。 特质：易于维护 投放成本倍率：1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Gullfaxi Omnimonitor was the second project by the 设计 team that made the Gulltoppr for Clan Wolf in Exile and the Lyran Commonwealth. Packing a significant percentage of its predecessors firepower into a smaller and significantly cheaper package. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. 装甲: 装甲 (C) 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 600 105 左侧 500 105 右侧 500 105 后方 400 105 炮塔 400 105 总计 2400 525 怪癖: 泰克铁康TC7000 Omni 车辆
column2: Gullfaxi 全向监视车是为流亡之狼氏族和莱拉联邦制造 Gulltoppr 的设计团队所开展的第二个项目。它将前代产品相当比例的火力装入更小、更便宜的车体。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲： 装甲 (C) 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 600 105 左侧 500 105 右侧 500 105 后方 400 105 炮塔 400 105 总计 2400 525 特质：泰克铁康 TC7000 全向车辆

column1: The Gulltoppr OmniMonitor is a thirty-second century superheavy OmniVehicle. It was first 生产 for the Lyran Commonwealth and Clan Wolf-in-Exile as a defensive garrison unit. The Gulltoppr was 设计ed and manufactured by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal in 3102, the unit was mass 生产 to help fill up worlds on the Clan border. Gulltoppr are mammoth machines that are noted for their impressive firepower and 装甲, but their slow speeds keeps them from being anything more than a defensive combat unit. 设计 to serve as a command 车辆, the B features two C3 boosted master computers and a 守护者ECM suite. The B's weaponry features only two 长 Tom Cannons, with one gun in each of its turrets and eight tons of ammo total. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. 装甲: Hardened 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 470 133 左侧 365 133 右侧 365 133 后方 280 133 炮塔 290 133 总计 1770 665 怪癖: 作战电脑B2000 Omni 车辆
column2: Gulltoppr 全向监视车是三十一世纪的超重型全向车辆。它最初为莱拉联邦和流亡之狼氏族生产，用作防御驻军单位。Gulltoppr 由流亡之狼氏族于 3102 年在 Arc-Royal 设计并制造，随后大规模生产，以填补氏族边境各世界的驻防需求。Gulltoppr 是巨型机器，以惊人的火力和装甲闻名，但缓慢的速度使其只能担任防御作战单位。B 型设计用于指挥车辆，配备两台 C3 增强主计算机和一套守护者 ECM 系统。B 型仅装备两门长钉火炮，每座炮塔各一门，总共携带八吨弹药。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲： Hardened 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 470 133 左侧 365 133 右侧 365 133 后方 280 133 炮塔 290 133 总计 1770 665 特质：作战电脑 B2000 全向车辆
