column1: At 255 tons, the Armageddon Prototype is less a Battle机甲 and more a mobile doomsday device. Built by the 明尼苏达部落, its centerpiece is the Rotary Railgun. A four-shot magnetic cannon so extreme it risks structural failure with each volley. Flanking it are eight compact PPCs, equipped with particle recyclers for increased efficiency, a Fire and Forget 8 for indirect fire and an I-AC/20 linked to an Ares TPS fire-control unit for medium-range precision. But the price for this arsenal is speed. The Armageddon is slow, ponderous, and vulnerable if outmaneuvered. Still, when it arrives on the field, it obliterates any enemy.
column2: Armageddon 原型机重达 255 吨，与其说是战斗机甲，不如说是一台移动末日装置。它由明尼苏达部落建造，核心武器是旋转轨道炮——这种四发磁力炮威力极端，每次齐射都可能导致结构失效。两侧布置八门紧凑型 PPC，配备粒子回收器以提高效率；一门 Fire and Forget 8 用于间接火力；一门 I-AC/20 与 Ares TPS 火控单元连接，用于中距离精确射击。然而，这套武库的代价是速度。Armageddon 缓慢、笨重，被绕到侧翼后会十分脆弱。但只要抵达战场，它就能摧毁任何敌人。

column1: For its weight, this thing is a sturdy wall and folks better watch out when that laser swings around the side of that shield.
column2: 以它的重量而言，这东西简直是一堵坚固的墙；不过大家最好小心那面盾牌侧边扫过来的激光。

column1: This thing is fast and that ion projector thingy-ma-bob concerns the hell out of me.
column2: 这东西速度很快，而那个离子投射器之类的玩意儿让我非常不安。

column1: An improvement over your garden variety Lynx, boss. Between that fancy ERPPC and the improved Large Lasers, this thing packs a punch.
column2: 这是普通 Lynx 的改进型，Boss。那门炫酷的 ERPPC 和改进型大型激光让它火力十足。

column1: This thing may be a bit slow, boss, but this thing seems purpose built to demolish everything in a certain area.
column2: 这东西可能有点慢，Boss，但它显然是专门用来摧毁某一片区域内的一切的。

column1: Boss, whoever gets in this thing's way is braver than me... maybe whoever pilots it as well, we found some handwritten instructions on how you can make popcorn in the cockpit while that TOS is active.
column2: Boss，谁挡在这东西面前都比我勇敢……也许驾驶它的人也是如此。我们还发现了一份手写说明，教你如何在 TOS 启动时待在驾驶舱里爆玉米花。

column1: You'd think that when they went through all of the trouble designing this thing, they would've added an ejection seat.
column2: 你会以为他们费了那么大力气设计这东西，至少该加上一张弹射座椅。

column1: I wouldn't want to be in front of one of those Ion Stream Projectors, let alone two. That'd be' a lot of particles I don't understand flying at me.
column2: 我可不想站在离子流投射器前面，更别说两个了。那会有一大堆我完全不懂的粒子朝我飞来。

column1: It's hard to go wrong with a Wolverine, boss; this one ain't no different. It packs a punch at nearly all typical ranges.
column2: 驾驶 Wolverine 很难出错，Boss；这台也不例外。它几乎能在所有常见射程上造成可观伤害。

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. The Hyperion Prime is a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it is just as fast as an Atlas, carries more armor, and those Heavy Plasma Cannons will slag almost anything.
column2: Boss，我很确定这东西刚才对我咆哮了。Hyperion Prime 真是台可怕的机器：虽然重了 25 吨，却和 Atlas 一样快，装甲更多，那些重型等离子炮几乎能熔毁一切。

column1: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan Omni机甲 that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-Zupport unit in most of its configurations. The ADR-Z only carries a pair of Society-设计 MRM 30s and the hard-mounted Flamers, leaving it vulnerable once the MRMs run dry.
column2: 最初与它交战的内层圈部队给它起了“Puma”的代号。Adder 是一台轻型氏族全向机甲，在大多数配置中担任直接或间接火力支援单位。ADR-Z 只携带一对 Society 设计的 MRM-30 和固定安装的火焰喷射器；MRM 打光后它就会变得十分脆弱。

column1: The Clans upgraded the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. The ZA variant is a Society refit that packs a pair of Tesla Rifles, pair of Medium Supra Lasers, and a Society MRM30.
column2: 氏族不断升级古老的 Griffin 设计，最终诞生了如今称为 Griffin IIC 的战斗机甲。ZA 型是 Society 的改装版本，装备一对 Tesla 步枪、一对 Medium Supra 激光和一具 Society MRM-30。

column1: As a Second-Line mech, the Incubus was a prime candidate for Society engineers to refit into a light mech capable of being integrated into Society formations easily. The Incubus Z drops the Large Pulse Laser for a Large Supra Laser and drops the ER Medium for a Nova CEWS.
column2: 作为二线机甲，Incubus 很适合由 Society 工程师改装成能轻松编入 Society 编队的轻型机甲。Incubus Z 用大型 Supra 激光替换大型脉冲激光，并用 Nova CEWS 替换增程中型激光。

column1: This Society configuration of the Mist Lynx features the a pair of Medium Supra Lasers in the torsos and a pair of Small Supra Lasers in the arms. These advanced weapons combined with the Nova CEWS makes the Mist Lynx Z an effective skirmisher.
column2: 这套 Society 配置的 Mist Lynx 在躯干中装备一对 Medium Supra 激光，手臂中装备一对 Small Supra 激光。这些先进武器与 Nova CEWS 结合，使 Mist Lynx Z 成为高效的游击机甲。

column1: The Z-A is an advanced Society configuration that utilizes a pair of Light Ultra Gauss Rifles and a pair of iATM3s in addition to the Nova CEWS.
column2: Z-A 是 Society 的先进配置，除 Nova CEWS 外，还使用一对轻型 Ultra 高斯步枪和一对 iATM-3。

column1: Named for a shapeshifting Monster of Terran Philippine Folklore, the Aswang 全向Mech employs advanced and experimental technologies, including a mimetic armor, to blend into the night and hunt its victims.
\n
\n特性：AR20 WarFare Suite
\n
\n部署成本倍率：1.02
\n
\n<color=#FFEF00>手臂驱动器限制：全向</color>
column2: Aswang 全向机甲以特兰菲律宾民间传说中会变形的怪物命名，采用包括拟态装甲在内的先进实验技术，能够融入夜色并猎杀受害者。 特质：AR20 WarFare Suite 投放成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Vengeance Industries, attempting to get a foothold in the Market for 全向Mechs, have redesigned the ancient Talos based on 'liberated' blueprints from 范登堡军工. With a focus on easily maintainable parts, they have ensured that it can be repaired with spares from any Talos model. 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Vengeance Industries 试图在全向机甲市场站稳脚跟，于是根据从范登堡军工“解放”出的蓝图重新设计了古老的 Talos。通过采用易于维护的零件，他们确保这台机甲可以使用任何 Talos 型号的备件进行维修。 特质：易于驾驶 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: In an attempt to marry 全向Technology to a Advanced Stealthed 陆空两用机甲 have Shengli Arm's created the 'Berkut' based on recovered Shadowhawk LAM designs. Only being able to mount a limited amount of Slots was the Design still considered a success. 特性：陆空两用机甲 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Shengli Arm 试图将全向技术与先进隐形陆空两用机甲结合，于是根据回收的 Shadowhawk LAM 设计制造了“Berkut”。虽然只能安装有限数量的槽位，但该设计仍被视为成功。 特质：陆空两用机甲 投放成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Recovered and rebuilt by VENS by order of a rather wealthy merc client, this Prototype Atlas 3 was 设计ed to be even more intimidating. According to her wishes, it boasts superior agility barely seen in its class.
column2: 这台 Prototype Atlas 3 由 VENS 根据一位富有佣兵客户的要求回收并重建，旨在显得更加令人畏惧。按照客户的要求，它拥有同级机甲极少见的卓越机动性。

column1: This particular model, already a rare prototype, has seen additional RISC enhancements alongduring its lifetime. This machine is a thing of beauty!
column2: 这台型号本已是罕见原型机，在服役期间又接受了额外的 RISC 强化。这台机器真是美得惊人！

column1: This is a pretty interesting find, boss. Looks like an old SLDF custom. With the way this thing is set up for stealth, as long as you can keep it out of direct line of sight, the enemy'll never even know it's there.
column2: 这是个很有意思的发现，Boss。看起来像是旧 SLDF 定制机。它的隐形配置非常彻底，只要避免进入敌人的直接视线，对方甚至不会知道它在那里。

column1: As far as custom jobs go, this isn't anything too special, Boss. Standard electronic warfare additions, an engine upgrade, et cetera. It's all pretty mundane, except for these Large Pulse Lasers. Probably some kinda early Clan technology, if I had to guess; they're leagues ahead of some of the stuff we usually go through.
column2: 就定制工作而言，这台没什么特别的，Boss。标准电子战组件、引擎升级之类的，整体相当普通，除了这些大型脉冲激光。要我猜的话，它们可能是早期氏族技术，性能远超我们平常接触的某些装备。

column1: Hailing from the punishing arenas of Solaris VII, the Storm Wolf combines the latest and greatest of technology on the Arctic Wolf II Omni Chassis. Capable of quickly traversing the battlefield and exploiting terrain to bring its payload to bear.
column2: Storm Wolf 来自 Solaris VII 残酷的竞技场，将 Arctic Wolf II 全向底盘上最新、最优秀的技术融为一体。它能够迅速穿越战场并利用地形发挥武器载荷。

column1: Big fan of this 'Mech's name. Certainly looks like it'd be one to face down, too. Just be careful with how hot she runs, Boss. She wasn't designed for alpha striking.
column2: 我非常喜欢这台机甲的名字。它看起来确实不好对付。只要注意她运行时的热量，Boss；她不是为全力齐射设计的。

column1: 4 MML Launchers and a Light AC5 in the Centertorso is the Mainstay Weapon of this Mech. It has a Narc发射器 for giving others a Helping Hand, but other than that it does its own Job. Whats more surprising to me is the Reactive Armour and the Endo Composite, both Very Rare and Hard to Install. Theres also a Shield in the 左侧 side, giving it some more Protection from incoming Fire. A Skilled Mechwarrior can do some Real damage with this, if he uses the shield to his Advantage. Sadly theres no Case in this, so if you get hit in the Ammo, the whole Mech is going to Blast off into Space.
column2: 4 具 MML 发射器和安装在中央躯干的轻型 AC/5 是这台机甲的主要武器。它配有 Narc（C）来帮助队友，除此之外基本靠自己作战。更让我惊讶的是反应式装甲和 Endo-Composite，二者都极其稀有且难以安装。左侧还有一面盾牌，可进一步抵御来袭火力。熟练的机甲战士善用盾牌后能用它造成真正的伤害。遗憾的是它没有 CASE，所以一旦弹药被击中，整台机甲都会飞上太空。

column1: That's a lot of SRMs on a 'Mech that knows how to chuck missiles. Not much else to say here, boss. This thing is terrifyin' up close.
column2: 一台会倾泻导弹的机甲上堆了这么多 SRM，Boss。没什么别的可说了——这东西在近距离令人胆寒。

column1: This Omnimech is better in any way compared to its other Models. Upgraded with an XL Engine, Ferro Fibrous and Endo Steel it shows the advantage it gets by Mounting 4 Medium Pulse, 1 Large Pulse and a Narc发射器. While you might think this Weapons Loadout is Underwhelming, the MASC makes it able to Brawl with any other Mech. Its also not as Underarmoured as Normal Clan Mechs, thanks to Blood Spirits different Thinking, so be Prepared. They even Mounted MG's on it to Fend off any Elementals that might come for your Mech.
column2: 这台全向机甲在各方面都优于其他型号。它升级了 XL 引擎、铁纤维装甲和 Endo 钢，安装 4 门中型脉冲激光、1 门大型脉冲激光和 Narc（C），充分体现了这些改进的优势。你也许会觉得这套武器配置不够强，但 MASC 让它能够与任何机甲近身缠斗。由于血誓氏族的理念不同，它不像普通氏族机甲那样装甲不足，所以要做好准备。他们甚至安装了机枪，以击退可能袭击你机甲的 Elemental。

column1: I'm no stranger to the Emperor's reputation to keep lasers running cool, but this is an incredibly ambitious build, even with the improvements to the cooling jackets. That said, I think with some restraint, I could see this thing doing some serious work as direct fire support.
column2: 我很熟悉 Emperor 让激光保持低温的名声，但即使考虑到冷却套的改进，这套构造也极其大胆。话虽如此，只要有所节制，我认为它能胜任严肃的直接火力支援。

column1: Factory refit on Solaris S7 for a Collosseum Champion, this Fafnir forgoes basically all engine power to replace its 移动 with 机甲anical 跳跃放大器s, turning it into something of a Flying 炮塔.
column2: 这是在 Solaris S7 为竞技场冠军进行的工厂改装。该 Fafnir 几乎放弃了全部引擎功率，把机动性换成机械臂，使它变成某种飞行堡垒。

column1: Based on recovered blueprints from the fabled 'Guerilla' was this Gauntlet Commissioned, 设计ed with mobility and long standing firepower in mind does it employ a Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield and a 躯干挂载 Interface System.
column2: 这台 Gauntlet 基于从传奇的“Guerilla”回收的蓝图制造，受命时强调机动性和持久火力，装备了变色龙轻型偏振护盾和机械接口系统。

column1: The Echidnae is one of the most rare and powerful Battlemech's, equipped with carefully preserved LosTech is it able to quickly strike hard and suppress the opposition.
column2: Echidnae 是最稀有、最强大的战斗机甲之一，装备精心保存的失落科技，能够迅速发动猛烈打击并压制敌人。

column1: Whoa! Hold on a second, Boss! You gotta be crazy if you think I'm going to work on something that's making the geiger counters go this nuts! ... Huh. Hazard pay? Hey, Sumire! Where's my hazmat suit?
column2: 哇！等一下，Boss！如果你觉得我会去修理一台让盖革计数器疯狂报警的东西，那你一定疯了！……什么？有危险津贴？嘿，Sumire！我的防护服在哪？

column1: 12 Clan Double Heatsinks and Special PPC Housings make this Jackal excel at using its Light PPC's, while a Streak SRM launcher makes sure it has Short Range capabilities. A Narc (C) and Guardian ECM (C) give it enough to also Support the Lance. The Innersphere XL Engine and XL Gyro make enough Space for all of this.
column2: 12 个氏族双重散热器和特殊 PPC 炮舱让 Jackal 能充分发挥轻型 PPC 的性能；一具 Streak SRM 发射器则提供近距离能力。Narc（C）和守护者 ECM（C）让它还能支援整个小队。内层圈 XL 引擎和 XL 陀螺仪腾出了安装这些设备所需的空间。

column1: 'Mechs like these aren't too much of a surprise. You send some big, heavy metal out to the outer reaches of the Sphere for somebody to use to dig a hole, and somebody's gonna end up pissed off enough to slap a ton of rockets on it.
column2: 这种机甲并不令人意外。你把一堆又大又重的金属送到星圈边缘去挖洞，总会有人气到给它装上一吨火箭。

column1: The Joermungandr, named for the great 'Midgard Serpent' of ancient Norse legend said to herald Ragnarok and bring an end to the Gods, brings a terrifying rain of fire and death to the battlefield.
column2: Joermungandr 以古诺斯传说中预示诸神黄昏、终结众神的巨大“米德加尔特巨蛇”命名，为战场带来令人恐惧的火焰与死亡之雨。

column1: A stolen, rewired, repurposed Marauder-4HB has been upgraded to an extent that is almost unbelievable. Normally these would be fielded by the Marian Hegemony loyalist units, but by God, whoever touched this thing had an ego to rival Seto Kaiba. Instead of the cheap rockets mounted in the torsos, there are iATMs. A LOT of iATMs. Apart from those, the electronics, cooling, engine and gyro have been upgraded. According to the onboard computer records, apparently there are multiple improvements that could be done, but they have been held back by 'Voices' in their head, telling them to put in different things or change that wire with another. Hope this doesn't happen to me while I work on this thing, Boss. I hate ghosts.
column2: 一台被偷走、重新接线并改造的 Marauder-4HB，升级程度几乎令人难以置信。通常这种机甲会由效忠马里安霸权的部队使用，但天知道改造它的人自负得足以和 Seto Kaiba 媲美。他们把躯干上廉价的火箭换成了 iATM——数量多得离谱。此外，电子设备、冷却系统、引擎和陀螺仪也都升级了。根据机载电脑记录，似乎还可以进行多项改进，但改造者脑中的“声音”阻止了他们，要求换装别的东西或把这根线换到另一根上。希望我修理它时不会发生这种事，Boss。我讨厌鬼魂。

column1: Armed with Dual UAC5's in the 右侧 Arm, supported by a Specially modified shoulder to absorb the Recoil better, This Nova Cat is Very dangerous Boss. The 右侧 Torso also Sports Streak LRM's and a 守护者ECM. The 左侧 Torso has 2 Pulse Lasers and a Probe in it. The 左侧 Arm Has a Shield, this makes me Question Things. All in All, this 机甲 seems Extremely out of Touch for Clanners, even if it was made by Blood Spirits.
column2: 右臂装备双 UAC/5，并由经过特殊改造、用于更好吸收后坐力的肩部结构提供支撑，这台 Nova Cat 非常危险，Boss。右侧躯干还装有 Streak LRM 和守护者 ECM；左侧躯干装着两门脉冲激光和一具探头。左臂配有盾牌，这让我开始怀疑人生。总的来说，这台机甲对氏族人而言极不寻常，即使它由血誓氏族制造也是如此。

column1: A Periphery Refit of a 4FX, Purpose Built to run into the Action, and go Guns Blazing. The amount of Rockets on this 机甲 may unsettle some People, but the Real Pain comes packed together with the Flamers. There are also some Fluid Guns hidden in this 机甲, who even 设计 this Monstrosity? The 长er i Look the worse it Gets. Please dont come back with this 机甲.
\n
\n怪癖: 稳定
\n
\n掉落成本乘数: 1.15
\n
\n<color=#FFEF00>Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower</color>
column2: 这是一台 4FX 的边疆改装型，专门用于冲入战场并火力全开。这台机甲上堆满的火箭可能让一些人不安，但真正的痛苦来自与火焰喷射器组合的攻击。机体里还藏着几门流体炮——到底是谁设计出这种怪物的？我越看越糟。请别再把这台机甲带回来。 特质：坚韧 投放成本倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Based on the popular Roughneck from Achernar Industries was this variant rebuild using Advanced Technologies, typical for Solaris sporting a massive first strike capabilities is it extremely reliant on Ballistic Weapons.
column2: 这款型号以 Achernar Industries 的热门 Roughneck 为基础，采用 Solaris 常见的先进技术重建，具备强大的首轮打击能力，并高度依赖弹道武器。

column1: Whoever got this refit done loved their Shadow Hawk, Boss. This ain't the type of gear you commission for just your regular rank and file. Hell, some of this stuff would've been a nightmare to get if you weren't Star League. Our original owner here was well-connected, that's for sure.
column2: 这次改装的人显然非常喜欢 Shadow Hawk，Boss。这可不是普通士兵能申请到的装备。有些东西要不是在星盟时期，弄到手简直是噩梦。原主人肯定人脉很广。

column1: How do we keep coming across tricked out custom jobs like this, Boss? It's like every crackpot mercenary group has their own factory sitting planetside or something. What? Don't gimmie that look - the Argo's different!
column2: 我们怎么总能遇到这种改得面目全非的定制机，Boss？简直像每个异想天开的佣兵团都在行星地面有自己的工厂似的。什么？别这么看我——Argo 不一样！

column1: A Light Engine with a 140 Core Make this Stinger faster than its Predecessors. More Armour and Clan Endo Steel make Sure it can fit all of the Upgrades, while the Weapons make sure it stays where its supposed to. 16 Double Heatsinks Cool this stinger, additionally the Lasers are all connected to Laser insulators. This Mech would be a goddamn Sauna if not for all of this. Oh, and dont forget the Laser AMS, gotta stop those LRM's somehow.
column2: 140 核心的轻型引擎让这台 Stinger 比前代更快。更多装甲和氏族 Endo 钢确保它能容纳所有升级，武器则保证它待在该待的位置。16 个双重散热器为这台 Stinger 降温，所有激光器还连接到激光绝缘器。要不是这些设备，这台机甲简直就是该死的桑拿房。对了，别忘了激光 AMS，总得想办法拦住那些 LRM。

column1: The Eris, named after the Terran Goddess of Chaos and Strife, is capable of delivering a stunning long range blow that can unexpectedly crush all but the most capable Combatants.
column2: Eris 以特兰的混乱与纷争女神命名，能够在远距离发动惊人打击，出其不意地击溃除最强悍战士之外的几乎所有敌人。

column1: 托罗于2546年生产，是金牛座协约的第一款战斗机甲设计。它以缴获的萤火虫为基础，是一款远程支援机甲，装有一门粒子加农炮和一对LRM-5，带两吨弹药和10个单散热器。最后一座托罗工厂于2598年被入侵的星际联盟部队拆毁，生产直到布莱克之词圣战才恢复。 Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这台机甲于 2546 年设计，是 SLDF 的第一批战斗机甲之一。它以远程支援为主，装备一门轻型 AC/5、一具 LRM-5 发射器、10 个散热器和一门小型激光。2598 年该型号被认为过时并退出服役，直到圣战后才被重新启用。 特质：灵巧 投放成本倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Coming straight from the bloody sands of Solaris; this Warhammer refit carries a mix of Advanced and Experimental technology, including a genuine Interface Cockpit, alongside Advanced Cooling tech.
column2: 这台 Warhammer 改装机直接来自 Solaris 的血腥沙场，搭载先进与实验技术，包括真正的接口驾驶舱，以及先进冷却技术。

column1: Pretty standard fare for these Star League upgrades. Buncha SRMs and some medlas. If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
column2: 这类星盟升级品基本都一个样：一堆 SRM 和几门中型激光。没坏就别修。

column1: Boss, this thing has had some serious RISC technical upgrades. It has had most weapons stripped from it in favor of two RISC MML-10 systems in the torsos along with an Artemis IV control system.
column2: Boss，这台机甲接受了大规模 RISC 技术升级。大多数武器都被拆除，换成躯干中的两套 RISC MML-10 系统和一套 Artemis IV 控制系统。

column1: A RISC Derivative of the BLK-10, exchanging its shield for a Medium Vibroblade and employing 2 Streak MML backed up by a Snub Nose PPC and a RAC5.
column2: 这是 BLK-10 的 RISC 衍生型，用中型振动刀替换了盾牌，并配备 2 具 Streak MML，由短管 PPC 和 RAC/5 提供支援。

column1: Boss...  What were these Institute guys thinking? This has to be the strangest looking Land Air 'Mech you've brought to my Mechbay. But I'll be damned if I don't see the appeal. It's fast as hell for a 65 ton LAM in its preferred mode, and has a LOT of bombs. Mad Bomber, indeed.
column2: Boss……这些研究所的人到底在想什么？这是你带进我的机甲库里外形最奇怪的陆空两用机甲。但不得不说，它确实有吸引力。在偏好的模式下，对于一台 65 吨的 LAM 来说它快得离谱，而且炸弹多得惊人。Mad Bomber，名副其实。

column1: The Hammer is a 'Mech that was built to provide fire support for light 'Mechs. Redesigned with a low tier Stealth suite was this version redesigned as a short range brawler.
column2: Hammer 是一台为轻型机甲提供火力支援而建造的机甲。这一版本重新设计并配备低等级隐形套件，改造成了近距离斗士。

column1: This 'Mech was made for punching, and thats just what it'll do, and one of these days, it's gonna be punching you....
column2: 这台机甲就是为了挥拳而生，而它也确实只会做这一件事；总有一天，它的拳头会落到你身上……

column1: Yeah Boss, this is a big old Mackie, but every piece of it was upgraded, even the bloody Access Hatches uses proprietary Parts!
column2: 没错，Boss，这是一台老 Mackie，但它的每个部件都升级过，甚至连该死的舱口都使用专有零件！

column1: Built with experimental RISC Technology, this Mauler excels at dealing extreme alpha strikes at all ranges.
column2: 这台 Mauler 采用实验性的 RISC 技术建造，擅长在所有射程发动极端的全力齐射。

column1: Boss, I hope you don't plan on piloting this yourself.  A round penetrates the armor, and you could see limbs fly off. I heard the designer in charge of this was in a relationship with a test pilot's sibling, and wanted to eliminate the test pilot for some inheritance scheme. It ended up wiping a whole class of test pilots, but missed the one the designer wanted.  Infuriated, the designer took the mech out for a test, hoping to crush the test pilot as they were examining a Roadrunner, and blew themselves up. So, uhh, guess the moral of the story is... don't date coworkers? Or maybe keep an eye on your heat? Don't be greedy?
column2: Boss，希望你没打算亲自驾驶它。只要一发炮弹穿透装甲，你就可能看到四肢飞出去。我听说负责设计的人与试飞员的兄弟姐妹谈恋爱，为了某个继承计划想除掉试飞员。结果整批试飞员都被干掉，却唯独漏掉了目标。设计师恼羞成怒，亲自驾驶机甲测试，趁试飞员检查 Roadrunner 时想把对方碾碎，结果把自己炸上了天。所以这故事的寓意是……别和同事约会？或者注意热量？别太贪心？

column1: A Waukheon? You just know those Wobbies had a hand in this. The T74 is a 'decapitation' design, built for high-speed high-priority-target raiding behind enemy lines. It's fielding a surprisingly heavy EWAR loadout, including a custom Stealth armor that worked with the transformation mechanism (though rumors abound about the right leg's stealth armor being of poorer quality, to the point of not existing, despite being identical to the left leg's). The weaponry equipped is niche, as to be expected: MML's with Acid ammo, and MG arrays with AP ammo; perfect for melting the armor off of command vehicles behind enemy lines.
column2: Waukheon？你就知道这一定有那些 Wobbies 的手笔。T74 是一款“斩首”设计，用于高速突袭敌后高价值目标。它配备了出人意料的重型电子战套件，包括与变形机构配合的定制隐形装甲（不过传闻右腿的隐形装甲质量很差，甚至根本不存在，尽管它和左腿完全相同）。武器配置很专门：装填酸性弹药的 MML，以及装填穿甲弹的机枪阵列；非常适合剥掉敌后指挥车辆的装甲。

column1: After the 布雷克圣言会 was defeated in the Jihad, Maxwell-Pulaski Motors modified the design slightly and produced it for the 球体共和国 in 3084.[9] The main differences are the removal of its Blakist features. The infantry bay was reduced to four tons, and the C3i system was replaced by a C3 slave unit. The machine gun ammunition was reduced to half a ton. All these changes increased the pod space available to the RAF Bollas by four and a half tons, but the turret can only mount fifteen tons of equipment. The 隐身装甲 was retained, as was the 守护者ECM suite. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. 装甲： 车辆潜行装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 200 30 左侧 160 30 右侧 160 30 后方 150 30 炮塔 210 30 总计 880 150 特性：Off Roader 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads.
column2: Jihad 中击败 Blakist 圣战军后，Maxwell-Pulaski Motors 对该设计略作修改，于 3084 年为 RAF 生产。主要变化是移除 Blakist 特征：步兵舱缩减为四吨，C3i 系统替换为 C3 从属单元，机枪弹药减至半吨。这些改动为 RAF Bollas 增加了四吨半的舱位，但炮塔最多只能安装十五吨设备。原有装甲和守护者 ECM 套件得以保留。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：5/8 格 / 150/240 米。 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 200 30 左侧 160 30 右侧 160 30 后方 150 30 炮塔 210 30 总计 880 150 特质：越野 全向车辆 可搭载 1 个战斗装甲小队。

column1: Boss, this is a RISC overhaul of an already strong support unit converting it to a direct support role.
column2: Boss，这是一台本就强大的支援单位经过 RISC 彻底改造后的版本，转而承担直接支援任务。

column1: An all-rounder mech from Quicsell. It's only got SRMs, but those are pretty versatile. It would technically be cooking itself, if it weren't for the fact that half the missiles are used as temporary Streak modules for the other half, meaning only successful target locks get launched. Watch that engine though, one side torso, and the mech's toast.
column2: Quicsell 的全能型机甲。它只有 SRM，但这些导弹用途很广。严格来说它会把自己煮熟，因为一半导弹被临时当作另一半的 Streak 模块使用，只有成功锁定目标的那部分才会发射。不过要盯紧引擎：只要一侧躯干出问题，这台机甲就完了。

column1: A surprisingly decent headhunter and pigeon shooter. Those so called 'LBX' lasers may silly, but they can certaily hit their intended target... with at least some of the power of a decent laser. So long as you're firing at soft and evasive foes, this thing actually stands a decent chance of killing them.
column2: 一台出人意料的优秀猎头机和打鸟机。那些所谓的“LBX”激光看起来很可笑，但确实能击中目标——至少还能发挥出普通激光的一部分威力。只要攻击脆弱且善于闪避的敌人，它其实很有机会把对方干掉。

column1: I don't believe it. A Quicsell mech that actually does a decent job that the original was designed for! This Black Knight is almost worthy of the name. The long range damage is piss poor thanks to those 'REX' lasers, but it's a nasty brawler.
column2: 我不敢相信。Quicsell 居然造出了一台真正完成原设计任务的机甲！这台 Black Knight 几乎配得上这个名字。由于“REX”激光，远程伤害糟糕透顶，但它是个凶狠的近战斗士。

column1: This thing is terrifying, boss. While it's a poor excuse for an assault mech in several areas, you do not want to be down range of this thing when it fires. It can spit PPC flavored death at you all day long. On the other hand, if you charge the thing, it's as helpless as a 80 ton bipedal machine can be.
column2: 这东西太可怕了，Boss。虽然它在几个方面都算不上合格的突击机甲，但你绝对不想站在它的射界里。它可以整天向你喷吐 PPC 形态的死亡。另一方面，只要你冲到它身边，它就会像一台 80 吨的双足机器一样无助。

column1: This entire mech is built around Quicsell's so called 'Gauss' rifle. And yes, it needs the quotes. It works by using twice the powder of a normal AC2 round, and loading the thing into a massively overbuilt firing chamber needed to contain the blast. Even then, the AC2 rounds just arn't 设计ed for those velocities, and you can expect a significant damage drop-off over the range of the gun.
column2: 整台机甲都围绕 Quicsell 所谓的“高斯”步枪构建。没错，引号不能省。它把普通 AC/2 炮弹两倍的装药量塞进一个为承受爆炸而过度加固的炮膛。即便如此，AC/2 炮弹也不是为这种速度设计的，因此炮弹在射程上的伤害衰减会非常明显。

column1: The EWS on this mech are actually decent for a Quicsell product. Through sheer tonnage, if nothing else. It's a pretty decent all-rounder, but you need to know how to use those lasers. The long range damage drops off to nothing, and they're no good against structure, so stripping off armor from nearby fast moving targets is their bread and butter.
column2: 这台机甲的 EWS 对 Quicsell 产品而言其实还不错，哪怕只是靠巨大的吨位撑起来的。它是相当可靠的全能型机甲，但你得知道如何使用那些激光。远程伤害会衰减到几乎为零，而且它们对结构无效，所以剥掉附近高速目标的装甲才是它们的拿手好戏。

column1: This is a loot pinata, boss. Most of the gear is crap, but Quicsell had to import the light engine and the specialist missile ammunition so if nothing else, make sure to grab those. Other than that, it's a decent all-around 25 ton mech, but nothing special.
column2: 这是台战利品宝箱，Boss。大多数装备都是垃圾，但 Quicsell 不得不进口轻型引擎和特殊导弹弹药，所以无论如何记得把它们拆下来。除此之外，它是一台不错的 25 吨全能机甲，但没什么特别之处。

column1: It's a pretty standard MRM mech. A bit faster than normal for a heavy mech, but not too far out of the bounds of normal. On the one hand, you've got to keep an eye out for that XL vulnerability, since I can't replace the engine. On the other hand, if I need to fix the damn thing again, at least it won't hurt the pocket books as much as installing a new one from scratch.
column2: 这是一台相当标准的 MRM 机甲。对于重型机甲来说它比通常型号稍快，但仍在合理范围内。一方面，你得留意 XL 引擎的脆弱性，因为我没法替换引擎；另一方面，如果我又得修这该死的东西，至少不会像从零安装新引擎那样掏空钱包。

column1: A very survivable mech. It's got Quicsell's special armor (which doesn't say much), and it's got a lot of it. About as much as the mech can carry, to be honest. Those missiles aren't that bad either. Swap out the Quicsell name brand stuff for the good stuff, and you'll have a decent mech. Just... Uh. Don't ask me to touch that damn engine.
column2: 这台机甲非常耐用。它有 Quicsell 的特殊装甲（不过这说明不了什么），而且装甲很多，老实说已经接近机体承载上限。那些导弹也不算太差。把 Quicsell 的品牌货换成真正的好东西，你就会得到一台不错的机甲。只是……呃，别让我碰那该死的引擎。

column1: This thing is just silly, boss. One half of the mech is just full of heatsinks. I don't think there's a single heatsink left in the engine itself, which has been stripped down the the very minimum required to run a mech this size. All to fit two of those knock-off artillery pieces into a light mech, for some reason I cannot fathom.
column2: 这东西简直荒谬，Boss。机体一半空间全塞了散热器。我怀疑引擎里一个散热器都没留下，只保留了让这种尺寸的机甲运转所需的最低配置。就为了把两门仿制火炮塞进轻型机甲，我实在无法理解。

column1: Another decent all-rounder from Quicsell. So long as you mind the very low stability from those leg actuator replacements, and keep an eye on your heat when enemies are packing flamers, you should do alright.
column2: Quicsell 另一台不错的全能型机甲。只要注意那些腿部驱动器替换件带来的极低稳定性，并留意敌人使用火焰喷射器时的热量，你应该能应付。

column1: I don't believe it. Quicsell actually made a normal, basic mech! Sure, it a bit undergunned and over-tuned for speed, but it's actually decent at what it does, which is move sixty tons of metal around really fast. If you can find a real double heatsink kit, it would allow you to get better cooling, but there's not all that much to complain about here.
column2: 我不敢相信。Quicsell 居然造出了一台正常的基础机甲！当然，它火力略显不足、速度调校过头，但确实擅长把 60 吨金属高速搬来搬去。如果能找到真正的双重散热器套件，就能改善冷却；不过除此之外也没什么好抱怨的。

column1: This certainly meet the requirements of a 'support mech'. As in, it shouldn't be anywhere close to combat. It's a mine-layer, and that's all it does. While it does have two tons of deadfire LRMs for if an enemy is charging, it's accuracy is crap with those LRM launchers and the shortened arm servos.
column2: 这确实符合“支援机甲”的要求——也就是说，它根本不该靠近战斗。它是一台布雷机甲，除此之外什么也不会。虽然它携带两吨死火 LRM，以防敌人冲锋，但这些 LRM 发射器和缩短的手臂伺服机构让它的准确度糟糕透顶。

column1: This thing may be sold as an E-war mech, but that's no excuse to only give it one gun. If I were you I'd rip out some of the unnecessary weight and give it some proper weaponry. Oh, and watch that left arm, the whole thing is packed with ammo.
column2: 这东西可以被宣传成电子战机甲，但这可不是只给它一把枪的借口。如果我是你，我会拆掉一些多余重量，给它装上真正的武器。还有，盯紧左臂，整条手臂都塞满了弹药。

column1: Despite the thin armor and lack of weapon variety, this one is nasty. That Heavy Large Chem Laser can rip through other lights like a hot knife through butter. If you see one in the field, make sure you prioritize it with a shot or two in order to set off it's ammo.
column2: 尽管装甲薄、武器种类少，这台机甲依然很凶。那门重型大型化学激光能像热刀切黄油一样撕开其他轻型机甲。要是在战场上遇到它，务必优先开火，争取引爆它的弹药。

column1: For a so called medium mech, Quicsell has done their best to make a heavy mech with this one. While it's not very fast, and that XL ICE is an affront to engineering, the foundations are solid. Good rookie mech, since it's very hard to kill; although they may fall over a lot, thanks to those unstable leg replacements.
column2: 对于一台所谓的中型机甲，Quicsell 已经尽力把它做成重型机甲了。它速度不快，那台 XL ICE 更是工程学的耻辱，但基础结构很扎实。它很适合新手，因为很难被摧毁；不过腿部不稳定替换件可能让驾驶员经常摔倒。

column1: 快售深知机师们喜欢火焰，并很乐意提供. BSW-QSK将快售最新推出的两件等离子武器——等离子散射枪——保证能熔化任何对手——带到了战场上. 在那片火海中仍然屹立的目标？我们还配了一门轻型迫击炮和REX激光，帮助清理残余. 我们经典的视界大师驾驶舱提供最广阔的视野，让机师沉醉于烈焰之美！请不要使用快售的设备组建任何可能导致我们收到措辞严厉信函的团体. 是的——包括“极限”烤棉花糖俱乐部. 不过请把烤棉花糖寄给我们. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂
column2: 这台机甲似乎迎合了设计师的奇怪喜好，装备了能在近距离消灭敌人的散射武器和 REX 激光。它的近战表现很差，但可以通过接口驾驶舱提供支援。警告：请不要使用该设备，否则可能导致严重后果。 特质：狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左前、右前

column1: This Pirate version of the Hoplite includes multiple methods of interfering with another '机甲's entire kit. It comes with a Taser, a Harpoon, and a pair of Fluid Guns that can spray a selection of chemicals on enemy units. It's equipped with a 机甲anical Jump Jet system to get it in and out of range of its targets.
\n
\n怪癖: Distracting
\n
\n掉落成本乘数: 1.03
\n
\n<color=#FFEF00>Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper</color>
column2: 这台 Hoplite 海盗版本具备多种干扰另一台机甲整套装备的方法。它配备 Taser、鱼叉和一对流体炮，可向敌方单位喷洒多种化学物质；还装有机械跳跃喷射系统，以便进出目标射程。 特质：分心 投放成本倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Yeah this was a Talos, until someone came along who self proclaimed 'Don't Care', and christened it the Honey Badger. That prototype armor can take an insane amount of punishment, built to withstand even direct hits from heavy ordnance.
column2: 没错，这原本是一台 Talos，直到有人自称“我不在乎”，给它取名 Honey Badger。那套原型装甲能承受疯狂的打击，甚至经得住重型军械的直接命中。

column1: Boss, this thing is meant to put some serious hurt on other units through FIRE! It's got a special Fire Control System that some yahoo hardwired into the LAM that somehow causes it to toss out some type of Plasma with each shot it fires.
column2: Boss，这东西就是要靠火力给其他单位造成严重伤害！它装有一套特殊火控系统，某个蠢货把它硬接进 LAM，结果每次开火都会以某种方式喷出等离子。

column1: I'm at a loss for words, boss. I don't even know what this is. I'm not sure I wanna know what this is. So, this is - or was - a Phoenix Hawk model 1. Somebody's given it wings, and a gun. And a knife. Why does it have a knife? And why does it have "P-HAWK WITH SHIV" stamped onto the torso armor?
column2: 我无话可说，Boss。我甚至不知道这是什么，也不确定自己想不想知道。它原本——或者说曾经——是 Phoenix Hawk 1 型。有人给它装了翅膀、一门炮和一把刀。为什么会有刀？为什么躯干装甲上还印着“P-HAWK WITH SHIV”？

column1: Would'cha look at this! Not only did they salvage and abuse a perfectly fine Hatchetman, they've put spikes all over it, even the Hatched got cut and filed down to be 'Spikey'....
column2: 你看看这个！他们不仅拆解并糟蹋了一台完好的 Hatchetman，还在上面到处焊尖刺，甚至把 Hatchet 本身切削锉磨成了“尖刺”……

column1: The Anzu was well-regarded by both 机甲Warriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had 开发 since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard 装甲 with CASE II built in to protect the '机甲 and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Anzu 因可靠性而受到机甲战士和技术人员的一致好评；自圣战以来，AMSC 采用的激进战术都证明 Anzu 非常合适。虽然 Anzu 的最高地面速度只有 64 km/h，但 Chilton 465 跳跃喷射器可让它跃过 120 米。Anzu 装有 11 吨 Starshield A 标准装甲，并内置 CASE II，以保护机甲和驾驶员免受弹药爆炸伤害。Anzu 还使用与 Shadow Hawk 相同、在其服役时已得到充分验证的生命维持系统；RCA Instatrac Mark X 目标与追踪系统则允许它同时攻击多个目标，并通过安装的 TAG 为间接火力提供目标标记。 特质：多重追踪 投放成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: This only really has one weapon, but it's a scary one! I don't know what voodoo the pirates worked on that AC/20, but I think I can hear it chanting quietly to itself in the mechbay.
column2: 它实际上只有一件武器，但那件武器非常吓人！我不知道海盗对那门 AC/20 施了什么巫术，但我觉得自己能听见它在机甲库里轻声吟唱。

column1: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. This one was refitted by a bunch of Pirates with some help of whatever goes as Moonshine among them.
column2: Black Knight 6B 是标准 BL-6-KNT 的星盟祖先，火力更强、运行更凉爽。这一台被一群海盗改装过，还加入了他们所谓的“月光酒”提供的帮助。

column1: This 'was' a K2 Catapult, but somehow they screwed Rifleman parts into the Arms and made it a Ballistic Carrier....
column2: 它“曾经”是一台 K2 Catapult，但不知怎么的，他们把 Rifleman 部件硬塞进手臂，把它改成了弹道武器载体……

column1: Based upon Shankey, a Frankenmech, this variant carries a mortar and srm instead of the large laser.
column2: 这台型号以 FrankenMech Shankey 为基础，用一门迫击炮和一具 SRM 替换了大型激光。

column1: Extremely well armored and armed for a Griffin, this pirate refit is a mish-mash of both jury rigged and experimental technologies.
column2: 对于 Griffin 而言，这台海盗改装机的装甲和武器都强得离谱，混合使用了临时拼装和实验技术。

column1: Yeah Well Boss, this is a Hollander, or whats left of it, they replaced the myomer and stabilizers with some Industrial Junk and completely ruined the Weapon Assembly.
column2: 没错，Boss，这是一台 Hollander，或者说还剩下的部分。他们用工业废料替换了肌电束和稳定器，还彻底毁掉了武器组件。

column1: The Kraken may be made by pirates welding different Crab parts together but it's surprisingly well made, though theres some profanity's etched in the chassis towards their ''Queen''.
column2: Kraken 也许是海盗把不同 Crab 部件焊在一起造出来的，但成品出奇地精良；只是底盘上刻着一些针对他们那位“女王”的脏话。

column1: Boss, what did you bring me this time?!? This thing is barely funcional, and it can't mount much of anything but missiles. Whatever yokel refit this thing absolutely LOVED his rockets, to the point that there is a sticker plastered on the cockpit viewscreen that just says 'Rocket Man'.
column2: Boss，你这次又带了什么回来？！这东西几乎无法正常工作，除了导弹之外什么都装不了。不管哪个乡巴佬改装了它，他肯定极度热爱火箭，甚至在驾驶舱视窗上贴了一张只写着“Rocket Man”的贴纸。

column1: Whatever pirates were responsible for this refit, they did a better job than most. This high-tech armor has been kept in good shape, and most of the equipment is totally functional. Just don't look too hard at that "HPCS" they've bolted in there.
column2: 负责这次改装的海盗无论是谁，都比大多数人做得好。这套高科技装甲保养良好，大部分设备也完全可用。只是别太仔细看他们用螺栓固定进去的那个“HPCS”。

column1: The 2D variant of the Argus was the original Argus configuration, designed as a long range support mech. Outfitted for long range combat at extreme ranges, it carried a pair of Artemis IV enhanced LRM 15s and an ER PPC.
column2: Argus 的 2D 型是最初的 Argus 配置，定位为远程支援机甲。它为极远距离作战而装备，搭载两具 Artemis IV 增强型 LRM-15 和一门增程 PPC。

column1: Bigger is better, right, Boss? The Ultra AC/20 leaves a lot bigger holes than a Gauss rifle. Boom, boom!
column2: 越大越好，对吧，老大？Ultra AC/20 打出的窟窿比高斯步枪更大。轰、轰！

column1: The -02 variant is designed as a missile boat, replacing the Ultra AC/10s with two Doombud LRM-20s, three tons of ammo for each, and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: -02 型被设计成导弹艇，用两具 Doombud LRM-20 替换 Ultra AC/10，每具配备三吨弹药，并加装两门中型脉冲激光器。

column1: Fighting against the powers of the Inner Sphere brought several harsh realities to light for Clan Jade Falcon, with one of the most glaring being their lack of effective reconnaissance and electronic warfare units in their touman. In an effort to rectify this issue, Jade Falcon engineers were tasked with upgrading the venerable Ostscout to Clan standards in 3063 and their prototype, dubbed the Ostscout IIC, displayed several excellent qualities for a scouting unit. These included being able to outpace even the infamous Fire Moth despite weighing 15 tons more, as well as a nearly 400 meter jump distance thanks to the coupling of a high volume of eleven jump jets with a Partial Wing.
column2: 与内圈各势力作战让 Jade Falcon 氏族看清了几项残酷现实，其中最明显的是其 touman 缺乏有效的侦察和电子战单位。为解决这个问题，Jade Falcon 工程师在 3063 年将老牌 Ostscout 升级为氏族规格，原型被称为 Ostscout IIC，展现出优秀的侦察性能：虽然重 15 吨，却能超过臭名昭著的 Fire Moth；十一具高容量跳跃喷射器配合部分机翼，还能实现近 400 米的跳跃距离。

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. The main weapon, a Streak SRM-4, is very conservative with its ammunition, while the ER Micro Laser provides a weapon that isn't tied to logistical bases.
column2: Triton 由 Goliath Scorpion 氏族为其搜索者设计。主武器 Streak SRM-4 对弹药非常节省，而增程微型激光器则提供了不依赖后勤基地的武器。

column1: Developed during the 3060s, this model was designed to take on the role of a command unit. To that end, the 'Mech is equipped with a C3 Master Computer in its left torso, replacing the original LRM-10. The weight saved by removing the LRM ammunition goes towards an additional double heat sink.
column2: 该型号在 3060 年代开发，定位为指挥单位。为此，机甲在左侧躯干安装 C3 主计算机，替换原有的 LRM-10；拆除 LRM 弹药节省的重量用于增加一组双散热器。

column1: the Catapult II C7 is a unique and rare variant, sporting a integrated Chameleon Light Polarization Suite and advanced Jump Systems is it able to deliver a Devastating Blow Anywhere at Anytime.
column2: Catapult II C7 是独特而稀有的变体，集成 Chameleon Light Polarization Suite 和先进跳跃系统，能够在任何地点、任何时间发动毁灭性打击。

column1: The Exhumer is a medium BattleMech first produced for the Draconis Combine in the third decade of the thirty-second century. The 'Mech was first advocated to enter the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery by Benjamin District Warlord Mitsura Sakamoto, who felt that the design would become a mainstay of the Combine's Armed forces. With the Warlord's backing, the 'Mech would finally enter service with its first production models joining the 2nd Benjamin Regulars in 3129. However, early engagements using the 'Mech by frontline forces would prove disastrous due to a flaw in the Exhumer's targeting systems. The 'Mech orders from DCMS were subsequently canceled, shuffling the produced units to sale in the mercenary market.
column2: Exhumer 是一台中型 BattleMech，于三十二世纪第三个十年首次为 Draconis Combine 生产。Benjamin 区军阀 Mitsura Sakamoto 首先倡议将它编入 Draconis Combine 军队，认为该设计会成为联合部队的主力。在军阀支持下，首批量产机终于于 3129 年加入第 2 Benjamin 常备团。然而，前线部队早期使用它作战时，目标锁定系统的缺陷造成了灾难性后果。DCMS 随后取消订单，将已生产单位转售给佣兵市场。

column1: The I configuration, popularized by Star Commander Lauren Hawker, features an ER PPC paired with a capacitor in the left arm, and two Rotary Autocannon/2s in the right arm to exploit holes opened up by the PPC.
column2: I 型配置由星际指挥官 Lauren Hawker 推广：左臂的增程 PPC 配有电容器，右臂则有两门旋转自动火炮/2，用来利用 PPC 撕开的装甲缺口。

column1: After the Draconis Combine captured Quentin and the Raijin lines production facilities, they modified and rebranded the 'Mech Fujin for both export and use by the DCMS.
column2: Draconis Combine 俘获 Quentin 及 Raijin 生产设施后，对这台机甲进行了改造并重新命名为 Fujin，供出口和 DCMS 使用。

column1: This Dark Age era configuration carries a pair of Clan-spec ER PPC and an LB 10-X autocannon. These are supported by four Medium Re-engineered Lasers.
column2: 这套黑暗时代配置携带两门氏族规格的增程 PPC 和一门 LB 10-X 自动火炮，另有四门中型重构激光器提供支援。

column1: Introduced to service in 3133 from the Achernar BattleMechs plant on New Avalon, the Vulpes was intended from the outset to be a heavy but fast attack BattleMech, and was quickly adopted by the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns.
column2: Vulpes 于 3133 年在 New Avalon 的 Achernar BattleMechs 工厂投入服役。它从一开始就被设计成厚重但高速的攻击型 BattleMech，并迅速被联邦太阳军队采用。

column1: Meant for work at longer ranges than the previous variants, the main guns of the Luminos are a pair of ER PPCs. Jump jets give it the ability to maneuver to a good position to snipe from more quickly, while a Guardian ECM Suite provides added defense. In case an enemy gets close, the Archangel D can utilize four Medium Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a Small Pulse Laser that is devastating to unarmored infantry.
column2: Luminos 的主炮是两门增程 PPC，定位远距离作战，射程超过此前的变体。跳跃喷射器让它能更快机动到适合狙击的位置，Guardian ECM 套件则提供额外防御。敌人逼近时，Archangel D 还能使用四门中型脉冲激光器、一门增程小型激光器和一门对无装甲步兵极具杀伤力的小型脉冲激光器。

column1: An experimental upgrade of the prototype K3, this Kuritan variant carries twin Heavy and Light PPCs linked to a Prototype Capacitor.
column2: 这是原型 K3 的实验升级型，Kurita 变体携带两门重型 PPC 和两门轻型 PPC，并由原型电容器联动。

column1: It seems the Underwater Maneuvering Units have been removed and the torpedo tubes replaced with missile launchers, otherwise this is standard Crossbow U configuration.
column2: 水下机动单元似乎已被拆除，鱼雷管也被导弹发射器替换；除此之外，这仍是标准的 Crossbow U 配置。

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The A variant was geared for general combat.
column2: Deimos 由 Snow Raven 氏族开发，于 3060 年代中期首次亮相，据称地点是 Kerensky Cluster 的 Lum 世界。然而，圣战期间内圈情报机构不再听到关于这台机甲的消息，它逐渐被遗忘。3085 年，Snow Raven 向内圈公开了 Deimos 的存在。它被视为氏族制造业的骄傲，每个 touman 至少配备一台。A 型针对常规作战优化。

column1: First appearing in December 3077, save for different component manufacturers, utilizing Donal model snub-nosed PPCs for example, the sole notable difference between the Word of Blake Eidolon and the Yao Lien was the use of C3i.
column2: 除了采用不同厂商的部件（例如 Donal 型短管 PPC）外，3077 年 12 月首次出现的 Word of Blake Eidolon 与 Yao Lien 的唯一显著区别，就是使用了 C3i。

column1: Another proof of the Blakists going at it. Double Heavy PPC on this 'Mech is asking a lot of the pilot, having to juggle all that heat management with everything else. But it sure will get the job done a lot of the times with that alpha strike.
column2: 又是 Blakist 的疯狂作品。这台机甲上的两门重型 PPC 对驾驶员要求极高，必须在处理其他事务的同时管理巨量热量。不过凭借全弹齐射，它确实经常能完成任务。

column1: The E Configuration was, like the D configuration, developed during the Jihad. It was designed to use a large quantity of range-weaponry as its primary focus. The Hauptmann's right arm is fitted with a Gauss Rifle with 2 tons of ammunition mounted in that section. In the left arm, a Plasma Rifle has been fitted. Both arms have their lower arm actuators removed to allow for the pilot to flip arms. The Plasma Rifle's 2 tons of ammunition are stored in the left arm and in the left torso. The 'Mech's only secondary weapons are a pair of 5-Tubed Multi-Missile Launchers mounted in each side torso. The Hauptmann has been given 3 tons of CASE protected ammunition for the missile weaponry.
column2: E 配置与 D 配置一样，都是在圣战期间开发的，主要目标是使用大量远程武器。Hauptmann 右臂安装一门高斯步枪，并在该部位配置两吨弹药；左臂安装一门等离子步枪。两侧下臂驱动器都被拆除，以便驾驶员翻转手臂。等离子步枪的两吨弹药存放在左臂和左侧躯干。机甲唯一的副武器是两侧躯干各一具五管多用途导弹发射器，另配三吨由 CASE 保护的导弹弹药。

column1: The C-series of Jenners are some interesting upgrades, and work quite well as both a scout and a fast flanker.
column2: Jenners 的 C 系列是很有趣的升级型，既适合侦察，也适合高速侧翼机动。

column1: A unique Prototype Jinggau, this should be interesting to take a closer look at. It sure seems fun with that huge cannon. Can I take it for a test ride, Boss?
column2: 这是一台独特的 Jinggau 原型机，值得仔细研究。那门巨炮看起来一定很有趣。老大，我能借它试驾一下吗？

column1: An experimental testbed configuration sighted in use among the Blakist Shadow Divisions in 3075, the Caelestis configuration features a PPC Capacitor enhanced ER PPC mounted on its right arm, supported by a trio of ER Small Lasers.
column2: 这是 3075 年在 Blakist Shadow Divisions 中发现的实验测试平台。Caelestis 配置在右臂安装一门由 PPC 电容器增强的增程 PPC，并由三门增程小型激光器提供支援。

column1: A rebuild of the previous MAD-5L, attempting to create a better profile for a stealth 'Mech. Never saw much success.
column2: 这是上一台 MAD-5L 的重建型，试图为隐形机甲打造更好的轮廓，但从未取得多大成功。

column1: With the destruction of many BattleMech factories in the Jihad, the Mjolnir was designed for the Lyran Commonwealth's export market. By selling the Mjolnir to any interested party, the Lyrans would gain much needed capital to rebuild their factories and restore their industrial might. To maximize profits, the designers focused on using existing successful 'Mech parts and components. Drawing from the Commando and Wolfhound designs, the Mjolnir entered production at Arc-Royal only a few months after being designed.
column2: 圣战摧毁了许多 BattleMech 工厂后，Mjolnir 被设计用于莱拉联邦的出口市场。莱拉人将 Mjolnir 卖给所有有兴趣的买家，以获得急需的资金，重建工厂并恢复工业实力。为最大化利润，设计师集中使用现有的成功机甲零件和组件。Mjolnir 参考 Commando 和 Wolfhound 的设计，设计完成数月后便在 Arc-Royal 投入生产。

column1: The Orc is the first ProtoMech developed wholly by Clan Hell's Horses. The Orc reflects the unique battle tactics of the Horses. This version tries to take the best features of the Orc 2 and Orc 3. It carries three SRM tubes in its torso, and a machine gun in each arm.
column2: Orc 是 Hell's Horses 氏族完全自主开发的第一台 ProtoMech，体现了该氏族独特的战术。这一版本尝试结合 Orc 2 和 Orc 3 的优点，躯干内装有三具 SRM 发射管，每只手臂各有一挺机枪。

column1: A considerably better variant for the hotter climates compared to the -10K, at the cost of slightly more complicated maintenance.
column2: 与 -10K 相比，这一变体更适合炎热气候，代价是维护稍微复杂一些。

column1: A faster version of the Panther, which means it can be used as good flanker for those nasty backstabs shots we all love to give but not take.
column2: 这是 Panther 的高速版本，因此可以充当优秀的侧翼机，执行我们都喜欢施展、却不愿承受的背刺射击。

column1: The Procyon is the first ProtoMech designed and built by Clan Coyote. Procyon 5 Carries jump jets and replaces one ER Small Laser with an SRM-2
column2: Procyon 是 Coyote 氏族设计并制造的第一台 ProtoMech。Procyon 5 携带跳跃喷射器，并将一门增程小型激光器替换为一具 SRM-2。

column1: A support variant, the second most-commonly seen version of the Septicemia mounts two ATM 12s with three tons of ammunition for each. These are supplemented by three Heavy Small Lasers in each arm. Extra double heat sinks keeps heat levels in check.
column2: 这是 Septicemia 的支援型，也是最常见的第二种版本。它装备两门 ATM 12，每门配备三吨弹药；每只手臂另有三门重型小型激光器。额外的双散热器帮助控制热量。

column1: The Slagmaiden BattleMech is a mixed hybrid of Clan and Inner Sphere experimental technologies. Built in 3076 by Arc-Royal MechWorks, the 'Mech was intended to showcase advanced technologies and boost the morale of troops during the Jihad. Only two Slagmaidens were ever constructed, due to some of its design features and its expense.
column2: Slagmaiden BattleMech 是氏族与内圈实验技术的混合体。它由 Arc-Royal MechWorks 于 3076 年制造，旨在展示先进技术并提升圣战期间部队的士气。由于部分设计特征和高昂成本，最终只建造了两台 Slagmaiden。

column1: This thing has pretty good damage potential with flexible range, and the iATM system makes efficient uses of ammo. But it lacks focused pinpoint damage.
column2: 这东西拥有不错的伤害潜力和灵活射程，iATM 系统也能高效利用弹药。但它缺乏集中、精确的爆发伤害。

column1: Apparently intended for long range direct fire support or anti-aircraft work, this configuration carries three LB 2-X autocannons, an ER PPC, and a Light Gauss Rifle. It can share targeting data with lancemates via a C3 Slave unit.
column2: 这套配置显然用于远程直接火力支援或防空，装备三门 LB 2-X 自动火炮、一门增程 PPC 和一把轻型高斯步枪。通过 C3 从属单元，它能与同编队机甲共享目标数据。

column1: Used by The Society's MechWarriors, this version of the Timber Wolf carries twin iATM 9 missile launchers with four tons of ammunition. Each arm carries an ER Large Laser and an ER Medium Pulse Laser. To maximize its battlefield utility it also carries a Nova CEWS in the center torso.
column2: Society 的 MechWarrior 使用这一 Timber Wolf 版本，携带两具 iATM 9 导弹发射器和四吨弹药。每只手臂各有一门增程大型激光器和一门增程中型脉冲激光器。为最大化战场效用，中央躯干还安装了 Nova CEWS。

column1: The Turkina X variant is designed as a fire support mech with an LRM-20 slaved to an Artemis V FCS mounted in each arm. These launchers are backed up by six Medium Pulse Lasers and an ECM system. Talons are mounted on each foot for inflicting additional damage from kick attacks
column2: Turkina X 是火力支援机甲，每只手臂各有一具连接 Artemis V 火控系统的 LRM-20。发射器由六门中型脉冲激光器和 ECM 系统支援，双脚安装爪刃，可在踢击时造成额外伤害。

column1: The triple light PPC setup is quite unusual for the Wolfhound size of 'Mech, and the actual performance of this variant on the battlefield has been disputed.
column2: 对 Wolfhound 这么大的机甲来说，三门轻型 PPC 的配置相当不寻常，这一变体在战场上的实际表现也一直存在争议。

column1: A Wolverine is never bad to have around, this variant has good firepower and durability for its size.
column2: 身边有一台 Wolverine 总不会错，这个变体以自身吨位而言拥有不错的火力和耐久性。

column1: Well it is fast, tough, and surprisingly carries a Large VSPL for an APC refit. You can't ask much else out of a medium hovercraft boss.
column2: 它速度快、够坚固，而且作为 APC 改装型，居然还装了一门大型 VSPL。对一辆中型气垫船来说，老大，你还能要求更多吗？

column1: There's a reason the Bane has been around for so long, they just keep re-innovating it. This new variant makes it even more powerful, stay clear of it unless it is on your side.
column2: Bane 能服役这么久是有原因的：它一直在不断革新。这一新变体让它更加强大，除非它站在你这边，否则最好离它远点。

column1: The Prototype of the Centurion OmniMech sports an advanced FCS and Sensors system alongside a less bulky experimental Endo-Steel.
column2: Centurion OmniMech 的原型配备先进火控与传感器系统，并采用体积更小的实验型 Endo-Steel。

column1: Another of the more modern Crusader versions, using Stream SRM and MML launchers, which makes it a flexible platform for dealing with many different scenarios. The addition of an AMS makes it even more durable, sounds like a good investment in the long run.
column2: 这是较现代的 Crusader 版本之一，使用 Stream SRM 和 MML 发射器，使它成为应对多种战况的灵活平台。增加 AMS 后耐久性更强，长期来看是笔不错的投资。

column1: It's simple. It's pretty cheap. It's effective. VEST did something right with this export model.
column2: 很简单：便宜、直接、有效。VEST 在这款出口型号上确实做对了事情。

column1: The Dark Crow is a Clan Snow Raven developed Second Line BattleMech, which was produced only at its Inner Sphere facilities in the Outworlds Alliance after the Jihad. Named after a strange cave-dwelling bird found on Dante, the 'Mech has proven to be a popular design among Second Line troops. This variant uses experimental technology to create a space-capable variant of the Mech utilizing Laser heat sinks.
column2: Dark Crow 是 Snow Raven 氏族开发的第二线 BattleMech，圣战后仅在 Outworlds Alliance 的内圈设施生产。它以 Dante 上一种奇特的穴居鸟类命名，在第二线部队中很受欢迎。这一变体采用实验技术和激光散热器，打造出能够在太空作战的型号。

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The S Configuration is specifically designed to meet the Ravens' need for a space-based 'Mech developed in 3086. The S configuration is almost identical to the C configuration with the exception of the ECM suite and the mech uses Laser Heat sinks for heat management.
column2: Deimos 由 Snow Raven 氏族开发，于 3060 年代中期首次亮相，据称地点是 Kerensky Cluster 的 Lum 世界。然而，圣战期间内圈情报机构不再听到关于这台机甲的消息，它逐渐被遗忘。3085 年，Snow Raven 向内圈公开了 Deimos 的存在。它被视为氏族制造业的骄傲，每个 touman 至少配备一台。S 型专门满足 Snow Raven 在 3086 年开发太空机甲的需求，几乎与 C 型相同，区别在于 ECM 套件，并使用激光散热器管理热量。

column1: The heavy missile-laden configuration, the B Config's principal weaponry is a pair of arm mounted 15-tubed LRM Launchers with 3 tons of ammo per launcher in same location. A pair of smaller side torso 5-tubed LRMs, with mix sized Advanced Missile Launchers, 9 and 6 is found in the left torso exclusively. The design's only energy weapons are pair of ER Small Lasers found inside torsos.
column2: 这套重型导弹配置的主武器是两具安装在手臂上的十五管 LRM 发射器，每具同部位配备三吨弹药。左侧躯干单独安装两具较小的五管 LRM，并混合搭载九联和六联高级导弹发射器。该设计唯一的能量武器是躯干内的两门增程小型激光器。

column1: The Gravedigger was introduced by Odin Manufacturing in an effort to stave off bankruptcy. The company's plants sustained heavy damage in the Second Combine-Ghost Bear War, and the Gravedigger was produced to generate much needed capital. Built using many Inner Sphere components, the 'Mech was designed to be cheap to produce. When introduced, it initially used standard Inner Sphere weaponry, but after the massive infusion of money from sales to mercenary forces Odin created a new version with Clan-spec weaponry and additional electronics.
column2: Gravedigger 是 Odin Manufacturing 为避免破产而推出的。该公司的工厂在第二次 Combine－Ghost Bear 战争中遭到重创，Gravedigger 的生产旨在筹集急需的资金。这台机甲大量采用内圈部件，以降低生产成本。刚推出时使用标准内圈武器；佣兵部队购买带来大量资金后，Odin 制造了采用氏族规格武器和额外电子设备的新版本。

column1: How did you come by this Mech? There was only one, Khan Malvina Hazen will kill you if she finds out you have her brother's Mech.
column2: 你是怎么弄到这台机甲的？世上只有一台。Khan Malvina Hazen 要是发现你有她兄弟的机甲，会杀了你的。

column1: Gotta say, boss, this looks like a real catch! No? Alright. This little one-hundred ton baby has some of the best stealth technology I've ever seen. The two SB gauss rifles it had mounted look real nasty too. Definitely wouldn't want this thing sneaking up on me, that's for sure.
column2: 老大，必须承认，这看起来真是个好货！不？好吧。这台一百吨的小宝贝拥有我见过最好的隐形技术之一。它装的两把 SB 高斯步枪看起来也很凶。绝对不想让这东西悄悄摸到我身后。

column1: I'd say this is a better version than the 7V for any longer engagements, but the difference is not that big.
column2: 在持续交战中，我会说它比 7V 更好，但差距并不大。

column1: Built for Solaris by Barrymore Munitions, this Marauder replaces the usual autocannon with a large mech mortar. The rest of the loadout is dedicated to flexibility, carrying a bit of just about everything.
column2: Barrymore Munitions 为 Solaris 打造了这台 Marauder，用一门大型机甲迫击炮替换通常的自动火炮。其余配置注重灵活性，几乎每类装备都带了一点。

column1: Introduced in 3116, the third variant of the Shrike replaces the autocannons of the previous models with ER PPCS Large Lasers while keeping the ER Large Lasers and chest mounted LRM10 of the standard version.
column2: 该变体于 3116 年推出，用增程 PPC 大型激光器替换前代型号的自动火炮，同时保留标准版本的增程大型激光器和胸部 LRM-10。

column1: A new variant, just recently launched by Clan Hell's Horses, the 8 model replaces the jump jets with Actuator Enhancement Systems, sacrificing mobility for stunning accuracy.
column2: 这是 Hell's Horses 氏族最近推出的新变体。8 型用执行器增强系统替换跳跃喷射器，以牺牲机动性换取惊人的精准度。

column1: The Tenshi's Primary configuration is equipped mainly with standard technologies that allow the 'Mech to engage an enemy unit at long-range. Its main weapon is an arm-mounted Gauss Rifle which is fed with 3 tons of ammunition. Its other set of long range weaponry consists five Light Particle Projection Cannons, all of which are fitted into the 'Mech's right arm. For a last resort, the 'Mech sports a pair of 10-tubed Rocket Launchers, with one placed in each of its legs. All of the energy weapons are tied to a Targeting Computer for greater accuracy. Among other equipment found in this configuration is a Guardian ECM, providing an electronic screen against enemy attacks, while a Supercharger is fitted into the center torso to help temporarily increase ground speed.
column2: Tenshi 的主配置主要采用标准技术，使机甲能够在远距离与敌方单位交战。主武器是安装在手臂上的高斯步枪，由三吨弹药供给。其他远程武器包括五门轻型粒子投射炮，全部安装在机甲右臂。作为最后手段，机甲装备两具十管火箭发射器，左右腿各一具。所有能量武器都连接到目标锁定计算机，以提高精度。其他设备包括 Guardian ECM，为其提供抵御敌方攻击的电子屏障；中央躯干安装增压器，可暂时提高地面速度。

column1: Boss, I don't know where these things came from.  I have no idea how they actually work.  And finally, I have no idea why you you think it's a good idea to keep them
column2: 老大，我不知道这些东西从哪里来的，也完全不知道它们究竟怎么运作。更别提我不明白你为什么觉得把它们留下来是个好主意。

column1: It heats up real good sir, too bad this one doesn't have the sentience of the others.
column2: 先生，这东西热得厉害，可惜它没有其他型号那样的自我意识。

column1: The invasion strategies that created the Boyyi also shaped the Canis III. Originally a second-line unit, the Canis was designed to aggressively engage Inner Sphere forces. While its heavy firepower looked good on paper, severe heat problems and lack of speed limited its effectiveness. After the Wars of Reaving, Clan Coyote developed the costly Canis II, producing only a few units. Just before their next invasion, the Coyotes reimagined this workhorse again, resulting in the Canis III, improved for better battlefield performance.
column2: 制造 Boyyi 的入侵战略也塑造了 Canis III。Canis 最初是第二线单位，设计目标是主动攻击内圈部队。它纸面上的重火力很漂亮，但严重的散热问题和低速度限制了实战效果。掠袭战争后，Coyote 氏族开发了昂贵的 Canis II，但只生产了少量。下一次入侵前夕，Coyote 再次重新构想这台主力机，最终得到性能更佳的 Canis III。

column1: The origin of this mech is unknown, but all the mech's equipment indicate it's made by the Society. Its codename 'Obsidian Skull' is only known if you have seen this mech before and left alive to continue living.
column2: 这台机甲的来历不明，但所有设备都表明它出自 Society。它的代号“黑曜石之颅”只有见过这台机甲并活着离开的人才知道。

column1: The maximum expression of death at a distance. The SR-R is built around an improved, downscaled Railgun in the Center Torso. Two arm-mounted Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifles complete this long-range kinetic energy delivery system.
column2: 这是远距离死亡的极致表现。SR-R 以安装在中央躯干的改进型缩小轨道炮为核心，两臂的超强高斯步枪构成完整的远程动能投射系统。

column1: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapons are four ER PPC backed up by a Rotary AC/10. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner also has an Arrow IV launcher.
column2: 在主配置中，Summoner 拥有简单却有效的武器库。四门增程 PPC 是主要直接火力，并由一门旋转 AC/10 支援；用于火力支援和轰炸的还有一具 Arrow IV 发射器。

column1: The MetalMax was built by MaxTech to fix the mistakes of the SpacerMax, offering an IndustrialMech advertised for both zero-g and terrestrial metalworking. It carries several of the same features as its predecessor, like environmental sealing and jump jets, though tailored more specifically toward construction site tasks. Despite weighing five tons more than the SpacerMax, it actually costs slightly less, and its improved marketing helped it sell far better across the Great Houses and beyond.
column2: MetalMax 由 MaxTech 制造，用来纠正 SpacerMax 的缺陷，作为同时面向零重力和地面金属加工的工业机甲进行宣传。它保留了前身的一些特征，例如环境密封和跳跃喷射器，但更专门针对建筑工地任务。尽管比 SpacerMax 重五吨，它的成本反而略低；改进后的营销也让它在各大贵族领地及更远地区卖得更好。

column1: This one's a one trick pony boss, built just to see if the ER PPC could work on something small. Center torso mount caused nasty electromagnetic interference when fired, chalked up to the design rather than the weapon itself. Only six were ever made.
column2: 这台机甲只有一个绝招，老大：它被制造出来只是为了测试增程 PPC 能否装在小型机体上。中央躯干挂载在开火时会产生严重电磁干扰，问题被归咎于设计而不是武器本身。总共只制造了六台。

column1: Clan Ice Hellion took the old Coriolis design and rebuilt it from the ground up using Clan tech in 2888. Lighter, faster, more dangerous. The Ultra AC/20 alone makes it something you take seriously, but stacking an LB-10X and Ultra AC/5 on top of that means it can threaten targets at almost any range. Nearly every Clan ran these as second-line units before the Invasion. Finding one in our bay means we pulled something genuinely rare out of the field.
column2: Ice Hellion 氏族在 2888 年使用氏族科技彻底重建了老旧的 Coriolis 设计。它更轻、更快，也更危险。单凭 Ultra AC/20 就足以让人认真对待，而再加上 LB-10X 和 Ultra AC/5 后，它几乎能威胁所有距离的目标。入侵前，几乎每个氏族都把它作为第二线单位使用。在我们的机库里发现一台，说明我们从战场带回了真正稀有的战利品。

column1: The SLDF wanted a Firestarter and Wasp rolled into one and Argile Technologies delivered. Only a few dozen were ever built before the Amaris Civil War shut production down, and the ones that survived went with Kerensky into exile. Finding one of these in working condition is genuinely remarkable. It is fast, it jumps well, it burns things, and unlike the originals it can actually hold its own in a firefight if it has to. Treat it carefully.
column2: SLDF 想把 Firestarter 和 Wasp 合二为一，Argile Technologies 做到了。Amaris 内战中止生产前只造出几十台，幸存者随 Kerensky 流亡。能找到一台仍可运行的机体确实令人惊叹：它速度快、跳跃性能好、能纵火；与原版不同，必要时它也能在交火中保护自己。请小心对待它。

column1: Hollis Incorporated built a handful of these for the Capellan Confederation and called it experimental, which is putting it mildly. Two Arrow IV systems with nuclear ammunition aboard is not something most commanders want pointed anywhere near their own forces. The torso cockpit is unusual but it freed up the head for an AMS which makes sense given what it carries. Opponents who knew what it was loaded with sometimes just backed off entirely. Can't really blame them.
column2: Hollis Incorporated 为卡佩兰联盟制造了少量这种实验机，称其为“实验”还算客气。两套 Arrow IV 系统配上核弹药，绝不是多数指挥官愿意让它靠近己方部队的东西。躯干驾驶舱很不寻常，但它腾出的头部空间可以安装 AMS，这对它携带的武器来说很合理。知道它装了什么的敌人有时会直接撤退，也不能怪他们。

column1: Clan Diamond Shark built these out of their Twycross factory after they rebuilt it. Ultralight scout, fifteen tons, not meant to fight anything seriously. Lyran Alliance bought most of them and mercenaries liked them too because they're cheap enough to risk losing. That Chameleon Light Polarization Shield is Star League era tech which is a nice touch for something this small. Don't let anyone shoot at it though.
column2: Diamond Shark 氏族在重建 Twycross 工厂后制造了这些机体。它们是十五吨的超轻型侦察机，并不打算认真战斗。莱拉联盟买下了大多数，佣兵也喜欢它们，因为价格低到足以承受损失。Chameleon Light Polarization Shield 是星盟时代技术，用在这么小的机体上颇有特色。不过别让任何人向它开枪。

column1: The Yun Qi came out of Firefly Foundry's Sea Fox partnership and was built specifically to give Firefly Stables a competitive medium-class entry in the Solaris VII games, which had been a gap in the stable's lineup. Arena design requires a different kind of thinking than field hardware, and whoever drew this one up understood that a medium mech needs to be dangerous at every range to survive against opponents who will probe for weaknesses before committing. Fitting a Clan Gauss Rifle into a 50-ton frame without sacrificing close-range options is not a trivial engineering problem, and they solved it well.
column2: Yun Qi 出自 Firefly Foundry 与 Sea Fox 的合作，专门为 Firefly Stables 在 Solaris VII 赛事中提供一台具竞争力的中型机甲，填补其阵容空缺。竞技场设计需要与野战装备不同的思路，而设计者明白中型机甲必须在所有距离都具备威胁，才能在敌人试探弱点后活下来。把氏族高斯步枪装进 50 吨机体、同时保留近距离选项并非简单的工程问题，但他们解决得很好。

column1: Boss... this thing! I don't know who in the hells came up with the idea to add freaking spikes to a VTOL and have it ram itself into a 'Mech, but I'll be damned if it doesn't work pretty well.
column2: 老大……这东西！我不知道哪个疯子想到给 VTOL 装上尖刺，然后让它撞进机甲，但见鬼，它居然效果不错。

column1: What happens when Pirates are successful? They go and refit a perfectly fine Atlas II to look like a Pirate! Id say its still a pretty solid Mech, if you ignore that they welded a bloody Raven onto its Shoulder and called it Polly...
column2: 海盗成功后会发生什么？他们把一台完好的 Atlas II 改装得像海盗机甲！就算忽略他们把一只该死的 Raven 焊在肩膀上并命名为 Polly，我还是得说它是一台相当扎实的机甲。

column1: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. This was somehow 'repaired' by a punch of pirates, theres spikes everywhere, even in the chassis.
column2: 我们把 Cataphract 叫作“弗兰肯机甲”，因为它身上缝合了各种各样的东西。这台机甲不知怎么被一群海盗“修好”了，到处都是尖刺，甚至底盘上也有。

column1: This once was just an average commando but someone padded it up with spikes and grapplers all over, unfortunately the badly maintained actuators decrease its chance to punch anything.
column2: 它原本只是一台普通的 Commando，但有人给它全身加装尖刺和抓钩。遗憾的是，维护不善的驱动器降低了它成功出拳的机会。

column1: However a Pirate got his hands on this tech, and then stuffed it all into a Locust  ...also someone scribbled a Wang was here into the Cockpit.
column2: 某个海盗拿到了这项技术，然后把它全塞进 Locust 里……还有人直接在驾驶舱写下“Wang 到此一游”。

column1: Leave it to a Pirate to find a perfectly fine owens and do this to it, the BAP and Tag got Ripped out for some ECM to support its stealth abilities
column2: 只有海盗才会找到一台完好的 Owens，然后把它改成这样：BAP 和 TAG 被拆掉，换成 ECM 来支援隐形能力。

column1: The pirates who got their hands on this Swordsman really took its name seriously. Besides this huge ten-ton blade, it's crammed full of flamers and covered in spikes. They even found room to fit this stolen rotary AC/2.
column2: 抢到这台 Swordsman 的海盗真的把它的名字当回事。除了这把十吨重的巨刃，它还塞满喷火器、浑身布满尖刺，甚至找地方装上了偷来的旋转 AC/2。

column1: Astoundingly little was broken as they repaired this Uziel, even the XL is intact! Just dont look at these missile launcher they jury rigged into that poor little pumpkin...
column2: 他们修复这台 Uziel 时损坏的东西少得惊人，连 XL 引擎都完好无损！不过千万别看那些被临时接到可怜南瓜上的导弹发射器。

column1: I don't even want to know from whom they looted a Wolfhound, but whoever did, surely indulged themself with upgrading it's weapons, all these lasers sure pack a whallop, if it doesn't just melt looking at the trigger.
column2: 我甚至不想知道他们从谁那里抢来这台 Wolfhound，但无论是谁，都肯定沉迷于升级它的武器。这些激光器的火力很猛，只是别在扣下扳机时把它自己融化了。

column1: Boss... this was a perfectly good Timber Wolf until some tarwaffle with more money than sense strapped it into half a dozen rocket packs and a bulldozer. It's basically a missile, with a very unlucky pilot inside.
column2: 老大……这台 Timber Wolf 原本完好无损，直到某个钱多脑子少的蠢货给它绑上六组火箭包和一台推土机。它基本就是一枚导弹，里面还塞着一个倒霉驾驶员。

column1: What a fine Machine, a Cougar OmniMech! Except everything thats making it an Omni got replaced by jury rigged and non standard parts sewing and duct taping this piece of frankenmech together. One can wonder, how it doesn't fall apart.
column2: 多么漂亮的机器，一台 Cougar OmniMech！可惜所有让它成为 OmniMech 的部件都被临时拼装的非标准零件替换了，靠缝补和胶带把这台弗兰肯机甲勉强粘在一起。真让人想知道它为什么还没散架。

column1: Well, its a Piranha, though these Junkers somehow managed to mangle its targeting Systems while installing better MachineGun Mounts.....
column2: 好吧，它是一台 Piranha，只是这些垃圾佬在安装更好的机枪挂架时，居然把它的目标系统弄坏了……

column1: The hell did you bring me, Boss? Yes. I know it says "Mad Cat" in its computer, but this is definitely not a Timber Wolf. It's pieced together from several 'Mechs that have no business being mangled together like that!
column2: 老大，你给我带来了什么鬼东西？是的，我知道它的计算机上写着“Mad Cat”，但这绝对不是一台 Timber Wolf。它由几台本来不该被这样肢解拼接的机甲硬凑在一起。

column1: Boss, this is basically a beached battleship, but the main guns are intact and there's a top-of-the-line stealth system masking the whole thing. It may only move by dropship, but as long as you keep anything from getting close enough to see it, "Tommy" here will light up the countryside from here to Tharkad, no problem.
column2: 老大，这基本就是一艘搁浅的战列舰，但主炮完好无损，而且顶级隐形系统覆盖了整个机体。它也许只能靠运输船移动，但只要别让任何东西靠近到能发现它，“Tommy”就能从这里一路照亮乡间直到 Tharkad，完全不成问题。

column1: Hey boss, the inside of this cockpit has the words 'write something funny for how we got this' scratched into it.
column2: 嘿，老大，驾驶舱内部有人刻下了一句话：“写点有趣的东西解释我们怎么弄到这台机甲。”

column1: Alright as a sniper, I guess, but useless as a general mech. Too slow and too lightly armored. If you know where you're going to be engaging the enemy then I suppose you can use it for overwatch, since that 'target lock' on those Heavy PPCs will at least prevent friendly fire accidents.
column2: 作为狙击机还行吧，但用作通用机甲就毫无用处。速度太慢、装甲太薄。如果你知道交战地点，倒可以拿它做监视火力，因为那些重型 PPC 的“目标锁定”至少能避免误伤友军。

column1: This thing is built like a cockroach, there's no denying that. The issue is the firepower. It's only got eight SRM tubes on the whole mech, other than those grenades it lugs around.
column2: 这东西像蟑螂一样顽强，没什么可否认的。问题在于火力：整台机甲除了携带的那些手雷，只有八具 SRM 发射管。

column1: Well, this thing works as a sniper, I guess, but those so called 'gauss' rifles have some pretty severe damage loss at long range, thanks to the fact that AC2 shells aren't designed for those velocites. Not a bad budget assault though.
column2: 好吧，这东西可以当狙击机，但那些所谓的“高斯”步枪在远距离会严重损失伤害，因为 AC/2 炮弹根本不是为那种速度设计的。不过作为廉价突击机，它并不算差。

column1: Another Quicsell cockroach. Yeah, it's hard to kill, but it's ugly, it's shoddy, and it's undergunned. Less total damage than one AC20 shell, and the thing still overheats if you manage to land all three shots in rapid succession. Still, makes for a good rookie mech, since it's just about impossible to fuck up with those so called 'streak PPCs'.
column2: 又一只 Quicsell 蟑螂。没错，它很难杀，但又丑又破，火力还不足。总伤害甚至不如一发 AC/20，而且即使你成功快速打出三发，它仍然会过热。不过它很适合新手，因为那些所谓的“Streak PPC”几乎不可能用错。

column1: You're probably going to want to find some new weapons or ammo for this thing, boss. It's only source of damage, other than ramming the enemy mechs, is this shitty Quicsell Thunderbolt ammo that has no guidance hardware at all. Sure, it packs a punch, but it can barely hit the farm, let alone the barn.
column2: 老大，你最好给这东西找些新武器或弹药。除了撞击敌方机甲外，它唯一的伤害来源就是这种糟糕的 Quicsell Thunderbolt 弹药，而且完全没有制导硬件。它的确有冲击力，但连农场都很难打中，更别说谷仓了。

column1: Yes, this is a fast mech for what is nearly a heavy. No, it's not worth it, unless you're hunting light mechs or VTOLs, it's just too undergunned otherwise. It only has two large lasers, except, you don't even have that, because the beam focusers are cracked, so they spread beams all over the place and don't do that nice pinpoint damage.
column2: 对一台几乎算重型的机甲来说，它确实很快。不，这不值得——除非你专门猎杀轻型机甲或 VTOL，否则它的火力实在太弱。它只有两门大型激光器；更糟的是，连这都没有，因为光束聚焦器已经裂开，光束会到处散射，无法造成漂亮的集中伤害。

column1: What? Don't look at me like that, Boss. Ain't much to say. It's damn fast and that Heavy Large Laser is no joke. Seems pretty obvious to me.
column2: 什么？别那样看我，老大。没什么好说的：它快得离谱，那门重型大型激光器也绝不是笑话。对我来说，这显而易见。

column1: An attempt by RISC to Retrofit older Hollander's to the more powerful spec's of a Lyran Hollander II, cramming a Heavy Gauss Rifle on the Chassis while proven possible, equally proved too cost prohibitive, requiring a complete Assembly Line.
column2: RISC 试图把老式 Hollander 改装成莱拉 Hollander II 的高性能规格，在底盘上硬塞一门重型高斯步枪。虽然证明技术上可行，但成本同样高得无法承受，需要整条装配线。

column1: Used by RISC as a testbed, this Orion has been rebuilt from the ground up with experimental technology.
column2: RISC 把这台 Orion 当作测试平台，从头开始用实验技术重建。

column1: Boss, some arena Mechwarrior has put some serious upgrades into this thing. They upgraded the already good stealth systems, weapons, and even threw on jump jets!
column2: 老大，某个竞技场 MechWarrior 对这台机甲做了大量升级。他们强化了本就不错的隐形系统和武器，甚至还加装了跳跃喷射器！

column1: This Flashman was Upgraded with Special Electronics to make the 4 Plasma Rifles even more Potent. The Heat it dishes out is enormous, and if someone thinks they can get close, those Micro Lasers will hurt a Lot. 2 AMS make sure it doesnt get any Missiles close to it, while the Probe and ECM give it a good Defense. Oh and, the Cooling System on this Thing is Quite something to look at.
column2: 这台 Flashman 通过特殊电子设备升级，使四门等离子步枪的威力更强。它释放的热量极其惊人，任何试图靠近的人都会被微型激光器狠狠教训。两套 AMS 确保导弹无法接近，探测器和 ECM 则提供良好防御。哦，这东西的冷却系统也相当值得一看。

column1: I know I give the Clans a lotta flak for ruining what ain't broke, but this time I think they might've been onto something. No unnecessary bullshit here, just a straight continuation of what the Shadow Hawk used to be. Top marks - for a Clan design, anyway.
column2: 我知道我经常批评氏族把没坏的东西改坏，但这次我觉得他们可能做对了。这里没有多余的废话，只是 Shadow Hawk 原本设计的直接延续。满分评价——当然，是按氏族设计的标准。

column1: Well, this is a monster of a 'Mech. Whoever designed this thing loved their PPCs; the entire fire control systems are optimised around squeezing as much out of them as possible. She still runs a little hot, though, so keep an eye on that.
column2: 这真是一台怪物般的机甲。设计它的人热爱 PPC；整套火控系统都围绕着尽可能榨出 PPC 火力进行优化。不过它运行时仍然有些过热，记得盯紧热量。

column1: The Clans upgraded the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. The Z variant is a Society refit that packs a pair of Light TAGs, a pair of Medium Supra Lasers, an iATM9, and a Streak NARC.
column2: 氏族升级了老牌 Griffin 设计，最终诞生了如今的 Griffin IIC BattleMech。Z 型是 Society 的改装型，装备两具轻型 TAG、两门中型 Supra 激光器、一具 iATM9 和一具 Streak NARC。

column1: I mean, it's pretty much what you'd expect out of a Hammerhands: a pair of cannons supplemented by a PPC; just, ya know, better.
column2: 这基本就是你对 Hammerhands 的预期：两门火炮再由一门 PPC 支援，只是——你懂的——性能更好。

column1: The Design that would Later become the Fafnir, was this prototype meant to carry 2 StarLeague Era Railguns, but suffered from many typical Superheavy Design issues.
column2: 后来成为 Fafnir 的设计原本是一台计划携带两门星盟时代轨道炮的原型机，但遭遇了超重型设计常见的诸多问题。

column1: A minor modification to the CMA-1S, the CMA-C drops the Machine Gun and its ammunition and replaces them with a C3 Slave unit, allowing the Mech to be integrated into C3 equipped units.
column2: 这是CMA-1S的小幅改进型。CMA-C拆除机枪及其弹药，换成C3从属单元，使这台机甲能够编入配备C3的部队。

column1: What we have here is something I never thought I would see. It has clan tech, It is built by the clans, but it is definitely designed to rip your face off with those talons. I hope Malvina Hazen gifted you that mech, else you may be in trouble.
column2: 我们眼前的是我从没想过会见到的东西。它采用氏族技术，由氏族制造，但那些爪子显然是用来撕碎敌人的。希望Malvina Hazen把这台机甲送给了你，否则你可能要倒霉。

column1: The Starslayer was a mainstay of the Lyran military when the 'Mech was resurrected in the thirty-first century. This highly mobile energy weapon platform can stay in the field nearly indefinitely with minimal resupply, making it an optimal raider. Upgraded Starslayers played a key role in Task Force Kingbreaker on Buena. Precision strikes disabled the equipment of the Third Collective Guards at Fort Buena without killing their occupants, whom the LCAF regarded as misguided fellow Lyran citizens
column2: Starslayer在31世纪复兴后成为莱拉军队的主力。这种高度机动的能量武器平台只需极少补给就能几乎无限期留在战场，因而是理想的突袭者。升级后的Starslayer在Buena的Kingbreaker特遣队行动中发挥了关键作用。精确打击瘫痪了Buena堡垒第三集群卫队的装备，没有杀死其中人员；LCAF认为他们只是误入歧途的莱拉同胞。

column1: A Crusader carrying Plasma weapons is not a common sight, but those crazy Capellans create one. Don't ask me why though.
column2: 携带等离子武器的Crusader并不常见，但那些疯狂的卡佩兰人造出了一台。至于为什么，别问我。

column1: Another of those NAIS mechs, where they aim to maximize the performance by just throwing all the latest tech at a 'Mech.
column2: 又一台NAIS机甲：他们把所有最新技术都塞进去，只为最大化机甲性能。

column1: The Gorgon is a heavy fire support unit that often anchors ProtoMech Points. A Jihad era variant, this model utilized an AP Gauss Rifle and SRM-6 Launcher. It was given a half-set of jump jets and a rearrangement of its protection.
column2: Gorgon是重型火力支援单位，经常作为原型机甲分队的核心。这个圣战时代的变体使用AP高斯步枪和SRM-6发射器，并配备半套跳跃喷射器，重新调整了防护布局。

column1: The personal 'Mech of Crucis March Militia deserter-turned-bandit Greta Halperin, her Hellspawn introduced in 3072 had been extensively modified with experimental technologies to turn it into a deadly first strike backstabber.
column2: 这是Crucis边疆民兵逃兵、后来成为匪徒的Greta Halperin的私人机甲。她在3072年得到的Hellspawn经过大量实验技术改装，变成了致命的先手突袭者。

column1: The Orochi is a Post-Jihad Assault BattleMech built by Victory Industries on Marduk. This Mech was intended to be an upgrade of the ancient Longbow fire-support design, utilizing Advance Tech Missile launchers in place of the Longbow's traditional LRM launchers.
column2: Orochi是圣战后由Victory Industries在Marduk制造的突击战斗机甲，旨在升级古老的Longbow火力支援设计，以先进技术导弹发射器取代Longbow传统的LRM发射器。

column1: A skilled pilot at the controls of a PNT-12DC-I can tear the head off an enemy ‘Mech with a single shot at close range. And that is precisely what it has been designed to do – taking the fight to enemy ‘Mechs in a city environment.
column2: 熟练驾驶PNT-12DC-I的飞行员可以在近距离一枪打掉敌方机甲的头部。这正是它的设计目的：在城市环境中主动向敌方机甲发起战斗。

column1: The Procyon is the first ProtoMech designed and built by Clan Coyote. Procyon 3 replaces the ER Small Lasers with a Heavy Small Laser and an LRM-3.
column2: Procyon是第一台由郊狼氏族设计和制造的原型机甲。Procyon 3将ER小型激光替换为一门重型小型激光和一具LRM-3。

column1: This configuration carries a C3 Slave unit, fifteen double heat sinks, two Heavy PPCs, and a Gauss Rifle.
column2: 该配置携带C3从属单元、15枚双重散热器、两门重型PPC和一支高斯步枪。

column1: Vindicator 6L is simultaneously a cross between the 4L, 5L, and something completely new. The salvaged nature of the 6L makes it incredibly rare, with each one being ''handmade'' and awarded to only the most deserving Vindicator pilots.
column2: Vindicator 6L同时融合了4L、5L以及全新的设计。6L由打捞部件构成，极其稀有；每一台都是“手工打造”，只授予最值得的Vindicator驾驶员。

column1: Another Solaris custom, the Wolverine DS is designed to deal massive damage in a short time, and have the mobility to get out safely.
column2: 又一台Solaris定制机。Wolverine DS旨在短时间内造成巨大伤害，同时具备安全撤离所需的机动性。

column1: The Hauptmann-M configuration is equipped with a Clan-spec ER PPC. This is supplemented by three LRM-15launchers. This long-range weaponry is a good choice as the M configuration carries a C3 Boosted Master computer into combat.
column2: Hauptmann-M型装备氏族规格的ER PPC，并由三具LRM-15发射器支援。由于M型携带C3增强主计算机，这套远程武器配置非常合适。

column1: A single Large Laser for long distance engagement, otherwise the main purpose is to scout and track enemy forces.
column2: 用于远距离交战的一门大型激光；除此之外，主要任务是侦察和追踪敌军。

column1: This 'Black Marauder' was found abandoned on the Asteroid LV-426, composed of extremely advanced Materials does it sport unique Weaponry and a unnerving capacity for Self Repair...
column2: 这台“黑色掠夺者”被发现遗弃在LV-426小行星上。它由极其先进的材料构成，装备独特武器，并拥有令人不安的自我修复能力……

column1: So you modified the files or had a bug, you should not have this mech. If it was a bug and you ended up with this mech please report it to Discord. If not think about this: You are riding around in a semi sentient beings body.
column2: 所以你改过文件，或者遇到了漏洞；你本不该拥有这台机甲。如果是漏洞导致你得到它，请向Discord报告。否则想想吧：你正驾驶着一个半自主生命体的身体。

column1: The Banshee IIC is a Clan second-line variant of a Star League-era design, pressed back into service due to shortages. The original Banshee, while iconic, had notable flaws. As OmniMechs advanced, older chassis like the Banshee IIC were relegated to garrisons or caches. The Star Adders kept the largest stockpiles. Over time, it was upgraded from SLDF weaponry standards. Recent IIC and IIC 2 variants improve on the Defiance BNC-5S design using advanced Clan technology, making the Banshee a more capable and dangerous battlefield machine..
column2: Banshee IIC是星盟时代设计的氏族二线变体，因短缺而重新服役。原版Banshee虽然经典，但存在明显缺陷。随着全向机甲发展，Banshee IIC等老底盘被降为驻军或缓存。星蝰氏族保有最大的库存。后来它从SLDF武器标准逐步升级；近期IIC和IIC 2型使用先进氏族技术改进Defiance BNC-5S设计，使Banshee成为更强、更危险的战场机器。

column1: Built as one of the earliest SecurityMechs ever fielded, drawn up just days after the original Wasp debuted. Sigourney Renault put it together using common IndustrialMech parts and cheap Hegemony weapons, aiming for something any world could afford at around a million C-Bills. Never stood a chance against real BattleMechs, so it mostly stuck to Periphery worlds that didn't expect that kind of trouble.
column2: 这是最早投入使用的安保机甲之一，在原始Wasp亮相几天后就开始绘制设计。Sigourney Renault使用常见工业机甲部件和廉价的霸权武器拼装，目标是造出任何世界都买得起、约一百万C-bills的机甲。它从未有机会与真正的战斗机甲抗衡，因此主要留在不预期遭遇这类麻烦的外围世界。

column1: A Canopian noblewoman got bored and commissioned a gladiatorial mech on Solaris VII. That is the whole story. Anya Sokolov wanted something fast, close-range and built around melee, and whoever built this delivered exactly that. The VSP lasers get more accurate the closer you are, the MASC gets you there faster than anyone expects, and then the whip and vibroblade do the rest. She won several tournaments with it. Looking at the loadout, that does not surprise me at all.
column2: 一位加诺普斯贵妇无聊之下委托Solaris VII制造了一台角斗机甲。故事就是这样。Anya Sokolov想要一台快速、近距离、以近战为核心的机甲，而制造者完全满足了要求。VSP激光距离越近越精准，MASC让你比任何人预期更快接敌，随后鞭子和振动刀完成剩下的工作。她用它赢得了多场锦标赛。看这套配置，我一点也不惊讶。

column1: The Ziegfried came out of the pre-Civil War Commonwealth procurement period, when both halves of the Federated Commonwealth were still trying to field hardware that impressed the other side, and Kallon delivered something genuinely clever with the TSM integration. After the split, both the Lyran Alliance and the Federated Suns ended up running it, which led to the unusual situation of identical machines facing each other across the front lines. A heavy mech that deliberately runs hot as part of its combat plan requires a very specific kind of pilot discipline to use properly, but when it works the Sword hits hard enough to end engagements quickly.
column2: Ziegfried诞生于内战前联邦采购时期，当时联邦两半都试图部署能让对方印象深刻的装备，Kallon交付了一台真正巧妙地整合TSM的机甲。分裂后，莱拉联盟和联邦太阳都装备了它，导致相同机器在前线相遇的奇特局面。让重型机甲按战斗计划故意保持高热，需要非常严格的驾驶纪律；但一旦运作，Sword的打击力足以迅速结束交战。

column1: Boss, these pirates somehow got their hands on an Anubis stealth mech. How they managed to salvage the delicate advanced Stealth and ECM systems, yet broke the LRMs is beyond me.  They have replaced them with some semblance of an MML system and of course it wouldn't be a pirate without flamers.
column2: 老板，这些海盗不知怎么弄到了一台Anubis隐形机甲。他们竟能打捞出脆弱的高级隐形和ECM系统，却把LRM弄坏了，真是不可思议。他们用某种MML系统替代，当然还加了火焰喷射器——没有火焰喷射器就不算海盗。

column1: This started as a fairly normal Crosscut X5M, and then some crazy fool ripped out the nice light AC2 and put a hotwired PPC in it's place. The scary thing is that it can take the heat. Oh, and watch out for the downright terrifying missile pack they bolted on too.
column2: 它原本是相当普通的Crosscut X5M，后来某个疯子拆掉漂亮的轻型AC/2，换成一门硬接线PPC。可怕的是它居然承受得住热量。哦，还要小心他们加装的那套极其吓人的导弹包。

column1: While still Pretty much a Victor, it looks as if they tried to 'upgrade' the AC20, totally screwing up the entire balance and chassis. It has DOOMGUY written all over...
column2: 它基本还是Victor，但他们似乎试图“升级”AC/20，结果彻底破坏了整体平衡和底盘。上面到处都写着DOOMGUY……

column1: Designed specifically as a fire support 'Mech by Curtis Militech, the Yeoman uses a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous armour,allowing  paired LRM-15 launchers and LRM-10 launchers to be mounted in each side torso. 6 tons of ammunition are stored in CASE protected magazines.
column2: Yeoman由Curtis军工专门设计为火力支援机甲，采用内骨骼钢和铁纤维装甲，使每侧躯干都能安装两具LRM-15和两具LRM-10发射器。6吨弹药存放在CASE保护的弹药舱中。
